releases.title: The Louisiana First Horizon Foundation Announces Investment in Louisiana Music Museum
releases.body:
LAFAYETTE, La., Nov. 6, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The Louisiana First Horizon Foundation today announced a significant investment in the Louisiana Music Museum, a program of the Acadiana Center for the Arts. The Foundation's support will help preserve Louisiana's rich musical heritage while advancing the development of a new cultural and educational destination in Downtown Lafayette.

The Foundation's commitment supports the museum's ongoing capital campaign and includes naming recognition for the Walk of Legends Plaza, an outdoor entrance space along South Buchanan Street designed to celebrate Louisiana's musical legends and their contributions to the state's cultural heritage.

"Louisiana's music is an important part of our culture and identity, and the Foundation is proud to support a project that will preserve that legacy for future generations," said Jerry Prejean, Acadiana Market President for First Horizon. "This museum will not only celebrate the artists and traditions that make our state unique, but also create new opportunities for education, tourism and economic growth in the communities we call home."

Located in the historic 1890 Lafayette Hardware Store in Downtown Lafayette, the museum will bring Louisiana's musical history to life through immersive exhibits, storytelling and educational experiences. From Cajun and Creole traditions to jazz, blues, zydeco, gospel, funk and more, the museum will highlight the diverse sounds and artists that have shaped the state's musical identity.

"The Louisiana Music Museum is about more than preserving our musical heritage. It's about bringing to life the stories, traditions and creativity that have shaped Louisiana's rich cultural identity," said Samuel Oliver, Executive Director of Acadiana Center for the Arts. "We hope to create a space that celebrates Louisiana's remarkable contributions to music while inspiring future generations. We're grateful to First Horizon for believing in this vision and helping us bring it to life."

Construction is expected to begin in 2027, with the museum slated to open in 2028.

About the Louisiana First Horizon Foundation

The Louisiana First Horizon Foundation is a private charitable foundation of First Horizon National Corporation. Founded in 2020, the Foundation has donated more than $15 million to meet community needs. Grants from the Foundation support the following impact areas: Arts & Culture, Education & Leadership, Environment, Financial Literacy and Health & Human Services. More information is available at www.firsthorizonfoundation.com

About AcA

As the community leader in arts and culture, the Acadiana Center for the Arts (AcA) serves to bring elevating arts experiences to the people of Acadiana through many approaches including holding public concerts, presenting art exhibitions, providing grants to artists and cultural organizations, and bringing artists into schools across the region. AcA brings equitable access to the arts through year-round education and outreach activities and aims to build a more sustainable cultural ecosystem for future generations in Acadiana. www.acadianacenterforthearts.org.

releases.body:
Original Members Omarion, J-Boog, Lil' Fizz and Raz-B Reunite on BPC Music Group's Inaugural Album Release

Lead Single "Mileage" Reaches the Top 15 at R&B/Hip-Hop Radio and No. 1 on Apple Music's R&B Songs and R&B Videos Charts. New Single "Co-Sign" Arrives Today

LOS ANGELES, Nov. 6, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Platinum-selling R&B group B2K returns today with ECLIPSE, its first studio album in nearly 24 years, via BPC Music Group. Original members Omarion, J-Boog, Lil' Fizz and Raz-B reunite on the thirteen-track project, which arrives alongside the new single "Co-Sign," produced and written by The Underdogs. ECLIPSE is available now on all major streaming platforms. STREAM/PURCHASE LINK

Watch the lyric video for "Co-Sign" here.

The hits. The harmonies. The moves. The brotherhood. B2K helped define a generation of R&B, and ECLIPSE brings four distinct journeys back into one unmistakable sound. The album features production from Sean Garrett, The Underdogs, Troy Taylor, Hitmaka, Blaq Tuxedo, Lil Ronnie, Kenneth "KP" Paige and Ethos, with songwriting contributions from B2K, The Underdogs, Eric Bellinger, Ant Clemons and Tyree Hawkins, among others.

The rollout began in July with "Mileage," which debuted at No. 38 on Billboard's Mainstream R&B/Hip-Hop Airplay chart, marking B2K's first entry on the chart in more than two decades and its seventh career entry. The single climbed to No. 23 on the Billboard tally, reached the Top 15 at R&B/Hip-Hop radio, and hit No. 1 on both Apple Music's R&B Songs and R&B Videos charts.

B2K followed in October with "Lil Freak," an Atlanta bass-inspired track produced by Lil Ronnie, Slikk Muzik and Kelby on the Track. Released with an official visualizer, the track pairs the group's signature vocal chemistry with a bass-heavy groove built for the dance floor.

Ahead of the album's release, B2K celebrated its return with an exclusive performance on NBC's TODAY on November 4, delivering a medley that paired new music from ECLIPSE with the group's signature hits. Find clip here.

"ECLIPSE is a celebration of our brotherhood, growth, and legacy. 25 years later, we're still making history," states Raz B of B2K.

"20+ years later, the stars have aligned. It's been so much fun bringing this project to life, and that energy speaks for itself in every track. Enjoy the music. Get ready for the ECLIPSE. B2K 2026. No, we don't miss," said Omarion of B2K.

"We're proud to share this next chapter with our fans. ECLIPSE is a moment we've all been waiting for!" exclaims Fizz of B2K.

"Being able to reunite with my brothers and give our fans new music after 24 years is something I'm truly proud of," says J Boog of B2K.

ECLIPSE is the inaugural album release from BPC Music Group, the label founded by Black Promoters Collective partners Gary Guidry and Troy Brown. Black Promoters Collective also presented the Boys 4 Life Tour, the nationwide arena run that brought B2K and Bow Wow back together onstage.

"We've worked with B2K on stage for years, and ECLIPSE is the natural next step: new music from four artists who still have plenty to say," said Gary Guidry, CEO of BPC Music Group.

B2K has earned seven Billboard Hot 100 entries, including the No. 1 smash "Bump, Bump, Bump," and two RIAA-certified platinum albums, B2K and Pandemonium! The group's self-titled debut reached No. 1 on Billboard's Top R&B/Hip-Hop Albums chart and No. 2 on the Billboard 200.

The group's three BET Awards include the 2002 Viewer's Choice Award for "Uh Huh," followed by Best Group and the Viewer's Choice Award for "Bump, Bump, Bump" in 2003. B2K also earned a Billboard Music Award for R&B/Hip-Hop Single Sales Track of the Year for "Uh Huh," three Soul Train Music Awards for B2K, Pandemonium! and "Bump, Bump, Bump," and a 2003 Nickelodeon Kids' Choice Award for Favorite Music Group.

From "Uh Huh," "Gots Ta Be" and "Why I Love You" to "Girlfriend" and "Bump, Bump, Bump," B2K soundtracked a generation's coming-of-age years. The group's signature choreography and the members' roles in the 2004 dance film You Got Served made them a fixture on screen as well as on the charts. With ECLIPSE, all four members give fans a new reason to turn the volume up.

ABOUT B2K

B2K is an American R&B boy band that rose to prominence in the early 2000s with their smooth vocals, infectious dance routines, and charismatic appeal. Comprised of Omarion, Lil' Fizz, J-Boog, and Raz-B, the group became one of the defining acts of their era with chart-topping hits including "Bump, Bump, Bump," "Uh Huh," "Why I Love You," and "Girlfriend." Their platinum-selling albums B2K and Pandemonium! earned widespread acclaim, including a BET Award for Best Group, Billboard Music Award for R&B/Hip-Hop Single Sales Track of the Year, Nickelodeon Kids' Choice Award for Favorite Music Group and multiple Soul Train Music Awards, while their starring role in the iconic 2004 dance film You Got Served further cemented their place in pop culture. More than two decades after their debut, B2K continues to resonate with audiences across generations, with their successful reunion and sold-out Boys 4 Life Tour reaffirming the group's lasting impact on R&B and their status as one of the most influential boy bands of the early 2000s. The group is currently preparing to release a new album this fall, led by the upcoming single "Mileage," produced by Ethos.

ABOUT BPC MUSIC GROUP

BPC Music Group, established in 2025 by Gary Guidry and Troy Brown, partners in the Black Promoters Collective, was founded on a commitment to artist development, creative freedom, and Black ownership. Dedicated to releasing music that moves culture forward, the label's growing roster includes Bow Wow, whose 2025 single "Use Me," featuring Chris Brown, debuted at No. 1 on the R&B radio chart. BPC Music Group is set to release B2K's highly anticipated first album in over two decades later this year, ushering in the next chapter of one of R&B's most beloved groups.

releases.body:
SOCAN Foundation awards Music Creator Day grants totalling $40,000

Canadians encouraged to celebrate and support the artists, songwriters, and composers behind the music they love

TORONTO, Nov. 6, 2026 /CNW/ -- On the eve of Canada's second annual Music Creator Day, SOCAN is proud to announce the recipients of its inaugural Music Creator Day grants. Through the SOCAN Foundation, a total of $40,000 in grant funding was awarded to four Canadian organizations whose projects showcase or invest in the work of music creators. 

Established alongside Music Creator Day in 2025 and celebrated each year on November 7 in honour of legendary Canadian songwriter Joni Mitchell's birthday, these grants support organizations that help songwriters and composers develop their craft and connect with audiences.

Together, the grant recipients represent a diverse range of projects that reflect the spirit of Music Creator Day through performances, educational programming, mentorship opportunities, and community-focused initiatives.

"Music Creator Day was established to recognize the cultural contributions of songwriters and composers at home and abroad," said Charlie Wall-Andrews, Executive Director, SOCAN Foundation. "These grants bring that vision to life by supporting organizations that create opportunities for music creators to learn and grow. We're proud to celebrate organizations investing in the careers of Canadian music creators."

"The goal of Music Creator Day is simple: to celebrate the songwriters and composers whose work makes our lives better. By shining a spotlight on music creators, we're building greater appreciation for the talent and creativity at the very heart of Canadian music," said Jennifer Brown, SOCAN CEO.

Visit www.socanfoundation.ca for more information about the 2027 Music Creator Day grants.

For more information about Music Creator Day, follow us @SOCANMusic on social media.

About SOCAN

SOCAN is Canada's largest member-owned music rights organization, championing the fundamental value of music and the people who create it. SOCAN collects license fees for the public performance and reproduction of music, matches them to rights holders, and distributes them as royalties to songwriters, composers and music creators and publishers in Canada and around the world. With more than a century of expertise and innovation, SOCAN stands for respect and fair compensation for creative work – protecting, recognizing, and celebrating its over 200,000 songwriter, composer, and music publisher members. For more information: www.socan.com. 

About SOCAN Foundation

Founded in 1992, the SOCAN Foundation is dedicated to fostering the next generation of music creators and publishers in Canada through grants, awards, and programs. The Foundation is an independent organization guided by its board of directors. This organization is a part of the SOCAN Group of organizations and is guided by a board of directors, consisting of songwriters, composers, and music publishers.

OPELIKA, Ala., Nov. 6, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Bass Pro Shops Bulls, Bands, & Barrels announced its 19-stop national tour for 2027, featuring its first stadium event March 5 and 6 at Lourdes Stadium in Lafayette, Louisiana. Jason Aldean and Treaty Oak Revival will headline the two-day event.

Aldean will headline Friday, March 5, followed by Treaty Oak Revival on Saturday, March 6. The two-day event, billed as Battle in the Boot, brings bull riding, barrel racing and freestyle bullfighting together with live country music. Additional performers include Lauren Alaina and Fox N' Vead. Hotel packages, RV parking, tailgating and more will give fans new ways to make BBB's stadium debut a country music and western sports getaway.

BBB's signature arena show packs bull riding, barrel racing, freestyle bullfighting and live country music into a three-hour spectacle built for longtime fans and first-timers alike. The competition and concert share the spotlight, bringing four distinct attractions together for one unforgettable night out.

Fans can take their BBB experience beyond the grandstands with Pit Passes and Behind the Chutes Tours, available as add-ons in every market. Pit Passes offer front-of-stage access for the concert, while Behind the Chutes Tours take fans to the bucking chutes for an inside look at the sport and opportunities to meet the athletes, cast and crew who bring BBB to life.

Fans can register for presale access at BullsBandsAndBarrels.com. Presale for select tour dates begins Thursday, Nov. 12, with public ticket sales beginning Friday, Nov. 13. Ticketing details for the BBB Finals and the stops on May 1 and May 15 will be announced separately.

"The music matters as much as what happens in the dirt," said Hunter Price, founder and CEO of Bulls, Bands, & Barrels. "Lafayette takes that whole experience into a stadium for two days, with Jason Aldean and Treaty Oak Revival leading the lineup. We're giving fans a reason to make a weekend of it. This ain't your grandpappy's rodeo."

The tour opens Jan. 9 at Ford Center in Evansville, Indiana, and runs through June. Artists appearing on selected dates include Jon Pardi, Parker McCollum, Tucker Wetmore, Sam Barber, Kameron Marlowe, Ole 60, Vincent Mason, Dexter and The Moonrocks, and more. Lineups vary by market.

The season culminates June 4 and 5 with the two-night BBB Finals, where athletes from across the tour will compete for championship titles.

The 2027 season marks a new partnership with Doussan Music Group, an independent concert promotion and live entertainment company, to support the continued growth of BBB.

"BBB has built a strong identity by giving the competition and the concert equal billing," said Russell Doussan, founder and CEO of Doussan Music Group. "We see an opportunity to build on that success, connect more artists and fans with the tour, and help the team deliver its next stage of growth."

releases.body:
The five-time Grammy-winning Country Music Hall of Fame member has earned 19 #1 singles as a solo artist and with The Judds

NEW YORK, Nov. 6, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- ASCAP, the American Society of Composers, Authors and Publishers, will honor country music star Wynonna Judd with the ASCAP Golden Note Award.

Past ASCAP Golden Note honorees include Garth Brooks, Tom Petty, LeAnn Rimes, Lee Ann Womack, Reba and Alan Jackson.

The ASCAP Golden Note Award celebrates extraordinary career milestones achieved by songwriters, composers and artists. Past honorees include Garth Brooks, Tom Petty, LeAnn Rimes, Lee Ann Womack, Reba, Alan Jackson and Don Williams, among others.

"Wynonna's legendary career is defined by a singular, powerhouse voice and a rich body of work that has permanently shaped the landscape of American music," said ASCAP Chairman of the Board and President Paul Williams. "As we honor her with the ASCAP Golden Note Award, we celebrate a true trailblazer whose soulful, unmistakable sound continues to inspire generations of music creators."

With the release of her 1992 self-titled solo debut, Wynonna emerged as an exceptional force in American music. Beyond five Grammy Awards, multi-platinum albums and sold-out tours, the country/soul vocalist built on the Appalachian traditionalism that defined The Judds to create a world where a top 5 dance/club hit was as possible as being inducted into the Country Music Hall of Fame.

Having practically grown up as America's favorite musical daughter, Wynonna matured into a woman who embraced how life is filled with peaks and valleys, great thrills and heavy disappointment. Those realities informed her five-times platinum Wynonna and platinum-selling Tell Me Why, albums that gave voice to every human being emerging into adulthood with joy in their heart. Beyond the groundbreaking music she and her mother created as The Judds, Wynonna has grown into her once-in-a-generation vocal prowess with an ease that made people flock to her. "No One Else on Earth," "Tell Me Why," "She Is His Only Need," "Girls with Guitars" and "I Saw the Light" set the next chapter in motion for the girl from Ashland, Kentucky who became a global superstar.

Most recently, Wynonna released The Hard Truth (via ANTI-Records). The 10-track project was her first time co-writing an album – one that masterfully weaves her own painful trials with resounding joy and triumph. In its first week, the album garnered over 1.3 million streams and debuted in the top 10 on Billboard's Top Album Sales chart. Wynonna is currently on the road on The Hard Truth Tour, a 33-date tour that brings her unmistakable voice, powerhouse performances and deeply personal new music to audiences across North America.

The award will be presented at the ASCAP Nashville Songwriters Celebration on Monday, November 16 in Nashville. The invitation-only celebration recognizes the songwriters and publishers of the past year's most-performed ASCAP country and Christian songs.

About ASCAP

The American Society of Composers, Authors and Publishers (ASCAP) is a membership association of more than 1.1 million songwriters, composers and music publishers, and represents some of the world's most talented music creators. Founded and governed by songwriters, composers and publishers, it returns nearly 90 cents of every dollar collected to its members as royalties and has the lowest overhead of any U.S. PRO. ASCAP licenses a repertory of over 20 million musical works to hundreds of thousands of businesses that use music, including streaming services, cable television, radio and satellite radio and brick and mortar businesses such as retail stores, hotels, clubs, restaurants and bars. ASCAP collects the licensing fees, and identifies, matches, processes and pays royalties to its members for trillions of performances every year. The ASCAP blanket license offers an efficient solution for businesses to legally perform ASCAP music while respecting the right of songwriters and composers to be paid fairly. ASCAP puts music creators first, advocating for their rights and the value of music on Capitol Hill, driving innovation that moves the industry forward, building community and providing the resources and support that creators need to succeed in their careers. Learn more and stay in touch at www.ascap.com, on X and Instagram @ASCAP and on Facebook.

releases.title: iQIYI Revives 90-Year-Old Lost Film with NadouPro, Shortlisted for the AI Unit at the Golden Rooster Awards
releases.body:
BEIJING, Nov. 6, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- iQIYI, China's leading online entertainment platform, is pioneering a new path in AI-powered film restoration through NadouPro, the company's AI platform built for professional film and television production. NadouPro has enabled the creative restoration of "Visiting Shanghai after Sixty Years", a short film lost for nearly 90 years. This shows how AI can restore films with almost no surviving original footage, bringing them back to life.

Completed by an eight-person team at the iQIYI-XMU Joint Laboratory of Film Restoration in just two months, the project has recently been shortlisted for the "2026 Future Images AI Unit" at the 39th Golden Rooster Awards. The Golden Rooster Awards are among China's most prestigious film honors, underscoring the project's industry recognition.

The Challenge: Building a Movie Without Footage

Traditional film restoration typically relies on surviving film materials, using digital technologies to repair damage and enhance image quality. However, with the original 1938 release of "Visiting Shanghai after Sixty Years" – one of China's earliest science-fiction works, which used comedy to imagine life sixty years into the future – there was almost nothing left to repair. All physical prints, reels, and scripts had been lost over the decades. Instead, the team had to generate the film from scratch using only production still-photos, posters, and newspaper clippings as conceptual guides.

"NadouPro allowed us to step outside the conventional restoration mindset," said Zidong JIANG, Member of iQIYI-XMU Joint Laboratory and iQIYI's Director of AI Restoration Technology. "With no surviving film prints to restore, we used AI to undertake a creative reconstruction of the film based on available historical materials."

Building a film from the ground up highlighted two major complexities in generative video: maintaining character consistency across scenes and achieving precise camera control. The team utilized NadouPro to address both.

Maintaining Continuity Through Digital Assets

The film spans two distinct historical eras – 1938 and 1998 – and features multiple characters. In generative video, ensuring characters retain the same appearance across different shots is historically difficult.

NadouPro solved this by acting as a centralized production hub. Rather than generating characters anew for every scene, the team used the platform to lock in permanent digital assets for each character's facial features, proportions, and costumes upfront. Subsequent shots drew from these foundational files, keeping character appearances perfectly consistent throughout the film.

Enabling Directorial Control with 3D Director Studio

Recreating acting performances from still photos required high precision. Rather than relying on trial-and-error AI generation, the team used NadouPro's 3D Director Studio to precisely control character positioning, composition, and movement, supported by tools for exploring different scenes, visual styles, and camera angles.

This control ensured filmmakers led the creative direction. The 1938 sequences drew inspiration from early black-and-white cinema with stable cameras and vintage lighting, while the 1998 scenes adopted a documentary style with natural light and handheld camera movement.

"NadouPro helped us move from relatively random image generation toward shots with clear directorial intent," said Enji YANG, the Director of the new film. "In the early stage, we still followed traditional methods: script analysis, character design, scene design, and storyboard planning. We always believe the audiovisual design of a film must come first, before considering how AI can realize it."

Aigong ZHANG, Chief Planner of the new film and Director of the iQIYI-XMU Joint Laboratory, noted that the project demonstrates how AI can integrate into a professional workflow. "NadouPro shares something in common with the production of this short film: the organic integration of traditional filmmaking craftsmanship with AI."

Building on Years of AI Restoration Work

As one of the earliest long-form video platforms to invest in AI film restoration, iQIYI has been exploring the related technology since 2017. Its proprietary ZoomAI uses algorithms for scratch repair, super-resolution, noise reduction, and intelligent frame interpolation, helping shift restoration from manual frame-by-frame work toward automated processes.

Through its joint laboratory with Xiamen University, iQIYI has already brought a number of 4K classics back to screens. Building on this experience, iQIYI is now exploring new possibilities beyond traditional film restoration, using AI to creatively reconstruct and reimagine lost films based on surviving historical materials, bringing classic works back to audiences in new forms.

LOS ANGELES, Nov. 5, 2026 /PRNewswire/ --

"In a world of endless screens and AI-generated everything, the one thing that can't be replicated is being there. Artists are taking their music to more fans in more places than ever, and fans are showing up in record numbers. Through October, we've sold 170 million tickets, up 13% and already ahead of all of last year. We now expect to welcome nearly 180 million fans in 2026.

This quarter attendance grew 19%, and year-to-date, international markets surpassed the U.S. in both concert attendance and sponsorship revenue — a powerful sign of how global live music has become. We're investing in more venues around the world, giving artists more stages to build their careers and fans more opportunities to experience the magic of live music. With double-digit adjusted operating income (AOI) growth across all three segments this quarter, we're on track to deliver another record year and sustain double-digit growth for years to come." –Michael Rapino, President and CEO

ARTISTS REACH MORE FANS WORLDWIDE DRIVING A RECORD QUARTER (3Q26 vs. 3Q25 unless otherwise noted)

  • Revenue of $10.1 billion, up 19%
  • Operating income of $892 million, up 13%
  • AOI of $1.18 billion, up 14%
  • Global key operating metrics achieved new levels: 
    • Fan attendance of 61 million, up 19% 
    • Fee-bearing tickets of 98 million, up 10% and fee-bearing Gross Transaction Value (GTV) of $11.2 billion, up 13%
  • International markets drove global strength, including:
    • Fan attendance up 29%, accounting for 60% of total fan growth
    • Fee-bearing tickets up 20%, contributing 75% of total fee-bearing ticket growth
    • Sponsorship AOI up 12% as international sponsorship surpassed North America in operating income and AOI for the quarter
  • Ticket sales for 2026 shows up 13% to approximately 170 million through late October, already exceeding full-year 2025, with stadium, arena, and amphitheater fan count each up mid-teens or higher
  • Venue Nation attendance for the year now expected to exceed 75 million, up more than 15% year-over-year
  • Through Q3, ticketing GTV for primary tickets sold for 2027 shows up double-digits compared to same point last year, driven by double-digit growth in North America primary ticket volume

ARTISTS DRAW RECORD ATTENDANCE WORLDWIDE (3Q26 vs. 3Q25 unless otherwise noted)

  • Revenue of $8.7 billion, up 20%
  • AOI of $603 million, up 17%
  • Global fan attendance of 61 million, up 19%, reflecting broad-based demand across all regions and large venue types:
    • North America up 13% with stadiums and amphitheaters driving 90% of the growth
    • International up 29%, with all regions up at least 15%
    • Fan attendance at third-party stadiums up over 40%, accounting for more than half of global fan growth
  • Concerts remain a high consumer priority:
    • Ticket sales exceeded prior-year levels every month of 2026 through October
    • Ticket sales for the month of October up over 20%, reflecting strong show closings
    • September marked an all-time monthly high for amphitheater attendance and number of shows
    • Sell-through rates are ahead of last year while cancellation rates pace below year-to-date
  • Record Q3 event-related deferred revenue of $3.8 billion, up 8%
  • Prepaid advertising expense for 2027 shows up double-digits at the end of Q3
  • Fan attendance now expected to approach 180 million for the full year, delivering double-digit growth
  • Concerts on track to deliver double-digit AOI growth for the full year

VENUE NATION EXPANDS STAGES FOR ARTISTS WORLDWIDE AND ENHANCES FAN EXPERIENCES

  • Venue Nation hosted 26 million fans in Q3, up 17% and now expected to host over 75 million fans in 2026
    • Arenas outside the U.S. expected to deliver 75% of owned or operated fan growth at our large venues for the full year, with attendance now surpassing U.S. amphitheaters
  • Fans are choosing a range of experiences at our large U.S. amphitheaters, with upgrade purchases and VIP revenue per ticket up double-digits while value menu unit sales more than doubled
  • Similar strength internationally, with onsite spending at our European arenas up double-digits
  • On track to open or acquire 10 large (over 3,000 capacity) venues through the end of the year, which are expected to deliver over 5 million fans this year with a run-rate of nearly 8 million

INTERNATIONAL SPONSORSHIP SURPASSES NORTH AMERICA (3Q26 vs. 3Q25 unless otherwise noted)

  • Revenue of $506 million, up 14%
  • AOI of $350 million, up 12%
  • International markets, led by ticket access, venues, and festivals, contributed 65% of sponsorship revenue growth for the quarter
  • Sponsorship AOI on track to grow double-digits for the full year

DEMAND FOR ARTISTS' SHOWS DRIVES RECORD Q3 TICKETING RESULTS (3Q26 vs. 3Q25 unless otherwise noted)

  • Revenue of $870 million, up 9%
  • AOI of $316 million, up 10%
  • Record fee-bearing ticket volume of 98 million, up 10%
    • Concerts accounted for 95% of fee-bearing ticket growth, benefitting from successful early 2027 on sales
    • International markets contributed 75% of fee-bearing ticket growth
  • Secondary ticket GTV flat, with growth in sports offsetting lower concert resale activity, consistent with efforts to constrain scalper sales
  • Net new ticketing agreements added 23 million tickets, over 70% from international markets, expanding our ability to help artists and venues reach fans 
  • Full-year AOI growth is now expected to be up high single-digits

STRONG CASH GENERATION SUPPORTS INVESTMENT IN MORE STAGES FOR ARTISTS

  • Year-to-date operating cash flow of $2.1 billion, up 45% and free cash flow—adjusted of $1.6 billion, up 25% with AOI to free cash flow—adjusted conversion of 69%, up from 60% last year
  • Full-year AOI to free cash flow—adjusted conversion expected to exceed last year
  • Year-to-date capital expenditures total $722 million, on track for full-year spend of nearly $1.1 billion:
    • $800 million directed toward expanding and improving venues, giving artists more places to perform and fans better live experiences
    • Approximately $200 million from funding by joint-venture partners, sponsorship agreements, and other sources reduce venue cash requirements
    • Remainder to focus on ticketing and sponsorship growth initiatives, as well as ongoing maintenance requirements

BALANCE SHEET WELL-POSITIONED FOR CONTINUED VENUE INVESTMENT

  • October refinancing extended maturities to 2031, providing additional financial flexibility to fund venue expansion at an attractive cost of capital, while euro-denominated debt aligns with our growing international business
  • 80% of our debt is fixed-rate with a weighted average cost of debt of 4.3%

OTHER FINANCIAL STATEMENT DETAILS (vs. 2025)

  • Depreciation and amortization expected to grow 12–15%
  • Net interest expense is expected to be approximately $280 million
  • Corporate / Other and Eliminations expense expected to increase in line with AOI growth
  • Income tax expense is expected to be 15–20% of AOI
  • Since mid-year, full-year foreign exchange benefit reduced by approximately $20 million
  • Below-the-line items (full year):
    • Noncontrolling interest expense is expected to be approximately $325 million. This projection may be further impacted by mark-to-market revaluations of investments and will have no impact to earnings per share, as any impact will be offset in other income and expenses
    • Accretion expense is projected to be one-third of last year's, with continued strong performance at OCESA and other partners
  • 2026 share count not expected to change materially from 2025

Notice Regarding Financial Statements

The company has provided certain financial statements at the end of this press release for reference. These financial statements should be read in conjunction with the full financial statements, and the notes thereto, set forth in the company's Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 to be filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission today and available on the SEC's website at sec.gov.

About Live Nation Entertainment:

Live Nation Entertainment (NYSE: LYV) helps artists grow their careers through live music, promoting shows that connect them with fans around the world. Since 2005, we've connected artists with more than 1.5 billion fans across 55 countries. A live concert is more than a show — it's a moment fans wait all year for, travel for, and remember for a lifetime. Live Nation exists to make more of those moments possible, helping artists grow their careers and bringing more live music to more fans, everywhere. For more information, visit investors.livenationentertainment.com.

Forward-Looking Statements, Non-GAAP Financial Measures and Reconciliations:

Certain statements in this press release constitute "forward-looking statements" within the meaning of the Private Securities Litigation Reform Act of 1995. Such forward-looking statements include, but are not limited to statements regarding anticipated Concerts fan attendance in 2026; the company's being on track to deliver another record year in 2026 and sustain double-digit growth for years to come; expected adjusted operating income growth in the company's Concerts business for 2026; expectations for Venue Nation's fan count for 2026 and the anticipated contribution to this growth from arenas outside the U.S.; anticipated openings/acquisitions of large venues by the end of 2026, as well as the fan contribution and run-rates from these venues; anticipated adjusted operating income growth in the company's Sponsorship business for 2026; expected adjusted operating income growth in the company's Ticketmaster business for 2026; expectations for full-year adjusted operating income to free cash flow—adjusted conversion rates; the company's anticipated capital expenditures in 2026, including the planned allocation and source of these funds; the positioning of the company's balance sheet for continued venue investment; the company's full-year 2026 expectations for depreciation and amortization, net interest expense, Corporate / Other and Eliminations expense, income tax expense, foreign exchange impacts, noncontrolling interest expense, accretion expense, and share count.

Live Nation wishes to caution you that there are some known and unknown factors that could cause actual results to differ materially from any future results, performance or achievements expressed or implied by such forward-looking statements, including but not limited to operational challenges in achieving strategic objectives and executing on the company's plans, the risk that the company's markets do not evolve as anticipated, the potential impact of any economic slowdown and operational challenges associated with selling tickets and staging events.

You are cautioned not to place undue reliance on these forward-looking statements which speak only as of the date on which they are made. All subsequent written and oral forward-looking statements by or concerning Live Nation are expressly qualified in their entirety by the cautionary statements above. Live Nation does not undertake any obligation to publicly update or revise any forward-looking statements because of new information, future events or otherwise.

This press release contains certain non-GAAP financial measures as defined by SEC Regulation G. A reconciliation of each such measure to its most directly comparable GAAP financial measure, together with an explanation of why management believes that these non-GAAP financial measures provide useful information to investors, is provided herein.

Adjusted Operating Income (Loss), or AOI, is a non-GAAP financial measure that we define as operating income (loss) before certain acquisition expenses (including ongoing legal costs stemming from the Ticketmaster merger, changes in the fair value of accrued acquisition-related contingent consideration obligations, and acquisition-related severance and compensation), amortization of non-recoupable ticketing contract advances, depreciation and amortization (including goodwill impairment), loss (gain) on disposal of operating assets, and stock-based compensation expense. Due to the significant and non-recurring nature of the matters, we also exclude from AOI the impact of realized liabilities for settlements and expenses for regulatory compliance matters associated with the provision for losses arising from certain significant governmental investigations and litigations under ASC 450 - Contingencies, which are described under the heading "Governmental Investigations and Litigation" in Note 6 of the Notes to the Consolidated Financial Statements in our Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. Except as described above, ongoing legal costs associated with defense of these claims, such as attorney fees, are not excluded from AOI. We use AOI to evaluate the performance of our operating segments. We believe that information about AOI assists investors by allowing them to evaluate changes in the operating results of our portfolio of businesses separate from non-operational factors that affect net income (loss), thus providing insights into both operations and the other factors that affect reported results. AOI is not calculated or presented in accordance with GAAP. A limitation of the use of AOI as a performance measure is that it does not reflect the periodic costs of certain amortizing assets used in generating revenue in our business. Accordingly, AOI should be considered in addition to, and not as a substitute for, operating income (loss), net income (loss), and other measures of financial performance reported in accordance with GAAP. Furthermore, this measure may vary among other companies; thus, AOI as presented herein may not be comparable to similarly titled measures of other companies.

AOI margin is a non-GAAP financial measure that we calculate by dividing AOI by revenue. We use AOI margin to evaluate the performance of our operating segments. We believe that information about AOI margin assists investors by allowing them to evaluate changes in the operating results of our portfolio of businesses separate from non-operational factors that affect net income (loss), thus providing insights into both operations and the other factors that affect reported results. AOI margin is not calculated or presented in accordance with GAAP. A limitation of the use of AOI margin as a performance measure is that it does not reflect the periodic costs of certain amortizing assets used in generating revenue in our business. Accordingly, AOI margin should be considered in addition to, and not as a substitute for, operating income (loss) margin, and other measures of financial performance reported in accordance with GAAP. Furthermore, this measure may vary among other companies; thus, AOI margin as presented herein may not be comparable to similarly titled measures of other companies.

Constant Currency is a non-GAAP financial measure when applied to a GAAP financial measure. We calculate currency impacts as the difference between current period activity translated using the current period's currency exchange rates and the comparable prior period's currency exchange rates. We present constant currency information to provide a framework for assessing how our underlying businesses performed excluding the effect of foreign currency rate fluctuations.

Free Cash Flow — Adjusted, or FCF, is a non-GAAP financial measure that we define as net cash provided by (used in) operating activities less changes in operating assets and liabilities, less maintenance capital expenditures, less distributions to noncontrolling interest partners. We use FCF among other measures, to evaluate the ability of operations to generate cash that is available for purposes other than maintenance capital expenditures. We believe that information about FCF provides investors with an important perspective on the cash available to service debt, make acquisitions, and for revenue generating capital expenditures. FCF is not calculated or presented in accordance with GAAP. A limitation of the use of FCF as a performance measure is that it does not necessarily represent funds available for operations and is not necessarily a measure of our ability to fund our cash needs. Accordingly, FCF should be considered in addition to, and not as a substitute for, net cash provided by (used in) operating activities and other measures of financial performance reported in accordance with GAAP. Furthermore, this measure may vary among other companies; thus, FCF as presented herein may not be comparable to similarly titled measures of other companies.

Free Cash is a non-GAAP financial measure that we define as cash and cash equivalents less ticketing-related client funds, less event-related deferred revenue, less accrued expenses due to artists and cash collected on behalf of others, plus event-related prepaids. We use free cash as a proxy for how much cash we have available to, among other things, optionally repay debt balances, make acquisitions and fund revenue generating capital expenditures. Free cash is not calculated or presented in accordance with GAAP. A limitation of the use of free cash as a performance measure is that it does not necessarily represent funds available from operations and it is not necessarily a measure of our ability to fund our cash needs. Accordingly, free cash should be considered in addition to, and not as a substitute for, cash and cash equivalents and other measures of financial performance reported in accordance with GAAP. Furthermore, this measure may vary among other companies; thus, free cash as presented herein may not be comparable to similarly titled measures of other companies.

releases.body:
Writer-Director Jimmy Jenkins and Star Ashley Olivia Fisher Head to the HBCU First LOOK Film Festival This Saturday, November 7

LOS ANGELES, Nov. 5, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Audiences have made it clear this year: when a film speaks to them, they show up. They showed up for BACKROOMS. They showed up for OBSESSION. Next up is GOD WITH US. More than 4,000 people packed the film's premiere last Saturday serviced out of Los Angeles, CA , and the modern-day parable from writer-director Jimmy Jenkins opens in select theatres nationwide on Friday, November 13, from Blue Harbor Entertainment and Variance Films.

Before opening day, Jenkins joins the HBCU First LOOK Film Festival this Saturday, November 7, at Howard University for the "GOD WITH US" Clips & Conversation (4:00–4:50 PM), sponsored by Black Girl Vitamins. Jenkins and HBCU alumna Ashley Olivia Fisher will share never-before-seen clips in a conversation moderated by Jawn Murray (Norfolk State University), plus a special surprise guest and audience Q&A.

WHAT: GOD WITH US limited theatrical release, plus filmmaker appearance at the HBCU First LOOK Film Festival

WHEN:

  • Saturday, November 7: "GOD WITH US" Clips & Conversation with Jimmy Jenkins and Ashley Olivia Fisher, 4:00–4:50 PM, HBCU First LOOK Film & TV Festival
  • Friday, November 13: In select theatres nationwide
  • Thursday, November 19: Los Angeles press junket with filmmaker and cast

WHERE: HBCU First LOOK Film & TV Festival, Armour J. Blackburn University Center, Howard University, 2397 6th Street NW, Washington, D.C. Festival tickets: https://events.eventnoire.com/e/hbcu-first-look-film-festival-2026. GOD WITH US in select theatres nationwide; tickets: https://www.atomtickets.com/movies/god-with-us/404259

WHO: Written and directed by Jimmy Jenkins (SINNERS WANTED). Starring Ashley Olivia Fisher (AVERAGE JOE), Aspen Kennedy (THE FORGE), Rotimi (COMING 2 AMERICA), Roger Guenveur Smith (DO THE RIGHT THING), Ashley Rios (CROSS), Gregory Alan Williams (REMEMBER THE TITANS), Clifton Powell (RAY) and Lil Rel Howery (GET OUT).

ABOUT THE FILM: A young woman in an impossible position. A young man torn between trust and faith. A birth that could change the world. GOD WITH US follows inner-city childhood sweethearts Mary Anne Thomas and Joseph "Junie" Love as they embark on a divine mission. A gripping drama with heart, humor and soul, the film explores grace, growth and the power of unconditional love.

MEDIA ASSETS: Film details, cast info and campaign assets: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1iE0suXZ85Tsk158s_bEU7pDZGjd3notZe7OU5IBK90Y/edit?usp=sharing

Trailer: godwithusmovie.com • Instagram: @godwithusmovie • #GodWithUsMovie #GodWithUs2026

releases.title: ASCAP PARTNERS WITH PROJECT HEALTHY MINDS TO CONNECT MUSIC CREATORS WITH BROAD ARRAY OF MENTAL HEALTH SERVICES
releases.body:
New ASCAP Member Benefit Offers Private, Intuitive Discovery of Mental Health Providers

Cheryl "Salt" James (Salt-N-Pepa) and MILCK Join ASCAP's Nick Lehman for "The Empathy Bridge: A Creator-to-Executive Conversation" at jump.global Summit, Tuesday, Nov. 10

NEW YORK, Nov. 5, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The American Society of Composers, Authors and Publishers (ASCAP) today announced a major expansion of its industry-leading Wellness Program, launched in 2019, with a new mental health member benefit in collaboration with Project Healthy Minds, the leading mental health tech nonprofit dedicated to expanding access to mental health services across the United States. The initiative provides ASCAP songwriter, composer and music publisher members with confidential access to a comprehensive ecosystem of mental health services, therapy options and wellness tools to support creators at every stage of their careers.

ASCAP made history in 2019 as the first PRO to launch a dedicated wellness initiative for music creators.

Project Healthy Minds developed an intuitive discovery platform that connects individuals with a diverse range of mental health services. Through this new, first-of-its-kind PRO partnership, ASCAP members will have curated access to the platform and can privately connect with mental health service providers. Available services include:

Care Category

Services

Delivery Model

Clinical Care

Therapy and psychiatry

Confidential virtual and in-person consultations

Community Support

Peer-led and expert-moderated support groups

Safe group settings for shared creator experiences

Daily Wellness

Self-care apps and digital tools

On-demand mindfulness, meditation and habit tracking

The announcement coincides with the jump.global Summit in Los Angeles, where Grammy winning artist and Rock & Roll Hall of Fame Inductee Cheryl "Salt" James of multi-platinum hip-hop trio Salt-N-Pepa and Billboard #1 Protest Songwriter and Elle UK's woman of hope, MILCK, aka Connie K Lim, will take the stage alongside ASCAP Executive Vice President and Chief Strategy & Digital Officer Nick Lehman on Tuesday, November 10, for "The Empathy Bridge: A Creator-to-Executive Conversation." In the session, Lehman and these two ASCAP members will explore ways for the music business to foster deeper empathy, bridge the divide between the creative and commercial sides of music, and prioritize creator well-being.

Over this weekend, in another intersection of wellness and music, ASCAP will bring members and staff to participate in the Diplo Run Club 5K at Los Angeles State Historic Park on November 8. ASCAP members can receive a 10% discount on the entry fee. Details are available at www.ascap.com/wellness.

Music creators encounter unique career pressures, from financial volatility and rigorous touring schedules to creative isolation. Because songwriting and composing rarely come with traditional employer benefits, ASCAP made history in 2019 as the first PRO to launch a dedicated wellness initiative. Today's collaboration with Project Healthy Minds builds on that momentum, following the successful rollout of a telehealth member benefit through MD Live for 24/7 urgent care consultations, plus dermatology and additional health care services.

"Creativity thrives when creators are supported - in mind, body, and spirit," said Lehman. "Music creators put their everything into the music we love, yet trying to find quality, affordable support shouldn't feel like everything is stacked against them in an opaque healthcare system. By teaming up with Project Healthy Minds, we are delivering direct access to vetted care - removing friction so our members get meaningful support, whenever and however they need it."

"Songwriters have helped millions of people feel less alone, and this partnership makes sure they have that same support in return. We are thrilled to give ASCAP's members a simple way to find care, whether that's a therapist, a support group or a tool they can use on the road," said Phillip Schermer, Founder and CEO of Project Healthy Minds.

The partnership expands ASCAP's wellness benefits, which also include discounts and perks through partners such as Aaptiv, Daily Burn, BetterHelp and Paramount Rx, alongside telemedicine through MD Live.

How to Access the Benefit

All current ASCAP writer and publisher members can immediately take advantage of the new benefit at no additional cost. Members simply log into the ASCAP Member Access portal to access a unique landing page on Project Healthy Minds' site. From there they can browse available mental health services, take personalized assessments and connect directly with care providers.

About ASCAP

The American Society of Composers, Authors and Publishers (ASCAP) is a membership association of more than 1.1 million songwriters, composers and music publishers, and represents some of the world's most talented music creators. Founded and governed by songwriters, composers and publishers, it returns nearly 90 cents of every dollar collected to its members as royalties and has the lowest overhead rate of any U.S. PRO.  In 2025, ASCAP reported record-high financial results of $1.945 billion in revenues and $1.759 billion available in royalty distribution monies to its members. Over the last ten years, ASCAP has delivered a 6.7% compound annual growth rate for total revenues, and a 7.3% compound annual growth rate for total royalty distributions to members. ASCAP licenses a repertory of over 20 million musical works to hundreds of thousands of businesses that use music, including streaming services, cable television, radio and satellite radio and brick and mortar businesses such as retail stores, hotels, clubs, restaurants and bars. ASCAP collects the licensing fees, and identifies, matches, processes and pays royalties to its members for trillions of performances every year. The ASCAP blanket license offers an efficient solution for businesses to legally perform ASCAP music while respecting the right of songwriters and composers to be paid fairly. ASCAP puts music creators first, advocating for their rights and the value of music on Capitol Hill, driving innovation that moves the industry forward, building community and providing the resources and support that creators need to succeed in their careers. Learn more and stay in touch at www.ascap.com, on X and Instagram @ASCAP and on Facebook.

About Project Healthy Minds

Project Healthy Minds is a Millennial & Gen Z-driven mental health tech nonprofit dedicated to expanding access to mental health services across the United States for every community. Project Healthy Minds focuses on three programmatic areas: (1) destigmatizing mental health by mobilizing culture-makers; (2) expanding access to mental health services through the world's first free digital mental health marketplace; and (3) advocating for innovative workplace investments in employee mental health. Project Healthy Minds' programmatic initiatives have served more than 500,000 people. For more information, visit www.projecthealthyminds.com.

releases.title: Kibbles 'n Bits Just Dropped an Action Movie Trailer. The Stars? Dogs.
releases.body:
Dogs will do anything for the bits. Now, Kibbles 'n Bits is turning that obsession into Hollywood-style action, complete with the return of its iconic jingle for the first time in more than 20 years

LAKEVILLE, Minn., Nov. 5, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Some dogs sit. Some dogs stay. These dogs will do anything for the bits.

Kibbles 'n Bits™ just dropped a short action film trailer starring dogs. Yes, actual dogs. Humans are welcome to watch, too, but this one's for the four-legged crowd. And if you think your dog goes a little crazy for their favorite food, just wait until you see what these dogs are willing to do for the bits.

We're talking big-screen drama, wild plot twists and some seriously questionable decisions. Because dogs don't just love the bits. They live for them. And can you blame them? With a delicious combination of crunchy kibble and chewy, crave-worthy bits in a variety of shapes and flavors, Kibbles 'n Bits gives dogs plenty to obsess over. Plus, it delivers complete and balanced nutrition, so pet parents can feel good about what's in their bowl.

They'll sit for the bits. Stay for the bits. Speak for the bits. Heck, they'll dress up like a taco, act like a baby or find themselves on the wrong side of the law for the bits. And that's just scratching the surface.

Hollywood, But Make It Dog-Friendly

Inspired by the larger-than-life movies of the late '90s and early 2000s, the [:45] trailer, titled The Heist, gives classic Hollywood storytelling a ridiculous, dog-approved twist. Think high-stakes action, over-the-top suspense and a cast of four-legged stars with one thing on their minds: getting their paws on the bits.

When the trailer opens, we see a seasoned crew of dogs look to make one final score and get their paws on some Kibbles 'n Bits. They crave the bits so much they're willing to risk it all.

And Kibbles 'n Bits didn't just borrow Hollywood's biggest plotlines. The trailer brings together the nostalgic charm of the brand's original commercials with the bold, cinematic look of the late '90s and early 2000s. Think high-contrast lighting, vibrant color grading and stylized visuals that give every scene its own larger-than-life personality.

For humans, it's a nostalgic throwback to the blockbuster era. For dogs, it's a front-row seat to a whole lot of action starring their fellow four-legged friends.

Because when the bits are involved, everything else comes second. Including good judgment.

"The idea was to take the way dogs crave Kibbles 'n Bits and treat it the same way characters in a heist movie crave whatever they're' after." said Joe Christenson, Director of Marketing at Post Consumer Brands. "We wanted to build that parallel between a dog's desire and the kind of obsession that drives a high-stakes heist. We leaned into the drama of it all, making sure it felt like a true heist movie, with the tension and cinematic flair you'd expect from the genre."

And that's not all! The trailer brings back a fan-favorite blast from the past: the iconic Kibbles 'n Bits jingle, making its long-awaited return for the first time in more than 20 years! This new version gives the beloved melody a modern twist.

The Trailer Is Just Act One

The short action film trailer marks the first act of "Do It for the Bits," a new campaign from Kibbles 'n Bits that takes dogs' craving for the bits to ridiculous new heights. Inspired by the idea that dogs will do absolutely anything for the bits, the campaign brings their obsession to life through playful movie parodies, over-the-top antics and a whole lot of four-legged mischief.

And the action doesn't stop when the trailer ends. Fans can follow along as the dogs' over-the-top antics continue across social media and influencer content. What will these dogs do next in their quest for the bits? Follow the action to KibblesnBits.com, where the final spot will be revealed and the heist comes to an end.

"At the heart of 'Do It for the Bits' is a simple insight: dogs will do just about anything for the bits they love," said Kathryn Budzien, Sr. Director, Creative & Studio Operations at Post Consumer Brands. "We wanted to take that truth and blow it up into something much bigger than a traditional dog food campaign. By putting dogs at the center of the storytelling and giving their obsession the Hollywood treatment, we're creating a playful world where anything can happen, all in the name of the bits. And the trailer is just the beginning."

And while the first act is playing out on-screen, the next one might be in real life.

Let's just say these dogs have big plans. And if there's one thing we've learned, it's that nothing gets between a dog and the bits.

Consider this your official warning: keep an eye on your dogs. And maybe your Kibbles 'n Bits.

Watch the short film trailer at https://www.kibblesnbits.com/do-it-for-the-bits/ and follow Kibbles 'n Bits on Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok to see what happens next. More information about the brand can be found at https://www.kibblesnbits.com/.

About Post Consumer Brands

Headquartered in Lakeville, Minn., Post Consumer Brands, a business unit of Post Holdings, Inc., is dedicated to providing people and their pets with delicious food choices for every taste and budget. The company's portfolio includes beloved brands such as Honey Bunches of Oats™, PEBBLES™, Grape-Nuts™ and Malt-O-Meal™ cereal and Peter Pan™ peanut butter, as well as Rachael Ray® Nutrish™, Kibbles 'n Bits™ and 9Lives™ dog and cat food. Post also provides private label solutions to customers in pet food, cereal, nut butters and granola. As a company committed to high standards of quality and to our values, we are driven by one idea: To make lives better by making delicious food accessible for all. For more information about our brands, visit www.postconsumerbrands.com and follow us on LinkedIn or Facebook for the latest news.

HoneymoonPostPet@wearehoneymoon.com

VALPARAISO, Ind., Nov. 5, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Pipit, a new independent-only music platform, officially opened to music fans today, challenging traditional streaming with a catalog that excludes generative-AI-created music and a discovery experience controlled by fans rather than black-box algorithms.
releases.title: Pipit Launches Music Platform Where "The Fan Becomes the Algorithm"
releases.body:
Built exclusively for human independent artists, Pipit introduces customizable subscription models and direct-to-artist monthly funding

VALPARAISO, Ind., Nov. 5, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Pipit, a new independent-only music platform, officially opened to music fans today, challenging traditional streaming with a catalog that excludes generative-AI-created music and a discovery experience controlled by fans rather than black-box algorithms.

Unlike mainstream platforms that rely on passive listening and massive major-label catalogs, Pipit is designed specifically for intentional music discovery. Through customizable subscriptions starting at $3.99 a month, fans use nine distinct musical categories to build their own "Discover Waves" and choose exactly which independent artists receive their financial support.

At Pipit, fans do more than press play. They decide what music they want to discover, which human creators they want to back, and where the artist-support portion of their monthly membership goes.

Join for $3.99 and Support an Artist You Love

Pipit's Support membership starts at $3.99 per month. Fans choose an independent artist they want to support, and $2 of that monthly membership goes directly to that artist. During the paid month, supporters can stream that artist's catalog on Pipit as part of the relationship.

Beyond direct fan support, artists also earn $0.005 for every qualifying discovery stream through Pipit's discovery memberships. Streams of an artist's catalog by fans currently supporting that artist are included in their Support membership and do not generate additional per-stream royalties.

Each month, fans stay in control. They can keep supporting the same artist, or move their $2 monthly support to another artist they want to back. The model gives fans a simple way to turn listening into meaningful recurring support while giving independent artists a more predictable connection to the audiences they have already built.

"As a songwriter and artist, I really appreciate Pipit's business model and how it puts the artist first," said Brandon Maddox, Grammy-nominated, award-winning songwriter, artist and performer. "The support and customer service also showed me they're focused on creating a great artist experience."

Fans Choose What Their Subscription Includes (and Skip the "Music Wallpaper")

Pipit also offers custom memberships that let fans shape their monthly experience. Fans can choose how many Feathers, Pipit's $1 credits for supporting independent artists, they want included each month, from $2 to $8, and direct them to artists they discover and enjoy. Rather than paying into a subscription with little visibility into where the money ultimately goes, Pipit lets fans direct a portion of their membership.

Fans also choose their monthly discovery/streaming time instead of paying for unlimited listening they may never use. Pipit is designed around intentional music discovery, not hours of passive "music wallpaper." By aligning streaming costs with the way fans actually listen, Pipit can offer lower-priced, more personalized subscriptions while keeping the focus on discovering and supporting independent artists.

Discover Wave: The Fan Becomes the Algorithm

Pipit's Discover Wave gives listeners direct control over music discovery. Pipit defines every song across nine musical categories: Genre, Flow/Journey, Mood, Sound, Vocals, Lyrics, Tempo, Studio/Production, and Region. Fans use those same categories to create their own Discover Waves.

Instead of receiving a black-box recommendation telling them what to hear next, listeners decide what matters and shape the discovery experience themselves. The fan becomes the algorithm. As new independent music is added to Pipit, songs that match a fan's existing Discover Wave can enter that discovery experience over time, keeping it fresh without taking control away from the listener.

Find Artists You Connect with Beyond the Music

Pipit's Backstage Pass helps fans & artists discover each other based on more than sound alone. Artists and fans answer a series of questions about their interests, personality, and relationship with music. Pipit then creates a compatibility percentage match without revealing either person's individual answers.

"I was attracted to Pipit because it felt like a game changer," said Elijah Beckham, who performs as Edubb302, an independent hip-hop artist from Wilmington, Delaware. "It's a place built around discovering and sharing music while also connecting artists and fans. I think it can create more exposure, opportunity, partnerships, and collaborations for independent artists."

Discover on Pipit. Listen and Connect Wherever You Go.

Alongside its fan launch, Pipit is introducing Pipit: Discover Indie Music, a companion mobile app for iPhone and Android that brings independent music discovery and artist connections to fans wherever they go.

Pipit Player also brings the Social Feed to mobile, letting fans follow artist updates, view photos and videos, and like and comment on posts to stay connected with the artists behind the music.

No Major Labels. No Generative-AI Music.

Pipit is built exclusively around independent human artists, with no major-label artists or generative-AI-created music competing for fans' attention.

"Pipit is about giving the fan a more active role," said Ray Shingler, co-founder of Pipit. "You choose what you want to discover and which artists you want to support, while connecting with the people behind the music instead of having the entire experience decided for you."

Fans can join Pipit at indiepipit.com.

About Pipit, Inc.

Pipit, Inc. is a five-person technology company building an independent-only music platform centered on fan-driven discovery, direct artist support, and stronger artist-to-fan relationships. Pipit combines modern technology with the curiosity and participation of old-school music discovery, giving listeners greater control over what they hear while creating new ways for independent artists to build sustainable relationships with fans.

releases.title: United Customers Can Now Stream Their Favorite Music, Podcasts and Videos from Their Spotify Accounts on Starlink-Enabled Seatback Screens
releases.body:
United is the first airline to allow passengers to log in and stream their personal Spotify content on seatback screens; customers can watch video podcasts, live performances and music videos, or listen to music and audiobooks, right where they left off

United's new functionality lets Spotify users watch and listen to popular artists and titles like On Purpose with Jay Shetty and To All the Boys I've Loved Before: Full Cast Graphic Adaptation by Jenny Han on the seatback screen from their own Spotify account, just as they would at home or on the go

Spotify rollout will expand across half of United's fleet by next spring; airline is advancing inflight innovation as it expects to offer 219,000 seatback screens by the end of 2027 and complete fleetwide Starlink installation before the end of 2027

CHICAGO, Nov. 5, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- United and Spotify today announced a first-of-its-kind way for travelers to enjoy their favorite Spotify content in the sky: streaming directly from their personal Spotify account on the seatback screen. Customers can scan a QR code to securely log in to access the full Spotify catalog, including over 100 million tracks, along with millions of podcasts, playlists, videos and albums directly from their screens*. Passengers can pick up their favorite content right where they left off and save new favorites to enjoy long after their flight.

United is the first airline to let customers access their own Spotify account directly from a seatback screen, creating a more personal and connected entertainment experience built around the content they love. Powered by Starlink Wi-Fi, the integration allows travelers to watch performance videos like To All the Boys I've Loved Before: Full Cast Graphic Adaptation by Jenny Han and On Purpose with Jay Shetty – streamed directly from their own Spotify account. Once logged in, customers can access their personalized recommendations, playlists and saved content, and discover new recommendations tailored specifically to their listening and viewing habits, delivering a seamless listening experience that moves with them wherever they travel.

"Our customers are used to streaming entertainment that's tailored to them, and that level of personalization shouldn't stop when they board one of our planes," said Andrew Nocella, Chief Commercial Officer at United Airlines. "Now, thanks to Starlink, they can watch and listen to their own Spotify content right on their seatback screen and pick up their favorites right where they left off. From video podcasts and live performances to music and audiobooks, our collaboration with Spotify gives customers more of what they love onboard and is helping us create an elevated experience for everyone who chooses to fly United." 

"Bringing personal Spotify accounts to United seatback screens is a major milestone, creating a new way to experience Spotify in flight," said Ian Geller, VP of Business Development at Spotify. "With a quick QR code scan, passengers can bring their personalized Spotify experience to the screen in front of them — their recommendations, saved library, and favorite songs, podcasts, audiobooks, and videos — and enjoy it all on a big screen at 35,000 feet."

United introduced an exclusive collection of Spotify content on its seatback screens in June 2025, including more than 450 hours of audiobooks, video podcasts and music playlists. Since then, more than 2.3 million customers have enjoyed more than 1.9 million hours of Spotify content onboard. This new functionality builds on that by giving customers access to their personal Spotify account – from their saved playlists to tailored recommendations and more – directly from the seatback screen. The launch of the Spotify app integration builds on United's continued investment in personalization and the inflight experience.

United continues to invest in the inflight entertainment experience, in addition to Spotify, the airline gives customers access to more than 2,500 hours of premium entertainment content including Apple TV, HBO Max, A24 and Peacock. 

United is also elevating the onboard experience with Starlink. Starlink Wi-Fi is now available on more than half of United's daily flights and enables MileagePlus® members to stream, work, shop and stay connected across multiple devices in the air. The airline expects to complete Starlink installations by the end of 2027, bringing a faster, more connected and increasingly personalized experience to more customers. In addition, United currently offers more than 181,000 seatback screens across its fleet – more than any other major U.S. airline and about 85% of its mainline fleet – and expects to have more than 219,000 screens, nearly its entire mainline fleet, by the end of 2027.

How It Works

Customers on eligible flights can open the Spotify app from the seatback screen and scan the displayed QR code with their phone's camera. If already logged in to Spotify on their phone, their account pairs seamlessly with the seatback screen through a single-click verification. If not, they can log in securely on their phone and their personal library will appear on the seatback screen, allowing them to:

  • Resume music, videos, audiobooks and playlists where they left off and control playback
  • Browse their library and personalized recommendations
  • Save new favorites to their library
  • Enjoy Spotify directly on the seatback screen, bringing them even more of the content they love
  • Optionally use their phone as a companion remote, allowing them to browse, select titles and adjust playback right from their seat without leaning forward to touch the screen

Customers may log out at any time during the flight and will be automatically logged out of their Spotify account at the end of the flight.

*Available content and features vary by Spotify plan and market.

About United

At United, Good Leads The Way. With U.S. hubs in Chicago, Denver, Houston, Los Angeles, New York/Newark, San Francisco and Washington, D.C., United operates the most comprehensive global route network among North American carriers and is now the largest airline in the world as measured by available seat miles. For more about how to join the United team, please visit www.united.com/careers and more information about the company is at www.united.com. United Airlines Holdings, Inc., the parent company of United Airlines, Inc., is traded on the Nasdaq under the symbol "UAL"

releases.title: AWARD-WINNING "AUSTIN'S MUSIC SCENE" PUTS WORKING MUSICIANS IN THE SPOTLIGHT AT TEXAS BOOK FESTIVAL
releases.body:
Thunderhouse Media Group founder and editor in chief Mitch Baranowski joins HAAM CEO Paul Scott to discuss what makes Austin the "Live Music Capital of the World" and the challenges still facing its venues and working musicians.

Winner of three 2026 IBPA Book Awards, including Best Gift Book, with half of all net proceeds benefiting the Health Alliance for Austin Musicians.

AUSTIN, Texas, Nov. 4, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- "Austin's Music Scene: Your Guide to the City's Most Iconic Artists & Venues," the coffee table book that took home three 2026 IBPA Book Awards, is coming to the 31st annual Texas Book Festival on Nov. 14–15. Thunderhouse Media Group will exhibit the book throughout the weekend, and founder and editor in chief Mitch Baranowski will appear at the Saturday night Lit Crawl and on a Sunday festival panel.

Throughout the festival, the book will be available at Exhibitor Tent 6 on Congress Avenue, open Saturday from 10 a.m. to 5 p.m. and Sunday from 11 a.m. to 5 p.m.

On Saturday, Nov. 14, Baranowski will tell a true story at Austin Bat Cave's Story Department, a Moth-style storytelling session that is part of Lit Crawl Austin. The session runs from 7 to 8 p.m. at The Side Bar (602 E. Seventh St.) on the theme "Do You Believe in Magic?" Lit Crawl is free and open to the public; guests must be 21 or older.

On Sunday, Nov. 15, Baranowski will join Paul Scott, CEO of the Health Alliance for Austin Musicians (HAAM), for "Your Guide to the Austin Music Scene," from 11:30 a.m. to 12:15 p.m. at the Texas State Library and Archives Commission (1201 Brazos St.). The conversation will explore what makes Austin the "Live Music Capital of the World," including the challenges facing artists and venues today. Following an audience Q&A, Baranowski will sign books at 12:30 p.m. at the festival's book signing tent.

"This book is a love letter to the scene today, written from a fan's point of view," said Baranowski, who fell in love with live music while attending journalism school at the University of Texas at Austin. "It gives you a real snapshot of how diverse and resilient the local music scene is, and it tries to explode the myth that there is just one scene. The reality is, there isn't just one Austin music scene. Scenes are personal, and your scene is not my scene, but the city holds space for all this great music, which is why it's world-famous."

Baranowski developed the book in partnership with HAAM, whose mission is to provide access to healthcare for working musicians, DJs and music teachers across Central Texas. Half of the book's net proceeds go to HAAM.

"If a musician isn't healthy, they can't play. Their livelihood is affected, and our scene suffers," Scott said. "We'll talk with Mitch about what makes the scene so diverse and resilient, and why it needs our continued support to thrive in the years ahead. We're proud to help bring this conversation to the Texas Book Festival."

"Austin's Music Scene" took top honors at the 2026 IBPA Book Awards, including Best First Book (Nonfiction) and Best Gift Book. Billed as the first coffee table book to celebrate the artists, venues and events shaping the city's music scene today, it features more than 160 artist profiles, histories of iconic venues, hand-drawn maps and vibrant photography, and is designed for longtime locals and first-time visitors alike.

Where to find "Austin's Music Scene" during the festival

Sat., Nov. 14, 10 a.m.–5 p.m.: Book sales at Exhibitor Tent 6, Congress Avenue

Sat., Nov. 14, 7–8 p.m.: Lit Crawl: Austin Bat Cave's Story Department (free, 21+), The Side Bar, 602 E. Seventh St.

Sun., Nov. 15, 11 a.m.–5 p.m.: Book sales at Exhibitor Tent 6, Congress Avenue

Sun., Nov. 15, 11:30 a.m.–12:15 p.m.: Panel: "Your Guide to the Austin Music Scene," with Mitch Baranowski and HAAM CEO Paul Scott, Texas State Library and Archives Commission, 1201 Brazos St.

Sun., Nov. 15, 12:30 p.m.: Book signing at the festival book signing tent

About Thunderhouse Media Group

Based in Austin, Texas, Thunderhouse is a mission-driven media company dedicated to stories of true grit. Its first title, "Austin's Music Scene: Your Guide to the City's Most Iconic Artists & Venues" (ISBN 979-8-9991381-0-1), is available at Amazon, thunderhouse.co and more than 25 stores across Central Texas. Follow along on Instagram at @howdythunderhouse.

About Health Alliance for Austin Musicians

Since 2005, the Health Alliance for Austin Musicians has provided access to affordable healthcare for the hardworking, low-income musicians who make Austin the Live Music Capital of the World. HAAM connects professional musicians, DJs and music teachers and their families with care through a network of doctors, dentists, mental health professionals and other providers who give their time and talents at reduced rates. For more information, visit myhaam.org.

About the Texas Book Festival

The Texas Book Festival, the largest book event in the state and one of the premier book festivals in the country, returns to downtown Austin on Nov. 14–15. Free and open to all, the festival features more than 280 authors, panel discussions, book signings, food trucks, an exhibitor marketplace and the Saturday night Lit Crawl. Learn more at texasbookfestival.org.

David Duong's remarkable journey from Vietnamese boat refugee to American entrepreneur earns two honors in San Francisco, the city where his family began rebuilding their lives nearly five decades ago.

OAKLAND, Calif., Nov. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The King of Trash, a documentary chronicling Vietnamese American entrepreneur David Duong's remarkable journey from a refugee of the Vietnam War to the founder of a successful American recycling company, won Best Documentary and Best People Choice Film at the 13th San Francisco International New Concept Film Festival.
