releases.body:
Tickets are now on sale for Man In Motion: The Rick Hansen Story at Cineplex theatres from coast to coast, November 1 and 3, an intimate look at his historic journey through never-before-seen footage and Rick Hansen's private audio diaries.

VANCOUVER, BC, Oct. 30, 2026 /CNW/ -- Network Media Group Inc. and Network Entertainment Inc. (TSXV: NTE) (OTC: NETWF) ("Network" or the "Company") are pleased to announce that Man In Motion: The Rick Hansen Story, a feature documentary produced by Derik Murray and Ryan Reynolds, in association with Maximum Effort, will be released in selected Cineplex theatres across Canada on November 1 and 3. Tickets are now on sale.

Following its World Premiere at the Toronto International Film Festival (TIFF), where it received an honourable mention for Best Canadian Feature Film, and its hometown premiere at the Vancouver International Film Festival (VIFF), the documentary chronicles a defining journey in Canadian history and a mission that continues four decades later.

Forty years after Rick Hansen wheeled more than 40,000 kilometres through 34 countries and changed perceptions of people with disabilities worldwide, the story behind the Man In Motion World Tour comes to the big screen, told for the first time in Hansen's own voice from the road.

Directed by Network's Adrian Buitenhuis, the film draws on rare archival footage and never-before-heard audio tapes Hansen recorded during the Tour.

"The Man In Motion World Tour was one of the most significant memories from my childhood. To have the opportunity to revisit Rick and his team's remarkable journey through an incredible collection of personal footage and recordings is truly an honour," said Adrian Buitenhuis. "My hope is that the film sheds new light on the Tour's extraordinary accomplishments and on all that Rick and the Foundation continue to achieve today."

"We're excited to partner with Cineplex and Blue Ice Docs to bring Man In Motion: The Rick Hansen Story to audiences across Canada," said Derik Murray, Network's Founder and CEO. "Rick's journey is one of the most extraordinary stories in Canadian history, with an impact that continues 40 years later. We're proud to bring this story to the big screen and look forward to sharing more about our distribution plans in the coming weeks."

About Network Entertainment

Network Media Group is the parent company of Network Entertainment Inc.

Network Entertainment is a proudly Canadian, creatively driven production company based in Vancouver, B.C., creating, financing and producing award-winning film, television and digital content for audiences around the world.

Network has earned international recognition for productions including Facing Ali, which was shortlisted for an Academy Award for Best Feature Documentary; SIDNEY, which premiered at the Toronto International Film Festival in 2022 before its global release on Apple TV+; BRATS, directed by original Brat Pack member Andrew McCarthy, which premiered at the Tribeca Festival in June 2024 before debuting at No. 1 on Hulu; and Sly Lives! (aka The Burden of Black Genius), directed by Academy Award winner Ahmir "Questlove" Thompson, which premiered at the Sundance Film Festival in 2025, received a Peabody Award in the Arts category and was nominated for an Emmy Award.

Recent and upcoming productions include Man In Motion: The Rick Hansen Story; Jimi Hendrix, directed by acclaimed filmmaker Bao Nguyen in collaboration with Janie Hendrix, Experience Hendrix and Double Agent; and Bernie Taupin: Timeless Flight – Life, Music, Elton and Me, directed by Matthew Miele.

For additional information, visit www.networkentertainment.ca.

About Maximum Effort

Maximum Effort makes movies, TV series, content and cocktails for the personal amusement of Hollywood star Ryan Reynolds. The company occasionally shares them with the general public. Its productions include the Deadpool films, Free Guy, The Adam Project and Welcome to Wrexham.

About the Rick Hansen Foundation

A legacy of Rick Hansen's Man In Motion World Tour more than 40 years ago, the Rick Hansen Foundation (RHF) is a registered charity working to remove barriers and accelerate a global movement toward an accessible, inclusive and healthy world. The Foundation brings people and organizations together to turn innovative ideas into real-world solutions, continuing Rick's dream of a world without barriers for everyone, everywhere.

For more information, visit www.rickhansen.com.

SOURCE Network Media Group Inc.

releases.title: CRTC launches new database to make it easier to identify Canadian music
releases.body:
GATINEAU, QC, Oct. 29, 2026 /CNW/ -- The CRTC is launching a free, downloadable music database that makes it easier for broadcasters, artists and the public to identify Canadian music.

For the first time, information that broadcasters use to identify Canadian music is available in one place. The database brings together information previously spread across several industry sources, making it easier for Canadian artists to be discovered and played across the country.

This will also help radio stations identify and promote music that counts toward their Canadian content requirements.

The initial release includes a large selection of popular Canadian songs. New releases and older songs will be added regularly to the database including additional French, Indigenous, and third-language music. As part of the initial phase, the CRTC welcomes feedback from users to help improve the database and ensure it continues to meet the needs of broadcasters, artists, and the public.

Quick facts

  • The CRTC is an independent quasi-judicial tribunal that regulates the Canadian communications sector in the public interest. The CRTC holds public consultations on telecommunications and broadcasting matters and makes decisions based on the public record.
  • The CRTC's new database modernizes how Canadian content is identified, making it easier and faster for broadcasters to find and play Canadian music.
  • The CRTC is continuing to provide tools, reduce administrative burden, and modernize the broadcasting framework for radio stations. This includes the CRTC recently removing the requirement for radio stations to renew their licences every few years.

releases.title: Sonilo and Musical AI Partner to Ensure AI Music Empowers Creators and Rewards Rights Holders
releases.body:
SAN FRANCISCO, Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Sonilo, the generative audio company building video-native music and sound models, announced on October 27 a partnership with Musical AI, a leading AI music attribution and rights management technology, to address one of the music industry's biggest challenges of ensuring that artists, songwriters, and rights holders are attributed as AI-generated music becomes increasingly mainstream.

The partnership comes as the music industry grapples with how copyrighted works are used to train AI models and how creators should be compensated when their music contributes to AI-generated outputs. While licensing agreements establish permission to use music, identifying how individual recordings and compositions influence what AI generates remains a significant challenge. Together, Sonilo and Musical AI aim to demonstrate a model for generative music where licensing, attribution, and compensation are built into the process from the start.

Sonilo generates music and sound effects directly from video footage, text, or both, using models built around licensed source material. Through the partnership, Musical AI's technology will analyze Sonilo's generated outputs and measure how licensed recordings and compositions contributed to each one. That reporting will give Sonilo's licensing partners the data needed to account for usage and support compensation for the songwriters, artists, and rights holders behind the original music. As generative technology makes it possible to create entirely new compositions influenced by existing works, the ability to identify and measure those contributions will become increasingly important to building sustainable relationships between AI companies and the music industry.

"The future of AI music can't be built at the expense of the people who created the music that makes it possible," said Keli Li, COO and Co-Founder of Sonilo. "The industry needs a better way to connect AI-generated music back to the artists and rights holders whose work contributed to it. We're building Sonilo around licensed music from the start, and our partnership with Musical AI is an important step toward building an AI music ecosystem that empowers creators while ensuring rights holders share in the value."

"AI music has enormous potential, but that potential depends on building a system that respects the creators behind it," said Sean Power, CEO of Musical AI. "Sonilo recognizes that licensing is only part of the equation. Rights holders also need visibility into how their work contributes to generated music. Together, we're helping demonstrate how attribution can support a more transparent and sustainable model for the industry."

The partnership comes as Sonilo finalizes master recording and publishing agreements with major rights organizations and prepares to launch its new music model update. Sonilo aims to demonstrate how the next generation of AI music platforms can create new opportunities for creators while protecting the value of the original works that make AI-generated music possible.

About Sonilo

Sonilo builds video-native generative audio models for creators, developers, and media platforms. Its technology generates music and sound effects directly from footage or text, creating soundtracks built for each video's story rather than pulled from a library. Sonilo is building a future where every video can have its own soundtrack, because when music truly fits a story, people don't just watch. They feel. Sonilo is headquartered in San Francisco and backed by B Capital. Learn more at sonilo.com.

About Musical AI

Musical AI is a Canadian rights technology company providing consent management and attribution infrastructure for generative music. Its platform helps rights holders manage permissions and identify how licensed works influence AI-generated outputs across composition and sound recording rights, supporting transparent reporting, licensing, and compensation.

releases.body:
Experience Beloved Holiday Traditions, Millions of Lights and ALL-NEW Festive Entertainment at SeaWorld's Christmas Celebration. All Included with Park Admission.

ORLANDO, Fla. and SAN DIEGO and SAN ANTONIO, Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The most wonderful time of the year is almost here, and SeaWorld is ready to shine. This holiday season, SeaWorld Orlando, SeaWorld San Diego and SeaWorld San Antonio will each transform into dazzling seaside wonderlands, with millions of glowing lights, heartwarming animal presentations, festive entertainment, seasonal flavors and traditions that can only be found at SeaWorld. Whether guests are meeting reindeer, cheering for orcas under the stars or sipping hot cocoa beside a twinkling tree, SeaWorld's Christmas Celebration offers the perfect place to make new memories and enjoy cherished traditions.

SeaWorld Orlando: Where Miracles Happen

From Nov. 6 through Jan. 4 on select dates, SeaWorld Orlando's Christmas Celebration lights up the park with millions of sparkling lights and more decorations than ever before. Recognized by USA Today's 10Best as one of the nation's top holiday theme park events, the celebration is a must-visit for families across Central Florida and beyond.

The festive fun includes:

  • The return of Miracles, the inspirational nighttime presentation that pairs a moving holiday soundtrack with the awe and beauty of orcas. Themes of peace, friendship and reflection make it a tradition that guests of all ages will want to return to year after year. SeaWorld Annual Pass Members will be among the first to experience Miracles through an exclusive presentation time.



  • Sesame Street Christmas Parade, where Elmo and friends partake in a joyful holiday parade.



  • O Wondrous Night, a heartwarming retelling of the first Christmas, featuring more than 30 carols, life-size puppets and live animals.



  • Elmo's Christmas Wish at Seaport Theater and the spectacular Winter Wonderland on Ice.



  • Clyde & Seamore's Countdown to Christmas, bringing signature heart and humor to the stage.



  • Holiday Reflections: Fireworks Finale, a breathtaking display of lights, music and pyrotechnics that fills the night with holiday cheer.



  • The Sea of Trees, where sparkling trees dance around a towering 70-foot centerpiece to holiday classics all across the lagoon, plus snow flurries along the Waterfront, marching toy soldiers and twirling ballerinas.



  • Meet Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer in Rudolph's Christmas Town, snap photos with Sesame Street friends in holiday attire, marvel at a charming miniature Holiday Train display and have festive fun at Mrs. Claus' Magic Kitchen.



  • Ice skating at Bayside Stadium alongside the lagoon (additional fee applies), and Christmas movies at SeaFire Grill with no dining purchase required.



  • Dinner with Santa at Sea Harbor Pavilions (select dates, excluding opening weekend) and the Sesame Street Christmas Breakfast at SeaFire Grill, both for an additional fee.

SeaWorld Orlando also celebrates the season's many traditions with a Hanukkah menorah lighting and Kwanzaa kinara lighting in Sesame Street Land, a New Year's Eve send-off with bold fireworks and festive entertainment on December 31, and a Three Kings Celebration on Jan. 2–6 featuring festive cuisine and special performances.

SeaWorld San Diego: A Seaside Holiday Tale, with Four All-New Experiences

From Nov. 13 through Jan. 3, SeaWorld San Diego invites guests into a breathtaking seaside wonderland. Beneath the glow of San Diego's largest Christmas tree, the 320-foot SkyTower Tree of Lights, the park sparkles with more than one million lights, radiant holiday trees and larger-than-life marine-inspired displays.

This year's celebration unwraps four ALL-NEW holiday experiences:

  • Baby Shark's Christmas Adventure makes its SeaWorld San Diego debut, taking families on an interactive musical journey to the North Pole filled with favorite songs, a special holiday mission and plenty of dancing.



  • Dolphin Island Christmas is reimagined with new music and costumes, celebrating the holiday traditions and cultures of Hawaii and the Pacific Islands, and featuring the park's newest dolphin family member, Solstice, enjoying her very first Christmas.



  • Rock the Holiday Christmas Parade sends Mrs. Claus and her merry elves marching through the park daily with floats, music and dancing.



  • North Pole Storytime invites guests to hear a special tale from the North Pole's head librarian, with help from elves and audience volunteers.

Beloved favorites return:

  • Clyde & Seamore's Christmas Special where prank-loving pinnipeds Clyde and Seamore, along with their trainers, have a hilarious holiday time.
  • Toymaker Trouble with Mrs. Claus and the Elves joins Santa's elves as they are preparing the final order of toys for Santa's sleigh, but the head toymaker elf is severely lacking in Christmas spirit. With the help of Mrs. Claus and three of her most trusted elves, Sparky will be reminded that the true gift of Christmas is the time spent with family and friends.
  • A Stocking Full of Soul musical performance features holiday music, spectacular dancing, and festive cheer.
  • At Rudolph's Christmas Town, meet Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer and make your spirits bright.
  • Take photos with Santa and meet Santa's reindeer visiting from the North Pole.
  • Go on the Snowflake Seeker's: A Christmas Quest! scavenger hunt (purchase required).
  • Nightly snowfall at SkyTower Lawn and Wild Arctic.
  • Donner and Blitzen's Laser Light Show where guests can experience a canopy of laser beams and a festive soundtrack.
  • A Christmas Wish Fireworks Shows on Saturday, December 12 and Thursday, December 31 light up the evening sky.

SeaWorld San Diego will also celebrate the season's many traditions with a Hanukkah menorah lighting beginning Dec. 1 and Kwanzaa kinara lighting with a Unity cup and crops. The park will ring in the New Year on Dec. 31 with entertainment and fireworks.

SeaWorld San Antonio: Texas' Biggest Christmas Celebration

Beginning Nov. 12 and running on select dates through Jan. 4, SeaWorld San Antonio transforms into Texas' largest Christmas wonderland with millions of twinkling lights and more than a dozen specially decorated holiday areas, all included with park admission.

Fan favorites take center stage:

  • Back by popular demand is the fan-favorite Miracles, the majestic orca holiday presentation set to traditional Christmas music brings the magic of the holiday season to life.
  • The ALL-NEW beluga whale and Pacific white-sided dolphin presentation, A Joyful Splash.
  • Clyde and Seamore's Countdown to Christmas, a laugh-out-loud sea lion and otter adventure, returns with hilarious holiday antics and plenty of heart.
  • O' Wondrous Night returns to tell the greatest story ever told, but through the eyes of the animals that were there that fateful night. This award-winning magical experience features amazing puppetry and more than 30 inspirational carols set against the backdrop of the very first Christmas.
  • The RhythMotion Christmas Parade brings the spirit of the sea to the streets with dazzling floats, music, dancers and whimsical marine-themed characters.
  • With 13 specialty-themed areas, guests can stroll through a Texas Christmas at Christmas Market, complete with a cowboy Santa and a Christmas tree made of cowboy boots, wander through an animated light tunnel set to holiday music, and step into a 1950s-inspired wonderland at Christmas Cove, and visit Rudolph's Christmas Town and meet the snowmen of Snowman Village.
  • Jolly Pathway Entertainment features Christmas carols performed with a unique festive fiesta flair by the Merry Mariachis, snap a picture with the infamous Nutcracker Stilt Walkers, and enjoy the All-New Melodic Mistletoes as they perform holiday carols. 

To close out the season, the New Year's Eve Fireworks Celebration lights up the night sky, with an exclusive VIP Fireworks Watch Party and Reception (reservations required) offering lakeside viewing and a champagne toast to welcome 2027.

The Gift of Holiday Savings

SeaWorld's Christmas Celebration is included with park admission at all three parks, and Annual Passes make the best holiday gift, offering unlimited visits and a full year of memories. Limited-time offers include:

  • SeaWorld Orlando: Save up to 60% on tickets and up to 25% on Annual Passes.



  • SeaWorld San Diego: Exclusive SoCal Pass available from as low as $11.50 a month for a limited time, with unlimited visits, exclusive events and no blockout dates.



  • SeaWorld San Antonio: Passes from as low as $8.50 a month, with Aquatica San Antonio, Texas' best waterpark, included free with Pass purchase for a limited time, plus free parking and free guest tickets.

Plan Your Visit

Christmas Celebration dates vary by park and some experiences require reservations or an additional fee. For tickets, dates, showtimes and details, visit SeaWorldOrlando.com, SeaWorldSanDiego.com or SeaWorldSanAntonio.com, and follow each park on social media for the latest holiday news.

About SeaWorld

SeaWorld is a leading marine life theme park and accredited zoo and aquarium that provides experiences that matter while educating and inspiring guests of all ages to care about marine life. Welcoming millions of guests every year, the parks offer fun and enriching experiences from up-close animal encounters and year-round educational programs to award-winning marine-life-themed rides and attractions, special events, and exciting entertainment. For more than 60 years SeaWorld has advanced the conservation of marine life in and outside its parks through science, education, and exceptional animal care that is Humane Certified by American Humane and accredited by the Alliance of Marine Mammal Parks and Aquariums and the Association of Zoos and Aquariums. SeaWorld is one of the largest marine animal rescue organizations in the world, helping more than 43,000 animals to date. The SeaWorld Conservation Fund, a non-profit foundation established in 2003, has provided more than $20 million to nearly 1,400 organizations to advance critical research on every continent. A portion of park proceeds goes toward supporting these longstanding conservation commitments. SeaWorld parks are in Orlando, San Antonio, San Diego and Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates (UAE). SeaWorld is part of the United Parks & Resorts Inc. (NYSE: PRKS) portfolio of theme park brands. For more information, visit SeaWorld.com.

SeaWorld Orlando: SWO-PR@seaworld.com

SeaWorld San Diego: swcpr@seaworld.com

SeaWorld San Antonio: Chuck.Cureau@seaworld.com

releases.body:
TORONTO, Oct. 28, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Leading global children's entertainment company Spin Master Corp. announced today that a fourth PAW Patrol feature film is in the works. Cal Brunker (PAW Patrol: The Movie™, PAW Patrol: The Mighty Movie™, PAW Patrol: The Dino Movie™, and The Nut Job 2: Nutty by Nature) returns to direct the latest instalment, and serves as co-writer for the film alongside Bob Barlen.

PAW Patrol's first three theatrical films became family favourites, all earning above 93% on the Rotten Tomatoes Popcornmeter and grossing a combined half-billion dollars at the global box office. The fourth film from Spin Master Entertainment, Paramount Animation and Nickelodeon Movies, is set to be distributed by Paramount Pictures in 2029. It is a Spin Master Entertainment production.

"PAW Patrol is a global entertainment phenomenon, and we're investing in the franchise to give fans more of what they love," said Vishnu Athreya, EVP & President of Spin Master Entertainment. "Looking to the future, we want to further expand the PAW Patrol universe through movies, series, specials, short-form video, and connected play to bring joy to the next generation of kids wherever they are. There are endless storytelling possibilities - this is just the beginning."

"PAW Patrol has a special place in the hearts of families around the world, and we're thrilled to continue the pups' journey on the big screen," said Jennifer Dodge, President of Paramount Animation. "Together, with our partners at Spin Master, we're excited to bring audiences another adventure that's made for the theatrical experience."

"Watching the way audiences have connected with the PAW movies has been incredible," said Brunker. "We've written a new story that we think audiences are going to love, and we can't wait to share it with the world."

Since its 2013 debut, PAW Patrol has become a beloved franchise for preschoolers and families with the series ranking as the #1 preschool show on Nick Jr. PAW Patrol's global reach spans over 190 territories and 33 languages, and it has amassed more than 10 million YouTube subscribers. The franchise's success also drives an active retail business, with more than 1,000 licensees worldwide and over $18 billion in lifetime retail sales generated through Skydance Products & Publishing, in addition to sales generated by Spin Master.

About Spin Master

Spin Master Corp. (TSX:TOY) is a leading global children's entertainment company, creating exceptional play experiences across its three creative centres: Toys, Entertainment and Digital Games. With worldwide toy distribution, Spin Master is best known for award-winning brands including PAW Patrol®, Melissa & Doug®, Bakugan® and Rubik's® Cube, and is the global toy licensee for other iconic properties. Through its in-house entertainment studio, the company creates and produces captivating multiplatform content including powerhouse preschool franchise PAW Patrol, along with other original shows, short-form series and feature films. With an established presence in digital games anchored by Toca Boca® and Piknik™, Spin Master engages close to 60 million active users monthly in open-ended, creative and safe play. With 29 offices spanning nearly 20 countries, Spin Master employs more than 2,500 team members globally.

releases.title: Entertainment Software Rating Board Names Ratings Veteran Orit Michiel as President
releases.body:
Former Netflix and Motion Picture Association executive brings more than two decades of experience in age ratings, content standards and children's safety

NEW YORK, Oct. 28, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The Entertainment Software Rating Board (ESRB) today announced that Orit Michiel will become its president, effective November 2, 2026. Michiel will lead the video game industry's efforts in helping parents make informed decisions about video games and apps through age and content ratings, resources for families, industry advertising standards and the ESRB Privacy Certified program. Michiel will also serve on the Board of Directors for the International Age Rating Coalition (IARC), which provides global age ratings for digitally delivered games and apps.

Michiel brings extensive experience developing and strengthening age-rating systems across the entertainment industry. At Netflix, she served as Director, Content Policy, leading the global Content Policy team and developing a global classification and maturity-rating system. Before joining Netflix, Michiel spent 13 years at the Motion Picture Association (MPA), serving as Vice President, Legal Affairs, and chair of the Classification and Rating Appeals Board. She led a comprehensive overhaul of the motion picture industry's U.S. rating and advertising guidelines, working with industry partners, regulators and international ratings bodies on content classification and child protection.

"Orit understands the responsibility that comes with providing trusted age ratings and the numerous positive benefits of interactive entertainment on our society and culture," said Strauss Zelnick, Chairman and CEO of Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc., and Chair, Board of Directors of the Entertainment Software Association (ESA) and ESRB. "Her experience across the entertainment industry, and her deep knowledge of classification systems, makes her an exceptional choice to lead ESRB for the future. She will build on its longstanding commitment to giving parents clear, reliable information to decide what is right for their families and ensuring that our self-regulated industry continues to adhere to its stringent guidelines and practices."

As president, Michiel will oversee ESRB's age and content rating system, enforcement of advertising and marketing guidelines adopted by the video game industry, and Privacy Certified program, which helps companies implement responsible privacy practices. Michiel will replace Patricia Vance, who is retiring after more than 20 years in her role as ESRB president.

"Interactive entertainment sparks imagination, inspires learning and brings families together. Parents deserve clear, useful information to help them choose gameplay experiences that are right for their children," said Michiel. "ESRB has earned parents' trust and empowered them with that information. I am honored to lead this team and build on its work to help families make confident choices as video games and the ways people play continue to evolve."

Michiel began her career practicing law. She holds a J.D. from the UCLA School of Law and a B.A. in Political Science from UCLA.

About ESRB

The ESRB is a non-profit, self-regulatory body that independently assigns age and content ratings for video games and mobile apps so parents can make informed choices. It also enforces advertising guidelines adopted by the video game industry and helps companies implement responsible online, mobile and internet connected device privacy practices under its Privacy Certified program. Visit www.esrb.org for more information.

LOS ANGELES, Oct. 28, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- EBONY today named the six members of its 2026 Power 100 Court - the special honorees who will be celebrated on stage at the EBONY Power 100 Gala on Monday, Nov. 9, at the Hollywood Palladium in Los Angeles.

Spanning space exploration, finance, media ownership, music and sports, this year's Court includes:

  • Grammy-winning singer and actress Brandy
  • Allen Media Group founder Byron Allen
  • Seattle Storm WNBA player Flau'jae Johnson
  • Digital influencer and culinary tastemaker Keith Lee
  • Emmy Award-winning writer, producer and actor Lena Waithe
  • NASA Astronaut Emeritus Victor Glover

The Court represents the honorees whose work most fully embodies this year's theme, "The Stories We Shape." Each member will be presented with a dedicated tribute and accept their honor in person on the Palladium stage.

"For more than 80 years, EBONY has kept the record of the people moving Black America forward, and the Court is that record at its most vivid. They wrote it themselves, and that is exactly what this year's Power 100 celebrates," said Eden Bridgeman, CEO of EBONY.

The program will also feature live musical performances from 20-time Grammy-winning artist Kirk Franklin, who will open the show, and Grammy-winning rapper, entrepreneur and member of this year's Music Innovators class T.I., who will close out the ceremony.

While the Court takes the stage, every member of the 2026 Power 100 will be recognized during the ceremony, and honorees will be photographed in the gala's portrait studio, adding the 2026 honoree class to EBONY's eight-decade visual record of Black leadership.

The evening will unfold inside "La Cour," the gala's immersive creative world, which reimagines the grand royal courts of history with Black excellence at their center.

Produced in partnership with Jesse Collins Entertainment (JCE), the private, invitation-only gala begins with a 5:00 p.m. red carpet and cocktail hour, followed by the 7:30 p.m. awards ceremony and a 10:30 p.m. post-reception. The 2026 Power 100 recognizes leaders across 11 categories, from the Junior Bridgeman Business Vanguards, named in honor of EBONY CEO Eden Bridgeman's late father, to STEM Trailblazers, Media Mavens and Generation Next.

This year's honors are supported by category sponsors including:

  • BMW, sponsor of Community Crusaders
  • Mielle Organics, sponsor of the Court
  • United Airlines, sponsor of STEM Trailblazers
  • Walmart, sponsor of Influential Creators
  • Sela K.

The complete list of 2026 EBONY Power 100 honorees is available at EBONY.com/Power100. Follow EBONY on social media for additional Power 100 updates: @EBONYMagazine on Instagram, @ebony_magazine on TikTok, and @EBONY on X and Facebook.

For more than 80 years, EBONY has served as a leading voice of the Black American experience and a global authority on Black culture. Through its commitment to storytelling, cultural coverage, entertainment, lifestyle, commerce and community, EBONY continues to illuminate the Black perspective and celebrate the people, ideas and movements shaping the past, present and future of the Black experience. EBONY Media Group is a division of 1145 Holdings LLC.

releases.title: LUXE Bidet Stages a Surprise "Funeral" at San Diego International Film Festival Screening of Horror Short "Bidet"
releases.body:
A DM to indie filmmaker James Brylowski sparked an unexpected creative partnership, bringing his film "Bidet" off the screen and into the theater.

SAN DIEGO, Oct. 28, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- LUXE Bidet surprised a San Diego International Film Festival audience with a staged funeral that ended in free bidets for everyone. The stunt followed a screening of "Bidet," filmmaker James Brylowski's horror-comedy film about a group of friends hunted by a possessed bidet — and it started with a DM.

LUXE Bidet surprised a Film Festival audience with a staged funeral that ended in free bidets for everyone.

As the festival's leading sponsor alongside SAG-AFTRA, LUXE Bidet worked with Brylowski and the festival team to pull off a surprise during the film's screening.

A Surprise After the Credits

The credits rolled, the lights dimmed, and a red spotlight hit the front of the theater as funeral music began to play. Cloaked performers carried in a stretcher, a white sheet draped over what appeared to be a body. When they pulled back the sheet, they revealed dozens of LUXE Bidets instead, and the tension dissolved into relief, laughter, and applause as the performers handed the bidets down every row. Relief, as it happens, is the business LUXE Bidet is in.

The Giveaway Didn't Stop There

"Initially, I was like, 'Am I selling out for some free bidets?'" said Brylowski, who wrote and directed the film. "But everyone I told said, 'I want a free bidet!' I've actually owned a LUXE Bidet for years and love it, so I felt good supporting them. After the stunt, viewers thanked me for the free bidet. I told them, 'Don't crank it to max unless you're ready to party.'"

Every attendee went home with a NEO 185 PLUS from LUXE Bidet's best-selling NEO PLUS series, a dual-nozzle bidet attachment that slides in without removing the toilet seat and features a self-cleaning mode. Outside the theater, the LUXE Bidet team continued handing out bidets to festivalgoers and staff in front of a custom "Bidet" poster backdrop, complete with novelty toilet-shaped popcorn holders.

The San Diego screening was just one stop on the film's festival run, with more screenings of "Bidet" planned in the coming months.

About LUXE Bidet

Founded in 2008, LUXE Bidet is the #1 best-selling bidet brand in America, making high-quality, affordable bidet attachments that are easy to install and easy to love.

Full Opening Animation Produced by PIERROT FILMS

PIERROT FILMS, the studio behind the TV anime "BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War", produced the game's full opening animation.

Watch the opening animation here:https://youtu.be/Ev0FRl7IRkU

Opening Theme Song "CRITICAL" with Lyrics and Composition by suisoh, Arranged by suisoh and Takahiro Yamada

The opening song of BLEACH Mirror's High, "CRITICAL," was written and composed by suisoh, who also composed the ending theme for the TV anime "BLEACH: The Thousand-Year Blood War." The arrangement is handled by suisoh together with Takahiro Yamada of ASIAN KUNG-FU GENERATION, who composed the opening theme for the TV anime "BLEACH: Arrancar Arc."

Stream "CRITICAL" today: https://suisoh.lnk.to/CRITICAL 

Licensed by Sony Music Labels Inc.

Artist comments:

Comment from suisoh: 

"I am honored to have had the opportunity to work on this song together with Takahiro Yamada from ASIAN KUNG-FU GENERATION.

When working on a collab, I place the utmost importance on synergy, so I took a different approach to this project compared to when I worked on "MONOCHROME". This track is a fusion between band sounds and samples of electronic music. For the recording, Yamada and Kiyoshi Ijichi from the ASIAN KUNG-FU GENERATION team were in charge of bass and drums respectively, while Yuto Shimizu from the suisoh team was on guitar. With the support of these incredibly talented musicians, we were able to complete a track that manages to be both dynamic and ethereal all at once.

I believe this song serves to encourage the new protagonists, Shirin and Shirane, along with everyone else as they embark on their journey. I would be thrilled if you listened to it over and over again."

Comment from Takahiro Yamada

"Whenever I see how pumped the audience gets when we perform a nearly twenty-year-old track like "After Dark", it reminds me of just how great BLEACH truly is. I'm honored to be involved in its music production once again through this cross-generation collaboration.

suisoh's music has a broad yet intricate style, with a rich sense of imagery and progression. To complement that, I aimed for an arrangement that maintains a consistent core idea while changing how I approach each part.

The Mirrors High theme song "CRITICAL" is a dignified track harboring hidden strength. I hope that it becomes the spark that raises the players' Spiritual Pressure!"

[Standing at the Top] Sosuke Aizen Headlines the First Limited Summon

[Standing in the Heavens] Sosuke Aizen headlines the game's first limited summon, running now through November 24, 2026, at 5:59 a.m. UTC. Watch the Sosuke Aizen Debut PV here: https://youtu.be/k9sUEMO9mEQ.

In addition to the previously revealed protagonists Shirin Migishima and Shirane Sanari, and the new recruits Naru Jurinna, Giro Hando, and Maiko Tokishima, 10 new squad members make their debut in BLEACH Mirrors High. The official website and official X account are currently featuring character concept art drawn exclusively by series creator Tite Kubo, as well as comments from the cast.

About BLEACH Mirrors High

Set in the wake of the Thousand-Year Blood War, BLEACH Mirrors High follows a lone soul newly awakened in Karakura Town as they take up the blade and carve an original Soul Reaper story all their own. Customize your Soul Reaper avatar's hair, face, body, eyes and more across a full color palette, then forge your ideal Zanpakuto, fine-tuning the blade, guard, hilt, decoration and effects. In battle, form a team of three and chain together fast, card-based attacks, signature special moves and the powerful "Soul Drive" team-up technique to trigger stylish Link Attacks. Fight alongside iconic characters such as Ichigo Kurosaki, Rukia Kuchiki and all-new Soul Reapers designed by series creator Tite Kubo.

About BLEACH

BLEACH is a smash-hit, sword-battle action manga by Tite Kubo that was serialized in Weekly Shonen Jump. Even after its conclusion, the series continues to enjoy enduring popularity worldwide, with over 130 million copies sold.

The animated TV series began airing in October 2004, and concluded in 2026 with its final part, BLEACH: The Thousand-Year Blood War. Across the series, more than 410 episodes have been produced along with four feature films.

Even after the conclusion of the TV series, BLEACH remains beloved by fans worldwide through a wide range of cross-media projects.

releases.body:
Margin reduced by 50 basis points to SOFR + 400, delivering approximately $9.3 million in annual cash interest savings

KNOXVILLE, Tenn., Oct. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Regal Global Entertainment ("Regal" or the "Company"), the second largest theatrical exhibition business in the world, today announced the successful repricing of its $1.9 billion term loan facility.

The transaction lowers the interest rate margin by 50 basis points, from SOFR plus 450 basis points to SOFR plus 400 basis points and is expected to generate approximately $9.3 million in annual interest savings. The maturity date and all other material terms remain substantially unchanged. The transaction was strongly supported by lenders.

Over the past three years, Regal has reduced the margin on its term loan by a cumulative 450 basis points, generating approximately $80 million in annualized interest savings.

The repricing follows Moody's Ratings' recent upgrade of Regal's Corporate Family Rating to B2 from B3, with a positive outlook. Together, the upgrade and strong lender demand reflect growing recognition across the credit markets of Regal's improving financial profile.

"Moody's upgrade with a positive outlook, followed by a well-supported repricing, is clear external validation of the progress we've made," said Thomas Song, Chief Financial Officer of Regal Global Entertainment. "Our business is seeing strong consumer demand, and the credit markets are recognizing it."

"Since emergence, we have taken 450 basis points out of our borrowing costs, and every dollar we save on interest is a dollar we can reinvest at high returns in our theatres, our premium formats and our guests. We will keep managing our capital structure with discipline as we build long-term value for all our stakeholders," said Song.

About Regal Global Entertainment

Regal Global Entertainment operates the second largest theatrical exhibition business in the world with 7,637 screens across 628 locations. Through its Cinema City, Cineworld, Picturehouse, Planet, and Regal brands, the company is committed to delivering exceptional moviegoing experiences through premium large formats, innovative loyalty and subscription programs, enhanced food and beverage offerings, and outstanding guest service.

releases.title: Block Reign Unveils MusIQ, a Music Participation Network Built Natively on the Gnodi Blockchain
releases.body:
New protocol connects fans, artists and operators through a participation credit earned through engagement and redeemed for real-world music experiences.

OREM, Utah, Oct. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Block Reign, Inc. today announced MusIQ, a music participation network built natively on the Gnodi Blockchain. MusIQ is a digital participation credit designed to coordinate fan engagement, artist promotion and operator infrastructure within a single ecosystem. Block Reign is building the MusIQ ecosystem on Gnodi, which serves as the protocol, settlement and security layer for the network.

Fans earn LYRIQ, a blockchain-based digital reward, by engaging with the music they love: attending events, streaming content, sharing promotions, joining fan communities, and completing campaign challenges. They may redeem it for event tickets, backstage access, digital collectibles, merchandise discounts and other exclusive experiences. Individuals will operate and host MusIQ service nodes that verify participation events and may be rewarded for their contribution to the network. Every MusIQ action is recorded as a transaction on the Gnodi blockchain, so engagement directly produces on-chain activity.

"What excites me about MusIQ Network is, quite simply, the network rewards people for enjoying music," said Mary Kanagy, founding community member of the MusIQ Network ecosystem. "Showing up, streaming, sharing and supporting artists all count, and the rewards they may earn open real doors to phenomenal experiences. As a founding member, I'm looking forward to helping build a community around this new way of enjoying MusIQ."

MusIQ at a Glance

  • Native to Gnodi: MusIQ runs as a native application on the decentralized Gnodi Layer 1 blockchain, not as a bridged asset or separate chain, and relies on Gnodi for execution, validation and gas processing.
  • Predictable emissions: Supply is capped at 1 billion MusIQ and follows a declining issuance schedule modeled after Bitcoin's halving, moving the network from early incentives toward organic, usage-based activity.
  • Three independent reward pools: Issuance is permanently divided among Proof of Action (60%) for fan and artist engagement, Proof of Contribution (30%) for service node operators, and Protocol Commitment (10%) for participants who voluntarily lock the LYRIQ token for defined periods.
  • Campaign framework: Artists, promoters, labels and communities can launch campaigns that set participation rules and redemption privileges. Campaigns cannot create or sell LYRIQ, so supply stays governed by the protocol.
  • Operator model: Node operators obtain service software licenses to process participation events and submit reward transactions to Gnodi. Licenses grant software access, not token ownership.
  • Developer-ready: MusIQ is built on the Gnodi EVM, an Ethereum-compatible execution environment within the Gnodi Cosmos SDK Layer 1 blockchain. Leveraging Solidity smart contracts, EVM-compatible development tools, and standard wallet integrations, developers can build fan applications, artist tools, and redemption services.

"MusIQ is designed so that applications can build on Gnodi with clear, enforceable rules," said Cory Clinton, Chief Technology Officer of Block Reign. "Emissions, node authorization and redemptions are all handled on-chain, which gives artists and developers a dependable foundation." Block Reign plans to support ecosystem growth through programs for artist activation, venue and event integration, developer tools and community onboarding.

Learn more about Block Reign here: www.blockreign.tech

Learn more about MusIQ Network here: https://musiqnetwork.com/ 

ABOUT BLOCK REIGN

Block Reign exists to innovate, empower, and connect by delivering cutting-edge technology solutions designed for the modern digital world. Specializing in SaaS products that seamlessly integrate with Web3 blockchain technology, Block Reign empowers businesses and individuals with meaningful digital tools that drive growth, efficiency, and security. Our mission is to connect people and organizations through scalable, future-ready solutions that bridge the gap between today's technology needs and tomorrow's possibilities.

ABOUT GNODI BLOCKCHAIN

The Gnodi Blockchain is a decentralized platform that empowers individuals to manage their digital identities and engage within an open ecosystem of applications and services. Built on Proof-of-Stake consensus, with community governance and protocol-driven rewards, Gnodi delivers a secure, scalable, and user-focused network designed for long-term growth. Digital rewards distributed through the network recognize participation and contribution; they are utility-based and not financial investment instruments and may never have any value outside of the ecosystem.

Disclosure: MusIQ is a consumptive participation credit for earning and redeeming access, experiences, and merchandise within the music ecosystem. MusIQ credits and digital rewards are earned through participation, are not guaranteed, and carry no expectation of profit. They do not represent equity, yield, revenue share, or investment rights, are not marketed for appreciation, and may have no market value. Block Reign integrates enterprise products with the decentralized Gnodi Blockchain, which operates separately and is not controlled by Block Reign. This release contains forward-looking statements, is for informational purposes only, and is not an offer, solicitation, or investment, legal, or financial advice. Participation is voluntary and subject to each participant's own tax and regulatory responsibilities.

JAŸ-Z is the first hip-hop artist to be inducted into the Songwriters Hall of Fame, a four-time Emmy winner, and a 25-time GRAMMY Award winner. With multiple businesses, accolades across the recording and film industries, and recognition throughout the philanthropic community, Carter, a 2021 Rock and Roll Hall of Fame inductee, is a globally dominant force of popular culture. 2026 became the year of JAŸ-Z 30, a year-long celebration of the 30th anniversary of JAŸ-Z's seminal debut album Reasonable Doubt. The initiative, made up of immersive experiences and limited-edition exclusive products, saw JAŸ-Z break attendance records with three sold-out concerts at Yankee Stadium, as well as sold-out concerts in London, Paris and Los Angeles.

"From Reasonable Doubt to standing on the Super Bowl Halftime stage, this has been a journey," stated JAŸ-Z. "Thirty years of music, work, and culture on the world's biggest stage. This run continues to be a dream come true."

"For several years, we've had the privilege of working closely with JAŸ-Z and Roc Nation, and I've seen the extraordinary impact he has had on the Super Bowl Halftime Show," said NFL Commissioner Roger Goodell. "When we first reached an agreement with Roc Nation to produce the show, I had just one request: that JAŸ-Z take the stage himself one day, whenever the moment felt right to him. I couldn't be more excited for fans around the world to experience the artistry, creativity and cultural impact he will bring to the Super Bowl stage."

"JAŸ-Z's impact on global music culture is as profound as it is undeniable," said Oliver Schusser, Apple's Vice President of Music and International Content. "We've had the privilege of working closely with him these last few years to bring some of the world's most exciting and prolific artists to the Super Bowl Halftime Show stage and we are so thrilled that he will be taking that stage himself this year. We know it's going to be an incredible show."

Immediately following the announcement, Apple Music Radio's Zane Lowe, Eddie Francis and Brooke Reese will be live on-air discussing this exciting news. Fans can also visit JAŸ-Z's Road to Halftime on Apple Music for exclusive content, season-long programming, and experiences created in partnership with the NFL.

The Apple Music Super Bowl LXI Halftime Show telecast will be executive produced by Roc Nation. Hamish Hamilton will serve as director. Roc Nation also serves as the strategic entertainment advisor of the live performance.



Apple Music's multiyear partnership with the NFL and Roc Nation brings its longstanding commitment to music – and the artists who make it – to the Super Bowl Halftime Show, the year's most-watched musical performance. Apple revolutionized the music experience with iPod and iTunes, and Apple Music carries that legacy forward with the highest audio quality and over 100 million songs. Follow @AppleMusic on TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, Snapchat, YouTube, and X.

The Apple Music Super Bowl Halftime Show has earned multiple Emmy wins and set broadcast milestones in recent years. Most recently, the Apple Music Super Bowl LX Halftime Show starring Bad Bunny made history as the most Emmy-awarded halftime show of all time, earning seven wins for Outstanding Variety Special (Live), Outstanding Music Direction, Outstanding Directing for a Variety Special, Outstanding Choreography for Variety or Reality Programming, Outstanding Sound Mixing for a Variety Series or Special, Outstanding Lighting Design/Lighting Direction for a Special, and Outstanding Technical Direction and Camerawork for a Special. The Apple Music Super Bowl LIX Halftime Show starring Kendrick Lamar became the most watched Super Bowl Halftime Show, garnering four Emmy nominations and taking home the Emmy for Outstanding Music Direction. The Apple Music Super Bowl LVIII Halftime Show starring Usher garnered three 2024 Emmy nominations, including Outstanding Variety Special (LIVE). In 2023, the Apple Music Super Bowl LVII Halftime Show Starring Rihanna scored five Emmy nominations, taking home two awards, including Outstanding Directing For A Variety Special, a first in Super Bowl Halftime history. In 2022, Super Bowl LVI Halftime Show Starring Dr. Dre, Snoop Dogg, Eminem, Mary J. Blige and Kendrick Lamar garnered five Creative Arts Emmy nominations. The critically acclaimed performance won three Emmys, including Outstanding Variety Special (Live), a first-ever for the show.

NEW YORK, Oct. 26, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- LuminoCity Festival (LuminoCity Inc.), an immersive entertainment company specializing in large-scale light shows, animatronic attractions, and themed entertainment, is expanding its business-to-business (B2B) offerings for zoos, botanical gardens, parks, and entertainment destinations. The company will present its capabilities at IAAPA Expo 2026, November 17–20 in Orlando, Florida.

Founded in 2018, LuminoCity has welcomed millions of visitors nationwide across 33 festivals in 16 locations throughout eight U.S. states. Its signature Holiday Lights and Dino Safari experiences feature immersive light displays, handcrafted Chinese lantern installations, life-sized animatronic dinosaurs, and interactive attractions that combine traditional artistry with modern technology and storytelling.

Through its "Powered by LuminoCity" partnership model, the company develops customized light festivals, illuminated attractions, and themed entertainment experiences tailored to each venue's landscape, audience, and goals. Services span concept development, creative design, fabrication, installation, technical operations, and marketing support, helping partners transform existing spaces into memorable destinations and introduce new seasonal attractions.

A recent example is "Illumi-Nature" at Brevard Zoo in Melbourne, Florida, presented in the Spring of 2026. The nighttime experience transformed approximately ten acres of zoo grounds with illuminated lantern displays inspired by animals, flowers, and mythical creatures, including pathways typically closed to visitors. LuminoCity will next launch a new project with Jacksonville Zoo and Botanical Gardens in early 2027, and is engaged with other like-minded collaborative partners for 2027 and beyond.

"Our vision is to become North America's most trusted partner for immersive, story-driven family experiences," said Xiaoyi Chen, CEO and Founder of LuminoCity. "We want to help venues transform places into destinations, spark imagination across generations, and bring communities together."

At IAAPA Expo 2026, LuminoCity invites attractions industry professionals to visit Booth S5400 to learn more about its customized immersive experiences and explore potential venue partnerships.

About LuminoCity Festival

LuminoCity is a dynamic light-art brand taking the creative journey from concept through design, manufacturing, and presentation. Our diverse, mission-driven team is inspired by the storied tradition of Chinese lantern making, drawing on its rich cultural heritage to create contemporary art that transforms imaginative ideas into stunning works of light and color. Our annual festivals include LuminoCity's Holiday Lights and Dino Safari, with exciting new themes to come.

releases.title: Music IP Holdings Launches "Click-Through" License Portal for AI Technology Companies
releases.body:
NASHVILLE, Tenn., Oct. 26, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Music IP Holdings, Inc. (MIH) today launched a "Click-Through License Portal" that lets AI technology companies license its patented technologies online in minutes. MIH is a leading AI innovation licensing and technology development company setting the standard for authorized AI generation involving existing and new content.

The first-of-its-kind, custom-designed "Click-Through License Portal" allows MIH to quickly and efficiently provide cost-effective patent portfolio licenses to select companies so they can obtain the "freedom to operate" within and across AI markets. The new portal is designed for both technology and content companies that need to license the MIH AI derivatives workflow, Super Fan, Stems and other related patents in the portfolio: https://app.musiciprights.com/company-info

Today's portal, offered to smaller companies through the MIH Strategic Innovation Partner (SIP) program, is separate from the licensing agreements with large content and technology companies that MIH began announcing in August.

"A great deal of work has gone into this process by our technology, legal and licensing teams. It represents a critical step in MIH's evolution in 2026. We are laser-focused on protecting content owners and accelerating licenses for AI companies, all while enabling standards and value in the marketplace," said Daniel Drolet, CEO of MIH.

MIH owns a patent portfolio built for the age of generative AI. The portfolio includes more than 28 patent families and more than 90 issued, allowed and pending assets that together claim the workflow by which AI generation services turn prompts of all types into finished outputs. That workflow runs from intake and interpretation of the request, through checks against rights holders' content rules, generation, and post-generation review and marking, to controlled delivery under authorization and payment.

"Copyright asks whether something was copied; the MIH patents ask how it was made," Drolet said. "The MIH portfolio covers those answers across all three major claim categories – methods, systems and software – so rights attach whether or not an output copies anything, and whether or not the output itself can be copyrighted."

The MIH protections are directed to content in general rather than a single medium, and are being commercialized across music, voice, motion pictures, video, imagery, animation, publishing, and character and franchise IP, as well as name, image and likeness (NIL).

The comprehensive portfolio protects both existing content and new AI-generated content while providing AI generation companies with a clear, licensed pathway to drive revenue and accelerate market growth.  www.musiciprights.com

NEW YORK, Oct. 24, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- CSTS Enterprises ('CSTS'), a New York-based sports, entertainment, integrated media and travel technology group, today announced the official launch of PremierXTM, its flagship live entertainment brand, with a landmark Halloween Weekend event "AFTER DARK" at The Rooftop at Pier 17 in New York on October 30, 2026.

Capping off Seaport's 2026 Summer Season in unforgettable fashion, the grand finale brings a powerhouse lineup of stars to the PremierXTM stage at Pier 17, featuring Lil Xan, Armani White, DJ Soda, Nate Wyatt, and surprise A-list guest headliners. Set against the iconic Manhattan skyline, the landmark eventing unites chart-topping hip-hop and high-octane electronic music for a festival-grade experience as The Rooftop at Pier 17 transforms into the city's premier live music destination.

Building on the momentum of the PremierXTM After Party for the 2026 World Cup Final that took place in New York on July 19th, "AFTER DARK" signals the official debut of PremierXTM, a proprietary, New York – born global entertainment IP created by CSTS to deliver defining cultural experiences at the intersection of music, sport, art and lifestyle. Centred on the power of cultural crossover, PremierXTM serves as an international bridge connecting East and West, modern innovation and timeless classical, while uniting world-class artists, creators, performers and audiences through the universal language of entertainment and premium live experiences.

The launch also marks the beginning of a promising relationship with Pier 17, providing a world-class stage for PremierXTM to accelerate its growth in the U.S. and engage international audiences over the long term. By combining PremierXTM's global entertainment vision with Pier 17's iconic waterfront setting, the partnership aims to create a premier destination for live experiences, empowering both platforms to expand their global reach, deepen audience engagement, and drive sustainable growth.

As a key pillar of CSTS' integrated ecosystem spanning entertainment, sports, travel, integrated media and marketing solutions, PremierXTM further strengthens the Group's ability to create high-impact experiences that connect audiences, destinations and brand partners. With the global live entertainment market projected to grow from approximately US$203 billion in 2025 to US$270 billion by 2030[1], PremierXTM is well-positioned to capitalize on the growing demand for premium, experience-led entertainment while creating long-term value to the Group through recurring audience engagement, tourism and brand partnerships.

"PremierX TM represents a significant milestone in CSTS' evolution from a leading operator of global sports and hospitality platforms into a creator of world-class entertainment experiences," said Abel Zhao, Group CEO and Executive Director at CSTS Enterprises. "The season finale at Pier17 marks the beginning of an exciting new chapter for CSTS as we expand our entertainment footprint and introduce a platform designed to deliver iconic live experiences and bring together artists and audiences from across the globe."

"PremierXTM was built from the ground up as a bespoke platform to champion multicultural talent and visionary creative performers." said Jason Liu, Regional Director of CSTS USA. "Starting from New York, we are building a scalable global brand that brings iconic live experiences to audiences worldwide while expanding our presence across key entertainment hubs in North America, Asia and Europe."

Following its New York launch, PremierXTM plans to expand through a broader international rollout across North America, Asia and Europe, with future editions planned as part of a growing network of recurring live entertainment properties and flagship cultural events.

For ticket information on PremierXTM: "AFTER DARK", visit

https://www.axs.com/events/1644912/after-dark-tickets

About CSTS Enterprises

CSTS Enterprises is an integrated media, entertainment, sports, and travel technology group. Headquartered in New York City, the company develops and partners with intellectual properties and brands to deliver compelling experiences that connect with audiences across the world. In addition to its own initiatives, including Generation CTM and PremierXTM, it collaborates with international IPs including FIFA World Cup, UEFA European Championship, and Formula 1.

CSTS integrates experiential marketing, travel, data, and technology to deliver seamless end-to-end audience experiences. The company engages consumers across physical events and digital channels, executing at scale worldwide, turning complex activations into co-ordinated, measurable outcomes.

[1] Source: Industry research by Markets and Markets, Live Entertainment Market Size, Share, Latest Trends & Growth Analysis, 2025-2030, Live Entertainment Market Size, Share, Latest Trends & Growth Analysis, 2025-2030.

SAN FRANCISCO, Oct. 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Jerry Garcia's family, in partnership with archival media management platform Starchive and project coordinator Christopher McCutcheon, today announced plans for the establishment of the Jerry Garcia Music Arts Center in the San Francisco Bay Area through Jerry Garcia Music Arts.

Conceived as far more than a conventional museum, the envisioned institution is designed as an active, living cultural center, preservation space, and creative hub. Dedicated to preserving and advancing the multifaceted legacy of the Grateful Dead co-founder, the facility will showcase Garcia's expansive musical catalog, fine art, community ethos, and enduring impact spanning the 1960s counterculture through today.
releases.title: New Jerry Garcia Music Arts Center Planned for the San Francisco Bay Area
releases.body:
Facility to Celebrate Grateful Dead Co-Founder's Musical Roots, Fine Art, and Conservation Legacy

SAN FRANCISCO, Oct. 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Jerry Garcia's family, in partnership with archival media management platform Starchive and project coordinator Christopher McCutcheon, today announced plans for the establishment of the Jerry Garcia Music Arts Center in the San Francisco Bay Area through Jerry Garcia Music Arts.

Conceived as far more than a conventional museum, the envisioned institution is designed as an active, living cultural center, preservation space, and creative hub. Dedicated to preserving and advancing the multifaceted legacy of the Grateful Dead co-founder, the facility will showcase Garcia's expansive musical catalog, fine art, community ethos, and enduring impact spanning the 1960s counterculture through today.

For several years, Jerry Garcia's family and Jerry Garcia Music Arts have explored meaningful avenues to share the rich catalog of historical and artistic materials carefully preserved within Starchive. Following the announcement of the Eyes of the World immersive experience project this past August, widespread enthusiasm and community interest served as the catalyst to formalize plans for this dedicated, permanent archival home in the Bay Area.

Reflecting Jerry Garcia's spirit of family and community, all Garcia family heirs are warmly welcomed to participate and share their personal family content, archival materials, and special mementos to be preserved and celebrated within the collection.

The center will feature a community-oriented, fan-accessible research library and physical archive housing rare memorabilia and historical artifacts, complemented by a modern digital preservation hub. To cultivate ongoing public participation, the center will also review and accept fan-donated materials.

Beyond Garcia's visual art and recordings, exhibitions will trace the diverse musical traditions that shaped his artistic journey-including Americana, blues, rock, gospel, jazz, country, folk, and world music. Galleries will also highlight landmark technological innovations pioneered by Garcia and his collaborators, notably historical innovations in live concert sound design.

"My father is recognized as one of the most culturally influential artists in history," said Keelin Garcia, co-founder of Jerry Garcia Music Arts. "It is a great honor to work with Christopher McCutcheon and the Starchive team of professional archivists in stewarding the preservation of his many artistic contributions for future generations."

Comprehensive plans for the facility encompass a state-of-the-art performance center and screening room for live music and film presentations, alongside special exhibition galleries dedicated to Garcia's fine art and instruments. The center will also host an Artist-in-Residence program supporting emerging and established creators in the recording and visual arts, accompanied by interactive environmental exhibits spotlighting Garcia's dedication to conservation-specifically his advocacy for coral reefs and rainforest preservation-supported by integrated charitable initiatives benefiting ocean preservation, music education, and the arts.

"Music and art naturally build community," said Manasha Garcia, Jerry's wife and co-founder of Jerry Garcia Music Arts. "In welcoming fan contributions and building an accessible archive, we honor the vibrant community that grew around my husband's commitment to creative freedom, live sound innovation, and planetary stewardship."

Additional announcements regarding architectural design, programming, and scheduled developments will follow as the project progresses.

About Jerry Garcia Music Arts

Jerry Garcia Music Arts supports and curates the creative works, recordings, and visual art of Jerry Garcia, continuing his mission of artistic integrity, community connection, and philanthropy. For more information, visit jerrygarciamusicarts.com.

About Starchive

Starchive is an archival media management platform built for artists, creators, and cultural estates to organize, protect, and share their media collections with future generations. Learn more at starchive.io.

releases.title: Kim Sledge Allen of Sister Sledge Calls on the Music Industry to Demand Congress Fund the American Center for Cures
releases.body:
Ahead of the Nov. 3 midterms, Kim Sledge Allen invites Taylor Swift, Lionel Richie, Barbra Streisand and artists everywhere to take #TheCuresPledge, unite a divided country and demand immediate action to cure disease

CHICAGO, Oct. 22, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Kim Sledge Allen of Sister Sledge, the group behind the 1979 anthem "We Are Family," today called on her brothers and sisters in music and the arts to join a national movement to cure disease. In a personal audio message, Sledge Allen asked artists and faith leaders, including Taylor Swift, Lionel Richie, Barbra Streisand, Cher, Barry Manilow, Celine Dion, Tyler Perry, The Weeknd, Pastor Jamal Bryant, Pastor John Hannah, and Jesse Duplantis, to take The Cures Pledge and urge every member of Congress and the White House to fund the American Center for Cures immediately.

"This is a time of a new movement, a movement for healing," said Sledge Allen. "I am asking my brothers and sisters in the music industry and the arts to come together, support this movement and speak to our politicians, our families, our churches and our communities. It's time for these diseases to be wiped out. We have the science, we have the minds, we have the heart, we have the hope, we have the faith, and we certainly have love for one another. We are family, and we're unity strong."

Sledge Allen also lends her voice to "Unity Strong," the American Center for Cures' song, featured on the campaign's website.

"The American Center for Cures is the opportunity for the music industry to lead the path forward to preventing and curing disease," said Lou Weisbach, co-founder of the American Center for Cures. "It's 'We Are the World' on steroids: a fully funded, business-like, accountable and urgent mission that brings together, for the first time in American history, every element needed to prevent and cure disease, including the great talents of our researchers and AI. But it can only happen if the American people stand up together and remind our leaders that members of Congress and the president work for us. The days leading up to Nov. 3 are a defining moment to heal America, physically and politically."

Founded in 1999 by Weisbach and Richard Boxer, M.D., the American Center for Cures is a bipartisan initiative calling on Congress to fund a national mission to prevent and cure cancer, Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, diabetes, heart disease, ALS and other major diseases. With the midterm elections less than two weeks away, the organization is asking Americans to make curing disease the No. 1 bipartisan issue of this election.

The need is urgent. Alzheimer's, diabetes, heart disease and cancer cost the nation more than $1.1 trillion a year, according to the most recent estimates from the Alzheimer's Impact Movement, the American Diabetes Association, the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention and the National Cancer Institute. The American Center for Cures' $750 billion plan, funded through U.S. Treasury bonds over six years, would cost less than the nation now spends on these four diseases in a single year.

Once funded by Congress, the American Center for Cures would launch 16 separate private-sector efforts. Fourteen would each be charged with preventing and/or curing a single disease, with a $36 billion budget. Two additional units would receive $108 billion each, one to fund all other diseases, including orphan diseases, and one to fund artificial intelligence efforts. The remaining $30 billion would be held as a reserve fund. Each effort would be led by proven business leaders working alongside leading scientists and physicians, with clear goals and accountability for results.

Sledge Allen and the American Center for Cures are asking artists, fans and families to take The Cures Pledge before Nov. 3: record a 10-second video saying who they're waiting on a cure for, ask three people by name to do the same and post it with #TheCuresPledge. Then send it to their U.S. representative, their U.S. senators and the candidates on their ballot. Every video joins the campaign's wall, where a famous name and a family member get the same space.

"Speak to your senators, speak to your congressmen, speak to your communities, speak to one another," Sledge Allen said. "We are a human family. It's time to be one in hope and in healing."

To hear Kim Sledge Allen's message, listen to "Unity Strong" and take the pledge, visit thecurespledge.org.

About the American Center for Cures

The American Center for Cures is a bipartisan initiative founded in 1999 by Lou Weisbach and Richard Boxer, M.D., to prevent and cure the major diseases of our time, including cancer, Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, diabetes, heart disease, ALS, MS and mental illness. The American Center for Cures is a fiscally sponsored project of The Giving Back Fund, a 501(c)(3) public charity. Donations are tax deductible to the extent allowed by law. For more information, visit thecurespledge.org.

PHILADELPHIA, Miss., Oct. 22, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Country music star Lainey Wilson joined GRAMMY Award-winning artist Marty Stuart and community leaders Tuesday for the unveiling of "Wildflowers and Wild Horses," a new mural honoring Wilson in downtown Philadelphia, Mississippi.
releases.title: Lainey Wilson Joins Marty Stuart for Unveiling of "Wildflowers and Wild Horses" Mural in Downtown Philadelphia, Mississippi
releases.body:
New mural installation by artist A'Darrius Hanible celebrates the country music star as part of the Congress of Country Music's growing public art initiative

PHILADELPHIA, Miss., Oct. 22, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Country music star Lainey Wilson joined GRAMMY Award-winning artist Marty Stuart and community leaders Tuesday for the unveiling of "Wildflowers and Wild Horses," a new mural honoring Wilson in downtown Philadelphia, Mississippi.

"Lainey Wilson is not only a dear friend, but someone who understands the meaning of home," said Marty Stuart. "She knows that no matter how far life takes you or how high your dreams carry you, nothing can replace the people and places that shaped who you are. Lainey came here for this mural unveiling and her fundraiser performances for the Congress of Country Music on nothing more than a hug and a handshake. No contract, no formalities, just friendship, trust and a shared love for where we come from. That tells you everything you need to know about who Lainey Wilson is, and I am so thankful for her support of the Congress of Country Music."

Created by artist A'Darrius Hanible, the mural takes its name and inspiration from Wilson's hit song and celebrates an artist whose distinctive sound, storytelling and authenticity have helped shape a new generation of country music.

The unveiling is part of Marty Stuart's Congress of Country Music's ongoing public art initiative, which brings country music's history and cultural influence to life through murals honoring some of the genre's most recognizable artists.

Wilson attended the ceremony and addressed community members and fans gathered to celebrate the new installation.

"This mural is absolutely beautiful, and I'm so grateful the warm welcome I've received here," said Lainey Wilson. "I brought some of my Mississippi friends along for a little picking and grinning, and that's exactly what I want tonight to be about. A chance to step away from the craziness of everyday life, come together and celebrate the heart of country music. At the end of the day, country music is about storytelling, and there's nothing better than sharing those stories with good people."

The mural was made possible through the support of Aalwese Properties, Hill Real Estate, lafedericks.com, Brent and Annette Federick, and the Riviera Motor Hotel, whose contributions reflect the community's continued investment in downtown Philadelphia's growing arts and cultural landscape.

"Wildflowers and Wild Horses" joins a growing collection of murals throughout downtown Philadelphia honoring influential country music artists and songwriters. The initiative builds on the Congress of Country Music's mission to preserve the genre's heritage while creating new opportunities for residents and visitors to experience its enduring influence.

About Marty Stuart's Congress of Country Music

Marty Stuart's Congress of Country Music is the spiritual home of country music, committed to touching lives by sharing experiences through exhibits, education and performances that inspire dreams for generations. The Congress aspires to touch lives through a real diversity of offerings in an authentic place unlike any other. Unique live performances, exhibits which honor both legends and newcomers and substantial educational offerings reach audiences across the state and country. Major performing artists are regularly featured alongside a solid season of events, integrated with revolving exhibits in collaboration with the Country Music Hall of Fame and Museum. Our educational offerings will touch all ages and can be accredited and recognized for their influence.
