releases.title: Lumara Film Festival Announces Finalists for Inaugural AI Film Festival
releases.body:
Presented by MoonPay and Venice, the inaugural Lumara Film Festival festival received more than 700 submissions from filmmakers worldwide and today reveals six finalists competing for the Grand Prize and Jury Selection, with winners announced live at the World Premiere at the Roxy Hotel Cinema in New York on October 26. The evening will also feature an exclusive extended prologue of jury member and AI filmmaker Gossip Goblin's new film "Gods Don't Give Gifts.", the first-ever AI film slated for a wide theatrical release at the end of this year.

NEW YORK, Oct. 16, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Lumara Film Festival, an independent film festival for the artists defining a new era of filmmaking, presented by MoonPay and Venice, has announced the six finalists competing for its Grand Prize and Jury Selection awards and the 16 nominees for its five category awards.

Lumara was created to find and celebrate the films coming out of a transformative moment for cinema. AI has given filmmakers a new set of tools and a new creative language that opens the door to opportunities otherwise unavailable to many. Submissions were open from July 24 to September 15 and drew more than 700 films. Entry was free and open worldwide, and filmmakers could use any AI filmmaking platform available.

Films were evaluated by a jury of the world's leading AI filmmakers and internet-culture figures including Voidstomper, Gossip Goblin, Chris White (executive producer, A24's "Backrooms"), JBoogxCreative, Heavy Pulp, SÜNDERMANN, BLVCKL!GHT, Ansem and FaZe Banks. Films were judged on the strength of the idea, the quality of the storytelling, and how well the filmmaker used AI.

The six finalists will now move into competition for the Grand Prize of $32,000 and 3.2 million Venice AI credits and the Jury Selection award of $20,000 and 2 million Venice AI credits.

The finalists are:

  • "Black Thunder" (Ryan Lightbourn)
  • "Candy" (Jiaze Li)
  • "Gabriel" (T Zhang)
  • "Killabears – The Broadcast" (Mikael Tyrsen)
  • "Living with a Merman" (Chris Capel)
  • "Mianmian" (Yingjie Chen)

This year's categories and their nominees include:

  • Terminal Award (best experimental film), $12,000 and 1.2 million Venice AI credits
    • "REVIVER" (Aleksey Dor)
    • "Stories My Great Great Great Grandmother Told Me" (Philippe Noguchi)
    • "THE LAST TRIBE" (Stephane Benini)
  • Serenissima Award (best film made with Venice), $12,000 and 1.2 million Venice AI credits
    • "Black Thunder" (Ryan Lightbourn)
    • "Er Loop" (Marco Magario)
    • "Never Forget" (Allan Ecax)
  • Get Shorty Award (best film under two minutes), $8,000 and 800,000 Venice AI credits
    • "Ato de [Later]" (Luke Mazey)
    • "COMPULSION" (Gyuseon Lee)
    • "Do Not Disturb" (Adrian Daniel Botnariu)
    • "Summer Afternoon, July 1994" (Charlie Park)
  • Mouse Award (best film for children or young adults), $8,000 and 800,000 Venice AI credits
    • "Far away home" (Siping Song)
    • "FIX" (Eunha Lee, Sora Lee and Hakhoon Lee)
    • "Roraima" (Ishan Devare Modi)
  • Rekt Award (best satire, comedy or musical about finance, markets or crypto), $8,000 and 800,000 Venice AI credits
    • "Great Pepe Wars" (Aiden Guo)
    • "JUST SAY SOLANA" (Yassine Le Gall)
    • "ROLL EVERYTHING" (Ashanth Phillips)

The winner of each category award will be announced on the Venice and MoonPay channels.

The finalists will be screened in full at the inaugural Lumara screening and awards night taking place on October 26 at the Roxy Hotel Cinema in New York City, with winners announced at the event.

The evening will also include screenings of the category-winning films, and new work previews from members of the jury, including an exclusive an exclusive extended prologue of Gossip Goblin's new film God's Don't Give Gifts, the first AI film slated for a wide theatrical release at the end of this year.

The winning films will premiere online on X and YouTube on October 27.

About MoonPay

MoonPay is a global financial technology company that provides infrastructure for moving value across traditional and digital financial systems. Founded in 2019, MoonPay serves more than 35 million customers in 180 countries and more than 1500 enterprise clients across crypto and fintech. Its products support payments, trading, commerce, stablecoin infrastructure and other services that connect conventional payment networks with blockchain-based financial rails. MoonPay maintains regulatory licenses and authorizations in multiple jurisdictions, including the United States and European Union. For more information, visit www.moonpay.com.

About Venice

Venice is a privacy-first AI platform built for unlimited creative freedom. It gives filmmakers unrestricted access to the world's leading video, image and audio models in one private workspace, alongside frontier text and code models, without censorship and without surveillance. Trusted by 5 million users, Venice runs leading video models including Seedance 2.5, image models from OpenAI, Google and xAI, and voice and music generation, so a filmmaker can make the story exactly as they envision it, rather than the one a platform allows. Venice is accessible through its app and API. Learn more at venice.ai.

releases.title: TRAILER PARK PAM Announces Album Release Following Brief, 25-Year Strategic Pause
releases.body:
LOS ANGELES, Oct. 16, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Recorded in 2001. Held back for the good of rock 'n' roll. TRAILER PARK PAM has arrived.

As Universal Music Entertainment debuts the self-titled original album today, the band is finally ready to reveal its bold strategy: wait 25 years for rock 'n' roll to be declared dead, then unveil an album recorded when it was still breathing.

The band — Keith Megna on vocals, his brother David Megna on bass, Hans Hettich on lead guitar, and Chuck Sparks on drums — spent the last quarter century allowing the world to catch up.

"We could see where things were headed in 2001," said lead singer Keith Megna. "We figured we'd let the entire music industry change, collapse, rebuild itself, and then see if Friday was a good day to release it."

"The time is now," said David Megna. "Some bands are ahead of their time. We wanted documentation."

Former manager John Asher confirmed that the delay was absolutely intentional.

"A lot of people would call this an unreleased album," said Asher. "We prefer an extremely exclusive listening period."

This time capsule recording, produced by Jerry Harrison of Talking Heads, will make you want to call your Mom after listening to the heartfelt "Photo Memories." Break out an old Hendrix vinyl after exorcising the ghosts of "Falling Stars."  Or smash your TV by the time "Talk Circus" reaches its final chord. 

Now, after surviving the death of the CD, the rise of streaming, and several generations of people explaining that rock is dead, TRAILER PARK PAM is ready to be unearthed.

The wait is over.

Out October 16, 2026 on all streaming platforms.

Listen Now – TRAILER PARK PAM

releases.title: STACY POLLEY'S ACT VI FOR THE FORK IT FUND BROUGHT MUSIC, COMMUNITY AND PURPOSE TO SONY HALL IN SUPPORT OF ALZHEIMER'S PREVENTION RESEARCH
releases.body:
NEW YORK, Oct. 15, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The Fork It Fund, a program dedicated to advancing transformational research focused on the prevention of Alzheimer's disease and all other dementias, brought together supporters, caregivers and friends for Act VI, an evening of music, performance and philanthropy on Thursday, October 8 at Sony Hall in New York City.

The evening raised over $1.2 million for prevention-focused research while recognizing the caregivers and families touched by the disease. Founded in 2019 by Stacy Polley and Daryl and Irwin Simon, the Fork It Fund has raised more than $5 million for research in partnership with the Alzheimer's Association, the world's leading nonprofit funder of Alzheimer's research.

For Polley, a former Goldman Sachs Partner, Act VI held special meaning. Her acclaimed "Acts" began as a creative passion, rooted in the love of music and theater her father, a musician, nurtured in her from an early age and carried with her throughout her life. As his Alzheimer's progressed, that passion grew into a mission to fund the research that could spare other families the same experience. Following his passing this past summer, this year's performance became a tribute to the man who first taught her the joy of the stage.

"My Acts began as something creative and joyful, but as my father's Alzheimer's progressed, they came to mean so much more to me," said Polley. "Act VI was a chance to honor my father, celebrate caregivers like my mother who give so much, and bring people together around a disease that has touched so many families. My hope is that the joy we created together will help fund the science that changes the story for future generations."

The Fork It Fund's mission is rooted in the belief that prevention research and early detection are essential. The Fund supports research working to understand how Alzheimer's can be detected and addressed early, while building a community that raises awareness of steps people can take to support their brain health and lower their risk.

Act VI carried that mission forward, bringing guests together for an evening of connection and remembrance, united by the belief that scientific progress and human connection can change what is possible.

releases.title: Plex and Fandango Turn Movie Discovery Into Theatrical Ticket Sales
releases.body:
New integration creates a direct path from discovery to purchase, giving studios and advertisers a new

way to reach high-intent moviegoers

LOS ANGELES, Oct. 15, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Plex, the global streaming platform for discovering, watching and connecting around entertainment, and Fandango, the nation's leading online movie ticketer, today announced an integration that creates a direct path from movie discovery to theatrical ticketing by allowing users to purchase tickets as they explore films on Plex. For studios, distributors and advertisers, the collaboration creates a new way to drive ticket sales at the point of discovery.

Starting today, Plex users in the U.S. will see a Fandango ticketing option on title pages for movies currently playing in theaters, allowing them to click through to Fandango to find showtimes and purchase tickets. The integration also enables direct attribution through Kochava, giving studios and advertisers greater visibility into how campaigns and audience engagement translate into ticket sales.

Plex users make more than 100 million streaming decisions each month, with more than 45 million users creating watchlists. Combined with search, ratings and cross-platform viewing, these signals give Plex insight into audience intent, while Fandango's reach across 31,000 U.S. screens provides a direct path from discovery to ticket purchase

"Our vision is to make Plex the place where people can discover what to watch, regardless of where that content lives. Fandango lets us extend that experience to all theatrical releases in the U.S., giving fans an easy way to act once they find a movie they want to see," Scott Olechowski, Chief Product Officer and Co-Founder at Plex. "For studios and advertisers, we're also creating a more measurable path from discovery to purchase, helping marketers understand which campaigns are converting, so they can use those insights to make their media work harder."

"Plex has a unique view into what movie fans are actively considering, from what they're searching for to what they're watching across services," said Jerramy Hainline, EVP, Fandango. "By connecting those discovery signals with Fandango ticketing, we're making it easier for fans to turn that interest into a trip to the theater, while giving studios and advertisers a more direct, measurable path to ticket sales."

Fans can purchase tickets on Fandango now via watch.plex.tv. Visuals available here.

About Plex

Plex is the social entertainment app made for movie and TV lovers, available in more than 180 countries and territories. It brings discovery, community, and free streaming together in one place, making it easier to enjoy everything entertainment has to offer. Discover what's streaming across platforms and playing in theaters, see what friends are watching, swap recommendations, and keep track of everything on your watchlist. Plus, stream thousands of free movies and shows, watch hundreds of free live TV channels, rent premium new releases, and organize and stream your own personal media collection.

Plex. Your watch starts here. For more, visit watch.plex.tv or follow @plex.tv on X, Facebook and Instagram.

About Fandango 

Fandango is the premier digital destination for movie and TV fans, delivering entertainment experiences across discovery, ticketing, reviews, and at-home streaming. Serving more than 50 million unique visitors monthly, Fandango is the leading online movie ticketer across more than 31,000 U.S. movie screens, operates Rotten Tomatoes, the world's leading entertainment review platform, and offers a premium video-on-demand service featuring more than 300,000 new-release and catalog movies and TV shows, including one of the industry's largest selections of 4K UHD titles. The portfolio also includes Fandango1, which provides exhibitors with a modern, cloud-based cinema operating platform that powers ticketing, concessions, loyalty, payments and more for cinema locations worldwide and Fandango FanClub, which gives fans access to exclusive perks and rewards. Fandango helps fans discover, watch, collect, and enjoy entertainment wherever and whenever they choose.

releases.title: Cineverse and Trevor Henderson to Adapt Hit Horror Podcast 'Mayfair Watchers Society' into a Feature Film
releases.body:
From the Mind Behind Siren Head and Cartoon Cat, and one of the Hottest Indie Creators, with Recent Studio Deals with Warner Bros. and TriStar

Feature Film Comes as Season 4 of the Scripted Audio Series Set to Launch on the Cineverse Podcast Network

LOS ANGELES, Oct. 15, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Cineverse (Nasdaq: CNVS), an entertainment technology company and studio, has made a deal with Trevor Henderson, creator of Siren Head and Cartoon Cat, to adapt the hit horror podcast Mayfair Watchers Society into a feature film. Downloaded more than three million times since premiering on audio on October 10, 2022, the Mayfair Watchers Society story will continue both on the big screen and through the podcast, which premieres its fourth season soon with the Cineverse Podcast Network.

This agreement comes at a time during which Hollywood demand for Henderson's viral online creations has exploded. Earlier this year, Warner Bros. Pictures won a bidding war to turn Henderson's Siren Head character into a movie, with Zach Cregger and Brian Duffield attached. Another of his popular and terrifying characters, Cartoon Cat, is being adapted into a film by Sony's TriStar Pictures, with Roy Lee producing. 

"It has truly been the year that online creators have planted their flag as the new generation of horror filmmakers and characters. This deal to expand our relationship with Trevor, and adapt this podcast into a feature with him, presents a great opportunity for us, him, and his fans, and we can't wait," said Cineverse Chief Motion Pictures Officer Yolanda Macias.

Since successfully bringing Terrifier 2 and Terrifier 3 to theatres, the Cineverse Motion Pictures Group has shown a commitment to supporting filmmakers with unique creative visions and IP with loyal, passionate fanbases. This includes the 20th anniversary release of Guillermo del Toro's masterpiece, Pan's Labyrinth, which opened in theatres October 8.

"There hasn't been a box office movement in years as transformational as the success seen by online creators with Iron Lung, Backrooms, and Obsession. We're incredibly fortunate to be in a position where we can use our platforms to work with independent artists and bring their visions to life reaching audiences in entirely new ways. Mayfair Watchers Society has been an incredible collaboration with Trevor, and I can't wait to continue that partnership and bring Mayfair to the big screen," said Cineverse VP Network Strategy and Co-founder, Bloody Disgusting, Tom Owen.

The feature will be a found footage style anthology film highlighting different creatures and stories from the podcast. These include The Needle, Creekman, Owls with Teeth, Mr. Bag, Anxious Dogs, Scissors, and The Clatter.

"The Cineverse and Bloody Disgusting teams have been great partners on the podcast, and I've long been impressed with the film side of the company, and its indie philosophy. I look forward to being very hands-on with adapting the podcast into a feature, and look forward to working closely with them as we develop the film, select the directing and writing teams, and get closer to bringing this to fans," said Henderson, who will be a producer and part of the writing team.

The Mayfair Watchers Society podcast is an original production of Bloody FM, Cineverse Podcast Network's horror brand. Created by Henderson and Pacific Obadiah, and produced by Obadiah, Mayfair Watchers Society is presented as a collection of found tapes and audio accounts, each episode focusing on different residents encountering Henderson's iconic style of monsters. It was chosen by Apple as one of the most popular podcasts when it debuted in 2022, and has been a top 50 podcast and the #2-ranked fiction podcast on both Apple and Spotify.

Trevor Henderson is represented by Verve, Redshift, and Marios Rush. The deal was negotiated by Macias and Cineverse VP Creative Development and Filmmaker Relations Steven Peros.

About Cineverse Motion Pictures Group

Cineverse super-serves passionate audiences by distributing content across all windows and platforms, from theatrical to digital to physical. Following the breakout box office success of Terrifier 3, recent theatrical releases include the franchise returns of The Toxic Avenger, Silent Night, Deadly Night, and Return to Silent Hill, and the 20th anniversary release of Guillermo del Toro's masterpiece Pan's Labyrinth. On Cineverse's upcoming slate are the third installment of Wolf Creek and the company's first theatrical family feature, Air Bud Returns.

About Cineverse

Cineverse (Nasdaq: CNVS) is an entertainment technology company and studio. Fiercely innovative and independent, Cineverse develops and invests in technology and content that drives the future of the industry. Core to its business is Matchpoint® – a growing tech ecosystem designed to prepare, distribute, monetize, and continuously improve content across any platform. Matchpoint helps studios large and small operate at scale and improve performance and efficiency in an increasingly fragmented distribution environment. Additionally, Cineverse distributes a vast library of premium films, series, and podcasts, across theatrical, home entertainment, and streaming; operates dozens of digital properties that super serve passionate fandoms around the world; and works with leading brands to connect them with audiences they value. From award-winning technology to the highest-grossing unrated film in U.S. history, Cineverse has created a playbook that marries tech and content to redefine the next era of entertainment. For more information, visit cineverse.com.

  • Debut programming includes original microdrama Alquilé Un Novio Para Navidad and a national call for Latino-produced family and faith films

NEW YORK, Oct. 15, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Great American Media is expanding its investment in Latino audiences with today's launch of Pure Flix Familia, a new streaming destination created for families seeking culturally relevant entertainment rooted in faith, family and shared values.

Pure Flix Familia launches in Spanish, with bilingual and English stories for Latino audiences to follow.

Launching during Hispanic Heritage Month and at the start of the Christmas family-viewing season, Pure Flix Familia will debut with Spanish-language entertainment that will continuously grow to include English-language, and bilingual storytelling created and curated for Latino audiences.

"Great American Pure Flix is the leading faith-and-family streaming service, and Pure Flix Familia will build on that foundation with programming and experiences created specifically for Latino families," said Bill Abbott, President and CEO of Great American Media. "Faith and family are at the heart of Great American Media, and those values have deep roots within the Latino community. We are committed to working with talented Latino creators to tell authentic, compelling stories and to building a trusted entertainment destination for families in the United States and around the world."

Pure Flix Familia represents the next step in Great American Media's continued growth, extending the company's faith-and-family mission to a new audience while complementing the programming available on Great American Pure Flix. First announced in December 2025, Pure Flix Familia is being developed around a Total Latino Market strategy that recognizes how today's Latino audiences move across languages, cultures, countries and generations. Rather than defining viewers solely by language preference, the platform will serve a broad spectrum of the Latino experience, connected by culture, family and shared values.

The market opportunity is significant. According to Nielsen's 2025 Diverse Intelligence Series report, U.S. Hispanics represent more than $4.1 trillion in purchasing power, while streaming accounts for 55.8% of their total television viewing time, compared with 46% for the overall U.S. population.

At launch, Pure Flix Familia will offer original, licensed and Spanish-dubbed movies, series, family entertainment, and faith-centered storytelling. Programming will reflect the humor, romance, faith, traditions, family relationships, and multigenerational experiences that are part of Latino life.

Great American Media is working with Minivela, the Latino media, entertainment, and production company co-founded by media entrepreneur Manny Ruiz and actor-producer Carlos Ponce, as the programming, content and creative partner for Pure Flix Familia. Ruiz and Ponce bring decades of experience working within the Latino community and across Hispanic media and entertainment.

"We approached Pure Flix because we saw an opportunity for more wholesome entertainment created with Latino families in mind, and they immediately understood the need," Ponce said. "Families shouldn't have to choose between stories that authentically reflect their culture and entertainment they feel good about bringing into their homes. Pure Flix Familia brings those two things together."

The debut slate will feature Pure Flix Familia's first original microdrama, Alquilé Un Novio Para Navidad, produced by Pure Flix Familia in association with Minivela. The faith-based microdrama follows a woman who enlists the perfect boyfriend to keep her family's Noche Buena gathering questions at bay—only to discover that real feelings weren't part of the deal. A little holiday pretending turns into a lot of romantic chaos in this heartwarming Christmas romcom.

In partnership with Chicano Hollywood, and a coalition of Latino film festival leaders, Pure Flix Familia will also support Latino storytellers through a national call for Latino-produced feature films and short films centered on family and/or faith. Selected projects will be considered for licensing or acquisition, creating a new pathway for filmmakers and independent producers seeking a home for culturally authentic, values-driven storytelling. Submission criteria and deadlines will be announced separately.

The October launch also brings Pure Flix Familia to audiences as the Christmas viewing season begins, building on one of Great American Media and Pure Flix's signature programming strengths. Great American Pure Flix offers an extensive collection of Christmas movies and series, giving Pure Flix Familia a strong foundation for serving families during one of the most family-centered times of the year.

The U.S. debut represents the first step in Great American Media's longer-term vision for Pure Flix Familia, with the company ultimately looking to serve audiences throughout Latin America and Spain and build a global Latino and Spanish-language faith and family entertainment brand.

Additional announcements regarding Pure Flix Familia's complete launch slate, subscription options, supported devices and availability will be made in the coming weeks.

ABOUT GREAT AMERICAN MEDIA

Great American Media is the leader in faith and family entertainment, and one of the fastest-growing entertainment networks on television. Great American Media is home to a portfolio of entertainment brands that celebrate faith, family, and country, including Great American Family, the flagship linear network featuring original Christmas movies, rom-coms, and beloved series; Great American Pure Flix, the leading faith and family streaming service; Great American Faith & Living, the unscripted companion network; and GFam+, an app that lets viewers watch anytime, anywhere. Great American Media, established in June 2021 by Bill Abbott and a group of US-based family offices, is available via cable, streaming on Pure Flix and YouTube TV, and on the GFam+ app.

ABOUT PURE FLIX FAMILIA

Pure Flix Familia is Great American Media's Latino-focused streaming destination for culturally relevant entertainment centered on family and faith. Created around a Total Latino Market strategy, the platform is designed to serve Spanish-dominant, bilingual and English-dominant audiences through movies, series, original microdramas and curated programming that families can confidently enjoy together.

releases.title: Human Diamonds: A New Blueprint for AI Companies to Prove Their Value to Humanity
releases.body:
Event Horizon Film Studio LLC announces Scott Hadley Morgan's vision for combining AI, entertainment, and human connection in a new digital ecosystem.

LOS ANGELES, Oct. 15, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Can AI companies compete to become the best for humanity while still winning the race to dominate their markets? In his book Human Diamonds, writer, producer, and director Scott Hadley Morgan explores a different way to approach that challenge.

Morgan began developing his ideas in 2018, building a framework that starts with physics and expands into astrophysics, biology, geology, and chemistry. His conclusion is that AI needs an environment where its impact can be explored through real human engagement. His proposed answer is the Multiverse, an entertainment, shopping, and social platform designed to bring AI companies and people together.

AI Gems: Where Loyalty Becomes Valuable

Morgan calls participating individuals and groups "AI Gems" because he believes their loyalty and engagement could become precious to AI companies, much like diamonds. Individuals could build their own presence, while communities, student organizations, and other groups could form Gem Teams and earn rewards.

"Let's say Anthropic offers to pay student debt for a fraternity if it uses only their AI in this Multiverse," Morgan explains. He envisions additional activities, such as debate teams, creating opportunities for further rewards and real-world benefits.

Morgan sees this as a new way for AI companies to build loyalty by giving people tangible reasons to participate. He compares the opportunity to the early growth of Google, when user participation helped establish its dominance in search.

Imagii: An Avatar Built Around You

Another key element is the Imagii, a personalized avatar Morgan designed around 49 apps intended to reflect different aspects of an individual's identity, interests, and aspirations. The concept begins with epigenetics, moves through technology, and extends toward personal and spiritual goals.

Morgan imagines that an AI Gem could explain a specific dream and find other Gems who have had the same dream. Combined with fantasy leagues, influencers, and interactive communities, he envisions an experience that feels like "Limitless meets Avatar."

Hollywood Meets the Future of AI

Morgan brings an award-winning career as a Hollywood writer, producer, and director to his vision. He believes storytelling has always helped humanity imagine what is possible, and that entertainment could play an essential role in making AI more engaging and beneficial to people.

Through Event Horizon Film Studio LLC, Morgan connects his entertainment background with his broader ideas about technology, creativity, and human potential.

"The power of story has uplifted humanity since our origin," Morgan says.

With Human Diamonds, Morgan invites AI professionals, investors, entertainment leaders, and anyone concerned about AI's future to explore a blueprint that puts human participation, creativity, family, and connection at the center of technological progress.

Morgan also welcomes inquiries from AI companies interested in consulting opportunities to explore how the Multiverse concept and the ideas presented in Human Diamonds could be developed to their fullest potential.

Read an excerpt from Human Diamonds and explore Morgan's video presentations at https://www.eventhorizon.studio.

For consulting inquiries, contact Scott Hadley Morgan through Event Horizon Film Studio LLC via the website.

releases.title: Korean Cultural Center New York Presents the 1st New York Korean Independent Film Festival (NYKIFF)
releases.body:
October 15–25, 2026: Exploring the Present and Future of Korean Independent Cinema

Featuring 10 Feature Films and 5 Shorts in Collaboration with Leading Korean Film Festivals

12 Directors and Film Professionals to Visit New York for Audience Q&As

NEW YORK, Oct. 14, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The Korean Cultural Center New York (KCCNY) presents the inaugural New York Korean Independent Film Festival (NYKIFF) from October 15 through 25, 2026, at the KCCNY Theater. The festival seeks to expand international screening opportunities for outstanding Korean independent films and foster meaningful exchange between Korean filmmakers and New York's film community.

Korea's independent film community produces outstanding works with the potential to resonate internationally, yet limited exhibition and distribution opportunities have kept many from reaching audiences abroad. The inaugural festival responds to this gap by providing a platform for these films in New York, bringing greater visibility to Korean independent cinema and creating opportunities for its filmmakers to gain recognition on the international stage.

Featuring 10 feature films and 5 shorts, the festival brings together a wide range of cinematic voices through a program developed in collaboration with leading Korean film festivals. 12 directors and other film professionals will visit New York to meet audiences through post-screening Q&As.

The lineup was developed in collaboration with the Seoul Independent Film Festival, Jeonju International Film Festival, Bucheon International Fantastic Film Festival, Muju Film Festival, and Mise-en-scène Short Film Festival in Korea. Spanning fiction, documentary, thriller, and action, the 15-film selection introduces New York audiences to the distinctive perspectives shaping Korean independent cinema today.

Admission is free and open to the public, but pre-registration is required.

Opening and Closing Films

The festival opens with STARS AND SAND, directed by KAM JEONGWON, winner of the Grand Prize at the 51st Seoul Independent Film Festival. KAM JEONGWON and cinematographer CHOI CHANG HWAN will attend the opening screening and participate in a post-screening Q&A. A networking reception will follow, providing an opportunity for exchange with members of the local film community.

The festival closes with THE WORLD OF LOVE, directed by YOON GA-EUN, who received the Best Director award in the film category at the 62nd Baeksang Arts Awards.

Feature Film Highlights

Director LEE WEONYOUNG will visit New York to present THE GLIMMERING, which received the Grand Prize at the Muju Film Festival, while director KIM MYUNWOO will join audiences for KARMA, an award-winning selection from the Jeonju International Film Festival. Both filmmakers will participate in post-screening Q&As.

Additional feature selections include THE ONLY CHILD IN THE BUTCHERY, SAVON, THE FIN, THE LOVE OF TRUMAN, REI'S WINTER BREAK, and THE GORALS, bringing a range of distinctive stories and cinematic approaches to New York audiences.

Mise-en-scène Shorts: Award-Winning Films and Visiting Filmmakers

Co-presented with Korea Creative Content Agency New York (KOCCANY) and Netflix Korea, the special Mise-en-scène Short Film Festival section showcases five award-winning films from the festival's 22nd edition: MY AUNT, WRONG AIM, MIXEDUP SHAMAN, NOISE CANCELLATION, and AFTER SUBMERSION.

Directors WI EUNG-KYOUNG, SON GWANG-MIN, KIM KEUNHO, CHOI JIHYE, and PARK JEONG-SU will attend to meet audiences, joined by JANG YOUNG-YEOP, ceo of Cine21, a leading Korean film magazine.

About the Korean Cultural Center New York (KCCNY)

The Korean Cultural Center New York (KCCNY), a branch of the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism of the Republic of Korea, was established in December 1979 to promote Korean culture and foster cultural exchange in New York. KCCNY presents a wide range of cultural and artistic programs, including exhibitions, performing arts, film, educational workshops, and more. At its home at 122 E 32nd Street in Manhattan, KCCNY serves as a cultural hub where audiences can discover and experience the richness of Korean culture.

releases.body:
Campaign Launches Today to Celebrate Asian Entertainment's Passionate, Global Fan Base

LE SSERAFIM to Curate an Exclusive Watch List of Their Favorite Asian Series for Viki Fans

SAN MATEO, Calif., Oct. 14, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Rakuten Viki, the leading destination for Asian entertainment, has launched a new brand campaign starring global K-pop group LE SSERAFIM. "Viki Pass It On" celebrates the passionate fans powering Asian entertainment's skyrocketing global popularity with a video spot running on CTV as well as major social and digital channels. In addition, LE SSERAFIM has curated a watch list for Viki subscribers of the group members' favorite Asian series.

Created in partnership with creative agency UNFOLD, "Viki Pass It On" launches today in the U.S. and other key global markets. Watch the spot here.

The campaign launches as Viki's audience approaches 130 million registered users and follows the recent premiere of Viki's original K-drama co-production Dive into You. Next up is the debut of another co-production, The Painted Soul, a Korean animated series coming to Viki on October 21.

The ad spot celebrates fans' passion for Asian entertainment. As LE SSERAFIM prepares to take the stage, the group passes around a mobile device, with each member spotlighting a favorite Viki show that reflects her personality – from addictive K-dramas and swoon-worthy C-dramas to variety shows. Each handoff captures the essence of how fan culture spreads: the thrill of discovering something you love and sharing it with your friends.

"Asian entertainment, from K-pop to Korean and Chinese dramas, has found a passionate global audience because of the extraordinary talent behind it, the compelling stories, and the fans who share it with each other," said Karen Paek, vice president of Marketing at Viki. "This campaign is a tribute to those fans, and we're proud to celebrate them alongside LE SSERAFIM."

LE SSERAFIM is a K-pop group formed in 2022 whose members include KIM CHAEWON, SAKURA, HUH YUNJIN, KAZUHA, and HONG EUNCHAE. They recently kicked off the '2026 LE SSERAFIM TOUR 'PUREFLOW,'' spanning Korea, Japan, North America, Europe, and Asia. LE SSERAFIM recently released the single album Made My Night, which was followed with appearances and live events including a headline performance at BlizzCon® 2026 and at the iHeartRadio Music Festival, becoming the first K-pop girl group to take the festival stage.

Viki is available to watch for free (with advertisements) or without advertisements through tiered subscriptions of Viki Pass Standard and Viki Pass Plus, and is available on web and several platforms via desktop, mobile, streaming devices, and connected TVs.

Follow Viki on Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube, and X.

About Rakuten Viki

Rakuten Viki is a leading global destination for Asian entertainment, attracting audiences worldwide with an extensive library of dramas, variety shows, movies, and Viki Originals from across Asia. With more than 127 million registered users in 190+ countries and territories, Viki's personalized streaming experience allows fans to discover and watch stories they love, brought to life through curated content and high-quality subtitles. Part of Rakuten Group, Inc., a global powerhouse in e-commerce and internet services, Viki and its entertainment news site Soompi connect a global community of passionate fans through Asian entertainment.

About LE SSERAFIM

LE SSERAFIM, consisting of KIM CHAEWON, SAKURA, HUH YUNJIN, KAZUHA, and HONG EUNCHAE, are the first girl group formed by SOURCE MUSIC under HYBE. Since their powerful debut in May 2022 with 1st mini album FEARLESS, they have steadily expanded their global presence. The group entered the Billboard 200 at No. 14 with 2nd mini album ANTIFRAGILE, reached No. 6 with their 1st studio album UNFORGIVEN, and most recently earned their fifth consecutive Top 10 album as 'PUREFLOW' pt. 1 debuted at No. 10. Their first English single "Perfect Night" became a global hit, followed by their first Billboard Hot 100 entry at No. 99 with "EASY." In April 2024, LE SSERAFIM became the fastest K-pop act to perform at Coachella following their debut and have taken stage at major international events including MTV VMAs and EMAs. "SPAGHETTI (feat. j-hope of BTS)" later reached No. 50 on the Billboard Hot 100, the group's highest-charting single to date, and earned a Best K-Pop nomination at the 2026 MTV Video Music Awards. The nomination marked their second at the VMAs, following their 2024 win for PUSH Performance of the Year with "EASY." In 2026, LE SSERAFIM are taking their 'PUREFLOW' world tour across Asia, North America, and Europe, alongside the release of their 2nd single album Made My Night.

releases.title: Buldak Celebrates Guinness World Records® Achievement with Original Song and Music Video "Crave the Burn"
releases.body:
Available Now Across Buldak's Official YouTube, TikTok and Instagram Channels

LOS ANGELES, Oct. 14, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Buldak is turning its Guinness World Records® achievement into a soundtrack with the release of "Crave the Burn," an original song and music video celebrating the fans who came together to make history by uploading the most videos of people eating instant noodles to TikTok in one hour. Watch the music video on Buldak's YouTube channel. 

Blending pop energy with Latin flavor and a golden vibe, Buldak's "Crave the Burn" features English and Spanish lyrics that celebrate the brand's bold spirit and the fans who made the world record possible. 

Directed by Weston Allen, the music video features choreography by Brian Esperon, as well as clips from the record-breaking attempt. The song and music video come on the heels of Buldak fans making history on October 1, when 335 qualifying videos were uploaded to TikTok in a single hour as part of the brand's Guinness World Records attempt. The total surpassed the previous record of 250 videos by 85, an increase of 34%.

For Buldak, the song is a celebration not just of the record, but of the people behind it. "'Crave the Burn' and its music video are a way to celebrate our fans, who have played such an important role in making Buldak what it is today and will continue to shape our future," said Abbas Arslan, the Vice President of Marketing at Buldak. "We're incredibly grateful to everyone who enjoys our noodles and helped make this achievement possible."

Since launching in 2012, Buldak has inspired spicy challenges, reaction videos, recipes and countless fan creations across social platforms, connecting fans through a shared love of flavor, heat and pushing their limits.

Fans can watch the "Crave the Burn" music video and follow Buldak's latest content on YouTube, TikTok and Instagram at @buldak_global.

ABOUT BULDAK

Buldak was born from a spicy chicken dish and a simple idea: what if that bold, fiery flavor could become a ramyeon? Rooted in Samyang's rich Korean heritage and launched in Korea in 2012, Buldak quickly became a spicy cult favorite, winning over fans around the world with its intense heat and unmistakable flavor. Today, Buldak has grown into a global cultural phenomenon and a favorite among Gen Z and Gen Alpha, bringing together the signature flavors of OG and Carbonara with playful energy and self-expression. As Korean food and culture continue to influence global trends, Buldak continues to push the boundaries of instant noodles, creating new flavors, experiences, and ways for fans to enjoy the brand. Buldak is part of the portfolio of brands from Samyang Foods, headquartered in Seoul, South Korea. Visit Buldak.com to learn more.

releases.title: Experience Kissimmee Launches Film Kissimmee
releases.body:
The new Kissimmee Film Commission will promote diverse filming locations, support productions and drive tourism-related economic impact.

KISSIMMEE, Fla., Oct. 14, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Experience Kissimmee announces the launch of Film Kissimmee, the official film commission for Osceola County. The commission is created to attract film, television, commercial and digital media productions, showcase the destination's diverse filming locations and expand opportunities for the local tourism economy.

Film Kissimmee will serve as a central resource for production companies, location managers and digital content creators seeking filming opportunities in Central Florida. The initiative connects industry professionals with a wide range of filming locations, local expertise and production resources to help bring stories to life in Osceola County.

"This initiative reflects the hard work of a team that saw an opportunity and took meaningful steps to bring it to life," said DT Minich, President and CEO of Experience Kissimmee. "Film Kissimmee creates a direct connection between our community and an industry that can drive visitation, support local businesses and introduce new audiences to everything Osceola County has to offer."

Nick Floyd, Experience Kissimmee's Manager of Video Production and the new Director of the Kissimmee Film Commission, will lead Film Kissimmee and oversee efforts to position Osceola County as a premier destination for film, television and commercial productions.

"Just as Osceola County is an excellent place to spend your vacation, we truly believe it is a diverse location for film and television production. And Film Kissimmee is us exploring that intersection between the two," said Floyd. "I'm beyond excited to kick off this new initiative, not just as an opportunity to showcase so many of our incredible partners, but to welcome fresh perspectives on our destination from filmmakers and producers."

One of Film Kissimmee's greatest strengths is the remarkable variety of filming environments available throughout Osceola County. Within a short distance, filmmakers can access a diverse collection of landscapes and settings that capture many sides of Florida, including natural waterways, cypress-lined wetlands, historic downtown streets, ranchlands, hospitality properties and modern innovation centers. Adding to this versatility is Kissimmee's expansive collection of vacation homes, offering filmmakers unique and production-ready settings ranging from luxurious estates and themed properties to contemporary residences and resort-style retreats, each providing distinctive backdrops for film, television and commercial productions.

To support the initiative's launch, Experience Kissimmee partnered with a professional location scout with more than 20 years of experience. The scout identified and documented more than 100 potential filming locations across Osceola County. These locations are being added to an online directory powered by Reel-Scout, an industry-leading location management platform that allows filmmakers to search available properties, review photography and access production-related information.

Beyond attracting film and television projects, Film Kissimmee is expected to create meaningful economic opportunities for local businesses. Production crews often require accommodations, dining, transportation, equipment rentals, supplies and a variety of support services while filming on location.

Those expenditures can generate additional business for hospitality operators and local service providers while supporting Experience Kissimmee's broader mission of driving tourism-related economic impact throughout Osceola County.

Looking ahead, Film Kissimmee plans to continue expanding its location database, developing educational resources for local partners and coordinating familiarization tours for producers and location managers across the United States. These tours will provide industry professionals with firsthand access to Osceola County's filming assets while fostering relationships with local businesses and property owners.

For more information about Film Kissimmee, visit filmkissimmee.com.

About Experience Kissimmee:

Experience Kissimmee, the official tourism authority for Osceola County, Florida, is dedicated to creating economic opportunities by driving tourism to the region. With a vision to be a trailblazer in destination marketing, Experience Kissimmee promotes Central Florida's diverse tourism experiences to the world. By attracting leisure travelers, meetings and conventions and sports events, the destination welcomes more than 10 million visitors annually, generating more than $11 billion in economic impact and supporting more than 41,000 local jobs. Experience Kissimmee helps position the region as a premier global destination. For more information, visit www.experiencekissimmee.com. 

About Kissimmee

Located at the heart of Florida, Kissimmee is 25 minutes from Orlando International Airport (MCO), close to world-famous theme parks and attractions, offers a variety of shopping and dining locations and provides access to natural spaces and outdoor adventures. Also known as the Vacation Home Capital of the World®, Kissimmee has approximately 50,000 options of accommodations, including sprawling hotels and resorts and more than 30,000 vacation homes ranging from two-bedroom condos to 15-bedroom mansions.

releases.title: CPKC Holiday Train begins 182-stop journey of music and giving Nov. 19
releases.body:
CALGARY, AB, Oct. 13, 2026 /CNW/ -- Canadian Pacific Kansas City (CPKC) today announced the 2026 CPKC Holiday Train program will kick off Nov. 19 in Montreal, beginning a 32-day journey in support of local food banks through music, celebration and giving, with stops in 182 communities across Canada and the United States.

"Our railroaders take great pride in bringing the Holiday Train through hundreds of communities across our network to support people facing food insecurity," said CPKC President and CEO Keith Creel. "This year, we are going farther south than we ever have before, visiting 10 communities in Texas, Louisiana, Mississippi and Missouri for the first time.

"Through the generosity of the thousands of families and fans who come out to see the Holiday Train and support local food banks, whether for the first time or as part of a long-running holiday tradition, we can spread the joy of the season and support the giving spirit of the holidays," Creel added.   

Holiday Train Highlights

  • 182 live music shows in six provinces and 13 U.S. states. The Holiday Train will visit 10 communities for the first time, with new stops in Missouri (Blue Springs), Mississippi (Meridian, Jackson), Louisiana (Vicksburg, Monroe, Ruston, DeQuincy, Leesville, Zwolle) and Texas (Port Arthur).
  • Performers include American Authors, Magic!, Maris, Chase Rice, Madeline Edwards, Allen Stone, Jamie Fine, Shawnee Kish, Rafaëlle Roy, Tyler Shaw, Sam Roberts Band, and Owen Riegling.
  • Since 1999, more than $28.3 million and over 5.6 million pounds of food for community food banks have been collected in Canada and the U.S.

For 28 years, the CPKC Holiday Train has brought communities together to support neighbours facing food insecurity. Today, millions of people across Canada and the U.S. continue to rely on food banks for assistance, making community support more important than ever. CPKC encourages attendees to bring a cash donation or non-perishable food item, with all contributions staying in the local community to help families in need.

"There's nothing quite like the magic of the CPKC Holiday Train arriving in Edmonton, bringing our community together for great music and a great cause, and ultimately helping our neighbours in need," said Marjorie Bencz, executive director of Edmonton's Food Bank, where the Holiday Train will stop Dec. 13. "As the train lights up the night, every donation of food and funds helps us give food to our neighbours. We are so grateful for the warmth and generosity of Edmontonians who bundle up, show up, and make a real difference. Thank you, CPKC Holiday Train, for visiting and helping our community." 

For the musicians taking part, the CPKC Holiday Train represents more than a performance. It is a chance to connect with communities, share holiday cheer and support families experiencing food insecurity.

"The CPKC Holiday Train is one of the most special events of the holiday season! Not only are the lights and music spectacular, but it brings people together to give back to their communities and support friends, family, neighbours and those in need," said Zac Barnett of American Authors. "We feel so fortunate to take part in the celebration that makes such a meaningful impact."

"We are so grateful to be invited back on the CPKC Holiday Train," said Nasri Atweh of Magic!. "Not only do we get to see so many beautiful parts of the world, but we get to see all the smiling faces every time they open up the train doors and give everybody that came out there in the cold a little bit of warmth and some holiday cheer. It's always been my favorite time of year."

Follow the 2026 CPKC Holiday Train journey using #CPKCHolidayTrain and join the conversation online. For the latest tour updates, event information and announcements, visit CPKC's official social media channels on X, Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn. Be aware of fake accounts impersonating CPKC or the CPKC Holiday Train, and rely on CPKC's verified channels for trusted information.

CPKC reminds all music and rail fans to keep safety top of mind and stay 15 metres or 50 feet back from the tracks when taking photos/videos or viewing the Holiday Train. Never take a picture or video standing on the track or the ballast rock and always stand back from the locomotive and rail cars.

About CPKC

With its global headquarters in Calgary, Alta., Canada, CPKC is the first and only single-line transnational railway linking Canada, the United States and México, with unrivaled access to major ports from Vancouver to Atlantic Canada to the Gulf Coast to Lázaro Cárdenas, México. Stretching approximately 20,000 route miles and employing approximately 20,000 railroaders, CPKC provides North American customers unparalleled rail service and network reach to key markets across the continent. CPKC is growing with its customers, offering a suite of freight transportation services, logistics solutions and supply chain expertise. Visit cpkcr.com to learn more about the rail advantages of CPKC.

releases.body:
First Entertainment recognized for technology innovation with CineFi; Nymbus for consulting excellence

JACKSONVILLE, Fla., Oct. 13, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- First Entertainment Credit Union and Nymbus have both been named finalists in the 2026 Credit Union Times Luminaries Awards, which honor standout leadership and innovation across the credit union industry. First Entertainment is a finalist in the Innovation in Technology: Technology Project/Rollout category for launching CineFi, the first fully digital credit union built exclusively for entertainment industry professionals, in partnership with Nymbus. Nymbus is a finalist in the Consulting Excellence: Organizations category for helping credit unions turn growth strategy into live digital brands.

Since 1967, First Entertainment has served the people behind film, television and music. The credit union saw an opportunity in Atlanta, where the entertainment industry has grown rapidly but many of the professionals who power it still bank with institutions that weren't built around their work. Through CineFi, First Entertainment is bringing financial services designed for the industry to Atlanta's growing creative workforce. Nymbus delivered the technology, market strategy, and execution to bring the brand live, and co-developed tools that help members manage variable, freelance, and project-based income, along with a prospect portal that offers financial education before a person opens an account.

CineFi runs as a sidecar brand on the cloud-native Nymbus Banking Platform, parallel to First Entertainment's existing systems, so the credit union entered a new market with no branches, no disruption to current operations and no core replacement. Since launch, CineFi has acquired over 1,700 members with over $61M in deposits.

"Our members build careers project by project, and CineFi gives them a credit union designed around how they actually earn," said Stephen Owen, CEO of First Entertainment Credit Union. "Nymbus helped us move from idea to a live brand in a new market without disrupting the members we already serve. Sharing this recognition with them makes it even more meaningful."

CineFi is one of several brands Nymbus has taken from strategy to launch through vertical banking, a growth model that helps institutions go deeper into specific communities with purpose-built digital brands. Through Nymbus Labs, the company provides market research, segmentation, brand development and go-to-market execution, then supports each brand live on its own platform.

Nymbus is also preparing its clients for AI-ready banking. In April 2026, the company launched one of the first Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers purpose-built for core banking, giving AI a single, standardized and auditable connection to core functions with role-based access controls, PII masking and full audit logging, so institutions decide which tools are enabled and where human review is required.

"Being named finalists alongside First Entertainment reflects what we set out to prove: credit unions can grow by going deeper into the communities they know best," said Jeffery Kendall, chairman and CEO of Nymbus. "CineFi shows that the right platform and strategy, delivered together, can produce measurable results in weeks. We congratulate First Entertainment on this well-deserved recognition."

The CU Times Luminaries Awards winners will be announced Nov. 5 at the Luminaries Awards gala in Orlando, Fla.

About Nymbus

Nymbus delivers a cloud-based, highly extensible, full-stack banking platform, empowering community banks and credit unions to accelerate their growth and market positioning. Founded in 2015, Nymbus modernizes legacy core systems that support both brick-and-mortar operations and digital-first institutions, and facilitates the launch of vertical banking strategies or subsidiary brands with a sidecar Core alternative.

The Nymbus Banking Platform solution delivers the technology, people, and processes to scale as your financial institution grows. For more information, visit nymbus.com.

About CineFi

Launched in 2026 by First Entertainment Credit Union, CineFi is the first fully digital credit union created for film industry professionals and aspiring talent in Atlanta, Ga. With more than 50 years of entertainment industry expertise, CineFi delivers a future-ready banking experience designed to simplify financial management for those who live and breathe the craft. Offering premium financial products, competitive rates, and tailored financial education, CineFi empowers filmmakers—above and below the line—to achieve long-term success. Beyond banking, CineFi is committed to strengthening the entertainment and creative community by supporting industry nonprofits, schools, organizations, festivals, and events that advance the art and business of filmmaking. Visit www.cinefi.com.

releases.title: Introducing FinalFinal: A New Music Collaboration Platform Built for How Creators Work Today
releases.body:
The new platform brings communication, file management, feedback, and project organization into one secure, seamless workspace

SAN DIEGO, Oct. 13, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- FinalFinal, a next-generation music collaboration platform built for producers, artists, and creative teams who require a safer, smarter, and more seamless way to create together, today announces its official launch with its web platform. With the introduction of its web experience and a fully integrated mobile app coming in early November, FinalFinal sets a new standard for how music is shared, managed, and brought to life.

Built with the modern music creator in mind, FinalFinal is more than a file-sharing tool. It's a powerful, secure workspace that supports every step of the collaborative process. With real-time version control, time-stamped edits, encrypted storage, and intuitive sharing features, FinalFinal is the first platform to fully prioritize both creative flow and content protection.

At the heart of FinalFinal is its Chat UX–driven interface, allowing collaborators to communicate, share files, manage feedback, and track progress in real time, all within a single unified environment. The result is a more connected creative process, with conversations, files, feedback, and project activity all living in one place.

"Music has become more integrated than ever, but the way artists and producers collaborate is still fragmented," said Angel "AROCK" Castillo, Founder & CEO of FinalFinal. "Creative teams and artists have long had to piece together file-sharing platforms, messages, and email threads just to finish one song. FinalFinal brings those moving parts together in one place, giving creators a more seamless way to stay connected from the first idea to the final track."

The FinalFinal platform is strategically built to streamline the entire lifecycle of music creation. Unlike competitors, it combines:

  • Chat-Based Collaboration (Chat UX): Real-time conversations directly tied to files, versions, and project milestones - keeping all context in one place.
  • Integrated Project Management: Track sessions, assign responsibilities, monitor progress, and manage deliverables without leaving the platform.
  • Simple, Intuitive Interface: Designed for creatives, making it easy to onboard and use immediately.
  • Cross-Device Accessibility: A web experience available at launch, with a mobile app coming in early November to enable seamless collaboration across mobile and desktop from anywhere in the world.

The approach transforms FinalFinal from a tool into a workflow engine, giving creators clarity, speed, and control across every project. The platform includes core features such as:

  • Real-Time Version Control: Track every change, take, and edit with full visibility into contributor activity.
  • Time-Stamped Sessions: Automatically document creative progress and protect intellectual property.
  • Secure Cloud-Based Storage: Industry-grade encryption ensures assets remain protected at all times.
  • Smart Sharing & Permissions: Granular control over who can access, edit, or distribute files.
  • Unified Collaboration Environment: Replace scattered tools with a single, cohesive workspace.

"FinalFinal addresses the pain points everyday creators face – lost files, overwritten versions, and disconnected communication," Castillo added. "The platform puts creative control back in the hands of artists while giving teams the infrastructure to move faster and more confidently. Whether you're working in Los Angeles, London, or your bedroom studio, FinalFinal makes collaboration feel immediate, connected, and effortless."

Creators can sign up for a complimentary account at finalfinal.pro to gain early access to the platform. The FinalFinal mobile app is will be available beginning in early November.

For more information about FinalFinal, visit finalfinal.pro and follow @FinalFinal.pro on Instagram and @FinalFinal_Pro on YouTube.

About FinalFinal

FinalFinal is a music technology company founded by artists, engineers, and producers committed to redefining collaboration. Built for the fast-paced, always-on nature of modern music creation, FinalFinal delivers a secure, intelligent, and seamless environment where creativity can thrive without compromise.

releases.title: Sammie Continues His Musical Journey With New Single "GOYARD," Following "Old Alone" and "AYO"
releases.body:
The R&B singer and songwriter continues his latest run of releases with "GOYARD," arriving October 16, featuring a new music video directed by PhillyFlyBoy.

ATLANTA, Oct. 12, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- R&B singer and songwriter Sammie continues his latest musical run with the release of his new single, "GOYARD," arriving Friday, October 16, 2026. Following the releases of "Old Alone" and "AYO," Sammie keeps the music coming with a new record accompanied by an official music video directed by PhillyFlyBoy, who also directed the videos for "Old Alone" and "AYO."

With a career spanning more than two decades, Sammie continues to evolve as an artist while maintaining his connection with R&B audiences. His latest releases demonstrate his ongoing commitment to creating new music and giving listeners fresh material to experience. Following "Old Alone" and the success of "AYO," "GOYARD" represents the next installment in this series of releases.

Sammie first captured national attention in 1998 after appearing on the television talent competition Showtime at the Apollo. In 2000, he released his debut album, From the Bottom to the Top, which achieved Gold certification from the Recording Industry Association of America (RIAA). The album established him as one of the young R&B voices to watch and laid the foundation for a career that has continued to evolve across multiple stages of the music industry.

After taking time to focus on his education, Sammie continued his recording career with his self-titled sophomore album in 2006. His subsequent projects include Indigo, Coming of Age, Everlasting, and Such Is Life. Through his evolving catalog, Sammie has demonstrated his longevity in R&B, continuing to release music and connect with listeners across generations.

Throughout his career, Sammie has also maintained a strong presence on the live performance circuit, sharing the stage with other established R&B artists and participating in major touring productions. In 2017, he joined Tank on the Savage Tour. In 2019, Sammie continued his touring activity with The Everlasting Tour. Sammie was also featured in The Millennium Tour in 2020, 2021, and 2024, performing alongside a lineup of celebrated R&B and Hip-Hop artists. He also toured with Eric Bellinger on the Vibes on Vibes Tour, adding another chapter to his live performance history and collaborative work within the genre. These appearances helped keep him connected with audiences across multiple generations and reinforced his place within the contemporary R&B landscape.

For "GOYARD," Sammie continues his creative partnership with PhillyFlyBoy, following their collaborations on the music videos for "Old Alone" and "AYO." The director returns to bring the new single to life visually, giving fans another opportunity to experience the collaboration between the singer and filmmaker. With "Old Alone" and "AYO" preceding the upcoming release, Sammie continues to build his current body of work one single at a time. "GOYARD" carries that progression forward, pairing his R&B artistry with a familiar creative collaborator and giving fans another release to experience. Their continued partnership connects the releases while allowing "GOYARD" to establish its own identity. "GOYARD" will be released by Star Camp Entertainment in partnership with Santi Music, and distributed by Vydia, a gamma company.

Throughout his career, Sammie has maintained a connection with the fans who have supported him through different stages of his musical journey. As he shares "GOYARD," he is expressing his appreciation for that continued support and inviting listeners to be part of the conversation surrounding his latest music.

"First and foremost, I want to thank my fans for the love and support you've shown me throughout my career. You've been with me through so many chapters of my musical journey, and I never take that for granted. I'm excited to share 'GOYARD' with you, and I'm really looking forward to hearing your feedback. Your continued support means everything to me, and I can't wait for you all to hear and see what we've been working on." — Sammie

Fans can follow Sammie on Instagram at @sammiealways for updates on "GOYARD" and its accompanying music video. "GOYARD" arrives Friday, October 16, 2026.

ABOUT SAMMIE

Sammie is an American R&B singer and songwriter whose career began in childhood. His accomplishments include a Gold-certified debut album, charting singles, songwriting contributions, and a diverse catalog of studio albums and independent releases. With a career spanning more than two decades, he continues to create music, perform live, and connect with R&B audiences worldwide.

ABOUT STAR CAMP ENTERTAINMENT AND SANTI MUSIC

Star Camp Entertainment is an independent record label owned by Sammie and working in partnership with Santi Music owned by his manager, Melinda Santiago. Their releases are distributed by Vydia, a gamma company.

releases.body:

COBOURG, ON, Oct. 12, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Celtic folk duo Lo & the High Road have released their sophomore album, 'Standing Stones,' a 14-track record that trades some of the whimsy of their debut for something noticeably darker, both musically and lyrically.

Written by Lauren Halász and Colin McMahon, the album reaches into Greek mythology and real historical darkness, with "The Weaver" reimagining Arachne's myth as a sea shanty, "God of the River" drawing on Book 21 of the Iliad to explore humanity's relationship with nature, and lead single "Salem" pulling directly from the Salem Witch Trials, pushing further into indie rock territory than anything else in the duo's catalogue. Still, pockets of light remain: "Canaries" reworks a bright Renaissance lute tune, and the duo's take on "Wild Mountain Thyme" honours one of the best loved folk melodies from Scotland and Ireland.

The title track began as Colin's idea for a song about community and platonic love, inspired by the Bronze Age monuments themselves, ancient structures whose original purpose remain unknown even to historians. "I have this idea that the earth remembers, even if people do not," Halász says, a thought that shapes the song's bridge and its bonfire gathering, built to feel flung back in time with help from guest musicians Saskia Tomkins on nyckelharpa, a Swedish keyed violin dating back over 600 years, and Steáfán Hannigan on uilleann pipes, Irish flute and whistle.

Based in Cobourg, Ontario, Lo & the High Road has built one of Canadian folk's most devoted followings, drawing coverage from Cashbox Canada, Tinnitist, Celtic Life International and Record World International across the singles leading up to this release.

Their 2023 debut, 'Jackalope Tales (& other stories),' has surpassed 2.8 million Spotify streams, and the band has amassed more than 200,000 social media followers worldwide, many of whom turn to their music for tabletop role playing soundtracks, woodland weddings and Renaissance faires.

A successful 2026 tour carried the duo, joined live by Dave Finneran, Christine Dando and Jordan Baldwin, from Toronto to Halifax, including stops at Port Hope's Cultivate Festival and Kingston's Ironwood Fantasy Fair, and 'Standing Stones' arrives ready to carry that momentum even further into the far ranging, myth-soaked world they've spent two albums building.

releases.body:

FORT ERIE, ON, Oct. 12, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Fort Erie, Ontario blues and roots rocker René Huard has released his new single "Tail Waggin'," out now and giving fans their first taste of his forthcoming album 'Gently Used', arriving November 5, 2026.

The song traces back to an old bit of guitar-world folklore. René Huard explains: "Based on an anecdotal urban legend, jazz guitarist Wes Montgomery replied to a journalist's question, 'Do you find time to practice guitar while you're touring?' Wes quipped, 'I just open the guitar case every once and a while, and toss a chunk steak in.' Ding-a-ling-a-ling, went the Pavlovian songwriter bell in my brain. Life on the road, wearisome, tedious, sometimes perilous! Didn't B.B. King run into a burning building to save Lucille? Guitar man's best friend, sharp teeth and strings that bend."

"Tail Waggin'" leads into 'Gently Used', an eleven-track collection written and performed by René Huard on vocals, guitar and harmonica, produced by longtime collaborator Rick Taylor, who also contributes guitar and vocals.

On the road, and recording studio, Huard is backed by the Project band, featuring Rick Taylor on guitar and vocals, Jeff Muir on bass and Peter Griffin on drums, with special guest contributions to the record from: Chris Airyes and Thomas Nelson on vocals, Alistair Robertson on saxophone and Ed Roth on keys.

Huard's musical roots run four decades deep from his early days fronting the Meteors, who opened for blues heavyweights James Cotton, Long John Baldry and the Downchild Blues Band, and appeared at the first-ever Ottawa Blues Festival. He's also known to Canadian audiences as the former host of the television series Antique Hunter and Antique Style.

His previous album, 'Blues Calling', produced by Jack de Keyzer, climbed into the Top 20 on the Roots Music Report and held the number eleven spot for several months. Its lead single, "Hard Times," found its way to Holger Petersen's CBC Blues Radio Show, along with U.S. and international podcasts and campus radio playlists.

With 'Gently Used', René Huard adds another chapter to a career built on the road, in the clubs, and among the musicians who shaped him, proof that four decades in, the songs are still coming, and the guitar case is staying open for more than just steak.

releases.title: Alt-Rock Trio A Different Brand of Noise Returns With New Album 'Far More Than Conversation,' Led by Single "Who Dares"
releases.body:
Spotify I YouTube I Website I Facebook I Instagram I TikTok

MONTREAL, Oct. 12, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Nearly four decades after they first plugged in together in Montreal, A Different Brand of Noise are releasing their second album, Far More Than Conversation, out now on all major streaming platforms, led by the single "Who Dares."

Guitarist Robert Ranaldi and bassist Ken Ashdown had already built careers before the band existed, Ranaldi through Secret Act and Man and Things, Ashdown through This "Blue Piano" and Ulysses Underwood. Both toured Canada and the UK, found campus and alternative radio success, and opened for major alternative rock acts. A chance meeting on a Montreal street reignited their friendship, and with drummer Gonzo, they quickly formed a power trio.

Writing and rehearsing quickly, they built a loyal following through packed Montreal shows. A demo recorded on an analog four-track in late 1987 surfaced as the bootleg Up, Tight, becoming a favourite on Montreal campus and alternative radio. After about a year and a half, university and steady paycheques won out, and the group quietly disbanded, leaving behind 10 songs that would not receive an official release for decades.

Ranaldi relocated to New York, Ashdown settled in Roberts Creek, BC, and Gonzo remained in Montreal. During the pandemic, Ashdown called his former bandmates, leading them to re-record their old material remotely. Relearning songs from rehearsal cassettes, teaching themselves audio production and Logic Pro, they traded files for three years until 19 songs were complete. The first 10 became the band's debut, Blurry, released in 2025.

Far More Than Conversation carries that identity into nine songs the band describes as being about sex, drugs and incipient societal collapse. "Who Dares" tackles income inequality and consumerism. "Do the Poor" grew from an overheard conversation among wealthy teenagers and closes with members of the Sunshine Coast Children's Choir. "Designs" traces back to a mushroom-fuelled afternoon, "She's the One" honours Ranaldi's childhood sweetheart, while "Pleasure Signs," "Falling Down Again II" and "Time Will Tell" salute the band's musical influences and enduring optimism. Touring remains on hold while the reunited trio balance music with careers in labour relations and behavioural neuroscience.

BOSTON, Oct. 12, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- D-Tension & The Secrets have released their self-titled debut album, D-Tension & The Secrets, a nine-song set led by the single "Hate To See You Go." The record spans rock, alt rock, punk and power pop without settling into any one lane.

The band exists because of an unlikely pivot. D-Tension built his name internationally as a hip hop artist, touring with the late DMX, Ja Rule and the late Biz Markie, before a pandemic lockdown and a Fender Jazzmaster won in what he calls a shady Instagram contest pushed him toward rock and roll.

A producer known for work with Slug of Atmosphere, Blackalicious and Mr. Lif, D-Tension had grown up surrounded by rock records despite never playing guitar. YouTube lessons closed the gap quickly. By Christmas 2020 he was recording his own material, released the following year as Secret Rock & Roll Project, featuring Craig Silverman of Agnostic Front, Frank Pino of the Andrew W.K. band and Brian Viglione of Dresden Dolls and Violent Femmes. "Lockdown had its advantages," he says. "All I did that year was play guitar."

D-Tension, who is on the autism spectrum, has long described music as his superpower, carrying that confidence into his shift from rapper to rocker.

Once the world reopened, The Secrets formed in his hometown of Lowell, Massachusetts. A second album, Tales From The Pub, followed on Red on Red Records as the band entered the Rock & Roll Rumble, proving this was never a rap-rock project but one built on melody, hooks, harmony and storytelling.

Their new album is the first recorded fully as a band. Opener "Hate To See You Go" channels Boston's Irish punk tradition with echoes of Dropkick Murphys, Rancid and Flogging Molly, while "Banned," "Crime Spree" and "Violated" move through psychobilly, dark humour and hard rock. D-Tension calls it "your favorite hour of rock and roll radio."

"Hate To See You Go" honours friends D-Tension lost, including soul singer Lesley, who died during the pandemic before they could make a record together, as well as a beloved cat and a childhood friend. Rather than write an elegy, he turned grief into an Irish punk drinking song celebrating lives well lived.

D-Tension was inducted into the New England Music Hall of Fame in 2024 and has won two Boston Music Awards, a New England Music Award and a New England Urban Music Award.
