releases.title: AI Made Music Fast. CITY JAM Founder Pat Villaceran Says the Real Asset Is the Artist's Own Sound
releases.body:
As AI music races on speed and volume, CITY JAM's INDUSTRY.AIFF works on what no pipeline can force: drawing original sound out of human creators.

NEW YORK, Oct. 10, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Generative AI has made music fast, and the race in AI music is now about speed and volume. Pat Villaceran, founder of CITY JAM, says that race leaves one input untouched: original sound from human creators. Drawing that sound out of artists is both an art and a science. It is the craft behind INDUSTRY.AIFF, which takes a label's signed-but-unfinished artists to catalog-ready work and carries them through launch.

"When you stack up the progress around AI, it's all about speed, and about getting human creators back on track. That is an art and a science of its own," said Villaceran. "There are blueprints in it. Anyone can copy a blueprint: the roadmap, the pipeline, the scheduling and the workflows. But you cannot force the sound to come out if it has to be an original sound. The creativity is in how you bring out and evoke insights from musicians and creatives, and that is what CREATOR LABS and INDUSTRY.AIFF do. How you do that is the expertise we have at CITY JAM."

In tech terms, the blueprint is the easy part. A release plan can be written down and handed to anyone. Software can run it. The sound, Villaceran says, cannot.

The figures show how fast supply has moved. Luminate's 2025 Year-End Music Report counted 106,000 tracks a day reaching streaming services in 2025, up 7% on 99,000 a day in 2024. In 2025, 120.5 million of 253 million audio tracks had ten streams or fewer. That is almost half.

A growing share of that supply is not made by people. On Deezer, fully AI-generated tracks reached almost 75,000 a day in April 2026, roughly 44% of daily uploads, and passed 50% of new uploads at the June 2026 peak. Yet AI tracks are 1 to 3% of streams on Deezer, and up to 85% of those streams were fraudulent in 2025. On Deezer, the flood is in uploads, not listening.

The CISAC and PMP Strategy study projects that generative AI "could put 24% of Music creators' revenues at risk in 2028." That is a projection.

The US Copyright Office is now asking what that volume costs. Its inquiry into music streaming fraud names, in its Federal Register notice, "the dilution of the royalty revenue pool" as the primary harm, and asks which industry practices may be "inadvertently contributing to streaming fraud." Initial comments are due November 23, 2026, and replies December 21, 2026.

Detection and enforcement sit with regulators and the streaming services. CITY JAM's work sits earlier, in the stretch between signing an artist and a finished record. The royalty pool is diluted by volume without an audience. Fully finished, genuine releases are what the pool is for, and those still depend on an artist finding a sound of their own.

So if speed is no longer the hard part, what is music for? Villaceran's answer is the artist's own sound. It has to be drawn out of the musician. Then the speed AI brings can serve an original sound instead of replacing it.

INDUSTRY.AIFF does this for record labels and artist services companies. It works with their signed artists from unfinished work to catalog-ready releases, and stays with them through launch.

INDUSTRY.AIFF sits within the AI-era accelerator and incubator model for music that Villaceran launched on October 9, 2026, starting with record labels. Artists get the kind of support a startup accelerator gives founders. Education and professional development sit alongside community and live jam sessions. Collaborations and commercial opportunities come with it, and so does technology.

About CITY JAM

CITY JAM is holistic, end-to-end infrastructure for the music industry, built for everyone from independent musicians to record labels and artist services companies. It runs INDUSTRY.AIFF and CREATOR LABS with a global network of experts and producers, including CITY JAM New York. Pat Villaceran founded and leads CITY JAM. She also founded the innovation agency The MooVe, and has built innovation programs for companies and founders in Asia Pacific and the United States as well as in the United Kingdom and Europe. CITY JAM brings that record to music. INDUSTRY.AIFF is CITY JAM's program for record labels and artist services companies, and the name of its weekday letter for music label CEOs. CREATOR LABS is a holistic support system for independent musicians. It is a separate offering and is not part of INDUSTRY.AIFF. CITY JAM is a brand of HINABI PRIVE, INC. For updates, follow CITY JAM on LinkedIn.

releases.body:
Following its TIFF and VIFF premieres, the documentary heads to theatres across Canada

VANCOUVER, BC, Oct. 9, 2026 /CNW/ -- Network Media Group Inc. and Network Entertainment Inc. (TSXV: NTE) (OTC: NETWF) ("Network" or the "Company") are pleased to announce that Man In Motion: The Rick Hansen Story was honoured with gala premieres at the Toronto International Film Festival (TIFF) and the Vancouver International Film Festival (VIFF).

The film premiered at TIFF on September 11, where it received an honourable mention for Best Canadian Feature Film, followed by a hometown screening at VIFF on October 3 at the Vancouver Playhouse.

Adrian Buitenhuis directed the film, which was produced by Derik Murray and Ryan Reynolds, in association with Ryan Reynolds' Maximum Effort.

"We were thrilled to share the film with audiences at both TIFF and VIFF and were incredibly gratified by the response," said Derik Murray, Founder and CEO of Network Entertainment. "These festivals were the ideal venues to showcase the film and motivate potential global distribution opportunities."

The film draws on rare archival footage, original interviews and Rick Hansen's personal audio recordings to reveal the story behind one of the most remarkable athletic achievements in history. Rick Hansen, paralyzed from the waist down after a car accident, wheeled around the world to raise money and awareness for spinal cord research. The Man In Motion World Tour began in Vancouver on March 21, 1985, when Hansen was 27, and took him and his small team more than 40,000 kilometres through 34 countries over 26 months.

The Tour raised more than $26 million for spinal cord injury research and accessibility initiatives, helping to change perceptions of people with disabilities and build momentum for a more accessible and inclusive world.

The Rick Hansen Foundation, established in 1988 following the Tour, has continued this work, raising more than $435 million and advancing initiatives focused on improving accessibility and removing barriers for people with disabilities.

About the Rick Hansen Foundation

A legacy of Rick Hansen's Man In Motion World Tour more than 40 years ago, the Rick Hansen Foundation (RHF) is a registered charity that exists to remove those barriers and accelerate a global movement toward an accessible, inclusive and healthy world. We bring people and organizations together to turn innovative ideas into real-world solutions. Together, we're continuing Rick's dream of a world without barriers for everyone, everywhere. Visit www.RickHansen.com to learn more.

About Network Entertainment

Network Media Group is the parent company of Network Entertainment Inc.

Network Entertainment is a creatively driven production company that creates, finances, and produces award-winning film, television and digital content for audiences around the world. For more than two decades, Network has built a reputation for telling the stories of extraordinary and iconic international figures.

Network has earned international recognition for productions including Facing Ali, which was shortlisted for an Academy Award for Best Feature Documentary; SIDNEY, which premiered at the Toronto International Film Festival, was produced in partnership with Oprah Winfrey and was released globally on Apple TV+, earning a Critics' Choice Documentary Award for Best Biographical Documentary and a Black Reel Award for Outstanding Documentary Feature; and Sly Lives! (aka The Burden of Black Genius), a Peabody Award-winning and Emmy Award-nominated feature documentary, directed by Academy Award winner Ahmir "Questlove" Thompson. The film debuted at the 2025 Sundance Film Festival and premiered shortly after on Hulu/Disney+. Also, BRATS, a feature documentary directed by Brat Pack member Andrew McCarthy in partnership with NEON and ABC News Studios, had its world premiere at the 2024 Tribeca Film Festival, went straight to #1 on Hulu upon its release, and won the 2025 ASCAP Award in the Top Streaming Film category; and Man In Motion: The Rick Hansen Story, produced in partnership with Ryan Reynolds and his team at Maximum Effort, chronicled one man's extraordinary journey to break barriers and inspire global change. The film premiered at the 2026 Toronto International Film Festival, where it received an honourable mention for Best Canadian Feature Film, followed by its hometown premiere at the Vancouver International Film Festival in October 2026.

Upcoming productions include a feature documentary on Jimi Hendrix, directed by acclaimed filmmaker Bao Nguyen in collaboration with Janie Hendrix and Experience Hendrix; and Bernie Taupin, directed by Matthew Miele.

releases.title: A Piece of New England Music History Is Up for Grabs: Beloved JJ Hapgood Hits the Market
releases.body:
From Grateful Dead and Bob Marley Memorabilia to Its Starring Role in Baby Boom, This Legendary Peru, Vermont Gathering Place is Ready for Its Next Chapter

PERU, Vt., Oct. 9, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Some places are restaurants. Some are general stores. And then there are places that become part of the cultural fabric of a community.

For decades, JJ Hapgood has been that kind of place.

Tucked into the heart of Peru, Vermont, the beloved destination has become known for its unmistakable music vibe, eclectic collection of rock-and-roll and jam-band memorabilia, and the sense that walking through its doors means stepping into a living piece of Vermont history.

Now, after years of building Hapgoods into a destination for locals and visitors alike, owners Leslie and Michael French say they are ready to hand the keys to a new owner.

And they aren't necessarily looking for someone to simply preserve what exists.

They are looking for someone who sees what could come next.

"We've had so much joy with Hapgoods," the Frenches say, while acknowledging that there is still enormous potential for the property, business and community surrounding it. They are already in serious conversations with a couple of prospective buyers interested in taking the space in a new direction, including more live music and events.

But nothing has been signed—and that means the door remains open.

Where the Walls Tell a Musical Story

Part of what makes Hapgoods unusual is that the experience begins long before the first bite or beverage.

The space itself is a tribute to music history.

Visitors encounter an extraordinary collection of concert posters and memorabilia representing some of the most influential artists and bands of the past several decades.

Among the pieces are a 1978 Bob Marley Greek Theatre Berkeley poster, described as a signed and accompanied by a certificate of authenticity; a Creedence Clearwater Revival Fillmore Auditorium concert poster, CGC graded 9.8; and a 1978 David Bowie Oakland Coliseum concert poster, PAE graded Mint "95."

And that's only part of the collection.

Phish, the Grateful Dead, Jerry Garcia, Trey Anastasio—classic rock, reggae and other legendary musical acts are woven throughout the space, creating an atmosphere that feels less like a traditional commercial property and more like a physical love letter to live music.

For music fans traveling through Vermont, the memorabilia alone can make Hapgoods worth a stop.

For entrepreneurs, the collection—and the community that has grown around it—offers something harder to replicate: identity.

A Hollywood Connection

Hapgoods also occupies a distinctive place in pop-culture history.

The Peru location was featured in the filming of Baby Boom, the 1987 film starring Diane Keaton, adding another layer to a property already steeped in Vermont and American cultural history.

That combination—music, film, community and place—is difficult to manufacture.

It has developed organically over time.

And that may be one of the most intriguing aspects of the opportunity now emerging in Peru.

A Vermont Institution Looking for Its Next Chapter

For Leslie and Michael French, the decision to sell is clearly bittersweet.

Hapgoods has brought them years of memories, relationships and experiences. But they also believe the space has more to give.

One of the prospective buyers currently in discussions with the Frenches is exploring a future with expanded live music and events, potentially building upon the energy that has already made Hapgoods a destination.

Nothing is finalized.

Which means, for the right entrepreneur, hospitality operator, music enthusiast, investor or creative visionary, there is still an opportunity to enter the conversation.

The question isn't simply what happens to a building in Peru.

It's what happens to a place that has already developed a following.

More Than a Real Estate Transaction

Across the Northeast, destinations like this have become increasingly difficult to create from scratch.

A new owner isn't starting with four walls and a business plan. They're stepping into a story that already includes generations of customers, travelers, musicians, moviegoers, collectors and music fans.

The next chapter could preserve the character that made Hapgoods special.

Or it could expand upon it.

Perhaps that's the most interesting part of the story.

JJ Hapgood is for sale—and the next owner could be the person who decides what the soundtrack sounds like. The Frenches are currently in serious discussions with a couple of prospective buyers but no sale has been finalized. Interested parties who want to explore the opportunity can still throw their hat in the ring.

releases.body:
The Article Outlines How Organizers Can Coordinate Performers, Venues, Production, Logistics, and Audience Needs When Planning a Concert.

ALBUQUERQUE, N.M., Oct. 8, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- What should organizers consider when planning a concert? A HelloNation article answers that question, featuring insights from Dino Hall of DSH ENTERTAINMENT, INC.®️in Albuquerque, New Mexico.

The article explains that live event planning begins well before performers arrive at a venue. Organizers first need to define the event's purpose, expected audience, available budget, and desired experience. These early decisions shape artist selection, production needs, scheduling, and other program elements.

According to the article, artist booking requires more than selecting performers who fit the event concept. Organizers should consider audience expectations, venue size, schedules, and technical needs. Contracts should also address performance times, payment terms, travel arrangements, production requirements, and responsibilities for everyone involved.

The HelloNation article notes that venue selection directly affects concert production and audience experience. Capacity should fit expected attendance while leaving appropriate space for staging, equipment, staff, and guests. During planning, also review accessibility, parking, transportation, security, sound restrictions, and venue requirements.

Technical coordination is another important part of live event planning. The article explains that performers may require specific sound systems, lighting, staging, electrical service, dressing rooms, or other equipment. Reviewing these requirements early helps production teams determine whether the venue and vendors can support each performance.

Scheduling brings the separate parts of concert production together. Load-in, sound checks, rehearsals, performances, vendor setup, security briefings, and cleanup all require defined time periods. The article recommends building enough flexibility into the schedule to address delays without disrupting the entire event.

Clear communication also supports effective event logistics. The article describes the importance of assigning responsibilities for artist needs, technical production, venue operations, security, guest services, and schedule changes. Centralized information can help artists, vendors, production teams, and organizers work from the same instructions.

The article also emphasizes audience experience throughout the planning process. Entry procedures, seating, signage, restrooms, food service, accessibility, and crowd movement can shape the guest experience. Careful planning in these areas can help prevent operational problems from distracting from the performances.

For cultural event planning, the article advises organizers to consider traditions, history, and community representation. Artists, speakers, food, activities, and visual elements should reflect the culture with appropriate care. Consultation with knowledgeable community members can help identify concerns before the event reaches the public.

Live Entertainment Expert Dino Hall's insights also inform the article's discussion of promotion and contingency planning. Event descriptions should accurately represent performers, cultural elements, schedules, and venue details. Organizers should also prepare procedures for weather problems, artist delays, equipment failures, medical situations, crowd concerns, and transportation disruptions.

The article concludes that successful event logistics depend on coordination across every part of the program. When purpose, programming, concert production, communication, and audience experience align, organizers can create a more cohesive event for performers and guests.

releases.title: NETEASE CLOUD MUSIC AND gamma. ANNOUNCE NEW STRATEGIC PARTNERSHIP IN CHINA FOR MUSIC FROM YE, MARIAH CAREY, SEXYY RED, USHER, SNOOP DOGG AND MORE
releases.body:
HANGZHOU, China and LOS ANGELES, Oct. 8, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- NetEase Cloud Music and gamma., the global media and technology company founded by Larry Jackson and Ike Youssef, today announced a multi-year strategic partnership that will expand opportunities for gamma.'s global artist roster in China while deepening NetEase Cloud Music's connection to international music and culture.

Under the new agreement, NetEase Cloud Music will serve as a key launch platform for licensed recordings from gamma.'s roster of leading artists, including Ye, Mariah Carey, Sexyy Red, Usher, Snoop Dogg, and more. Beyond music distribution, the partnership will create opportunities for collaboration across artist promotion, cultural exchange, original music content, and other initiatives designed to connect global artists with audiences in China.

The partnership builds on gamma.'s broader strategy of creating new pathways for artists to reach audiences, grow their businesses, and participate in culture across markets, while expanding NetEase Cloud Music's access to a diverse roster of internationally recognized and emerging artists. Together, the companies will explore new opportunities to amplify artists and music across borders, deepen connections between global artists and Chinese audiences, and foster greater cultural exchange.

In September 2025, Mariah Carey's latest album, Here For It All, made its China debut on NetEase Cloud Music, generating more than four times the volume of Carey's 2018 album Caution during its first two weeks. The album also delivered record-setting first-day streams and, by day 14, had surpassed every studio album Carey released in the previous decade in the China market.

The success of Here For It All demonstrates the potential of combining gamma.'s artist platform with NetEase Cloud Music's reach and market expertise. The expanded partnership formalizes that collaboration and establishes a broader framework for bringing gamma.'s artists to new audiences while creating new opportunities for NetEase Cloud Music to participate in the larger music ecosystem.

Vivian Wei, Vice President of Copyrights at NetEase Cloud Music, said: "We are delighted to build on our successful past cooperation and enter into a new strategic partnership with gamma., continuing to bring the works of international artists to music fans across China. We look forward to working closely with gamma. and leveraging our respective strengths in streaming platforms and copyright content to further enhance the visibility and influence of international artists in the Chinese market, while injecting new momentum into the diversity and development of China's music industry."

Larry Jackson, Founder and CEO of gamma., said: "I've been so deeply impressed by the imagination that NetEase has brought to every single gamma. release by way of their intent to maximize the commercial results in ways that we had never initially conceived of. Their footprint and success in China coupled with their passion for our repertoire made a partnership in this regard an obvious move. Going back to my time at Apple Music, I have always strongly believed that aligning with a company that is willing to go the extra step on treating your company's release as if it is their release is something that will truly move the needle in this commodified time of music streaming."

About NetEase Cloud Music 

NetEase Cloud Music ("Cloud Music Inc.," HKEX: 9899) is one of the leading online music platforms in China with over 200 million monthly active users, featuring an interactive content community for music enthusiasts in terms of user scale and engagement. NCM is also the leading original music platform in China, hosting more than 1.25 million independent musicians. NCM has built a large-scale, robust and rapidly growing business to provide community-centric online music services to its users. NCM empowers music enthusiasts with a wide variety of technology-driven tools to discover, enjoy, share and create diverse music and music-inspired content and to interact with each other.

About gamma. 

Founded by CEO Larry Jackson and President Ike Youssef, gamma. is a global media, technology and creative agency company built to empower artist-entrepreneurs to create, distribute, and monetize culture on their own terms. With eight global offices and more than 10,000 monthly releases powered by its Vydia platform, gamma. partners with some of the world's most influential artists, including Mariah Carey, Ye, Snoop Dogg and Death Row Records, USHER, Rick Ross' Maybach Music Group, and Sexyy Red, alongside emerging talent including MOLIY, October London, JayDon, Loe Shimmy, and honestav.

Bringing together music, technology, creative services, and cultural ventures, gamma. is building a new model for how artists and their businesses grow beyond the traditional music industry. In 2026, the company expanded into fashion with the launch of gamma. Maison, its new fashion venture, further extending its platform across culture and commerce.

releases.body:
From chart-topping songwriters to the acclaimed screen composers behind Lioness: Special Ops, Landman and Heated Rivalry, this year's achievement winners exemplify the impact of Canadian music.

TORONTO, Oct. 7, 2026 /CNW/ -- SOCAN today revealed the exceptional songwriters, composers and music publishers who will be celebrated with Special Achievement Awards at the 2026 SOCAN Awards, taking place October 26, 2026, at Toronto's REBEL nightclub. The annual event, hosted by Arisa Cox and Andrew Phung, will honour over 100 music creators and publishers shaping Canadian music at home and around the world.

The 2026 honourees reflect the diversity and global reach of Canadian musical creativity and will be celebrated with an evening of standout performances and special guests including Shawn Desman, Jamie Fine, Hailey Benedict and the 2025 Breakout Composers the Chan brothers. Also awarded will be 2025 Songwriter of the Year, Evan Blair, Lowell and the composer team behind Daniel Tiger's Neighborhood and PAW Patrol.

2026 SOCAN Special Achievement Award Winners

  • International Achievement Award – Jessie Reyez

    With over 4 billion streams globally, the GRAMMY nominated, and multiple JUNO winner, Jessie Reyez is representing Canada on the global stage, influencing music and culture with her talent, and collaborations with artists like Dua Lipa, Beyoncé and Eminem.
  • Cultural Impact Award – "Let Your Backbone Slide" by Maestro Fresh Wes, Anthony Davis, Peter Davis; published by BMG Rights Management Canada o/b/o BMG Rights Management (US), Warner Chappell Music Canada Ltd.

    A global success story, this is one of the most groundbreaking and culturally significant recordings in hip hop and Canadian music history.
  • Global Impact Award – Peter Peter 

    Celebrated for elevating Canadian talent on the world stage through his work on the international hit series "Heated Rivalry."
  • Screen Composer of the Year – Andrew Lockington

    A standout year that includes multiple major wins across film and serialized drama for "Atlas," "Landman," "Mayor of Kingstown" and "Special Ops: Lioness".
  • Songwriter of the Year – Non‑Performer – Jenna Andrews

    Recognized for an exceptional year, including "Free" and "What It Sounds Like" from the global hit soundtrack KPop Demon Hunters, Andrews is one of Canada's most sought-after songwriters.
  • Songwriter of the Year – Performer – Drake

    Honoured once again for his unmatched influence on music worldwide.
  • Breakout Songwriter Award – Jade LeMac

    With a fresh, authentic perspective and growing fanbase, Jade is one of the most exciting new voices in Canadian music.
  • Breakout Composer Award – Nathan Micay

    The electronic music producer made waves with his foray into screen composing on the hit HBO series "Industry."

"Every year, the SOCAN Awards shine a light on the songwriters, composers and music publishers who define and elevate Canadian music," said Jennifer Brown, SOCAN CEO.  "The 2026 honourees show the extraordinary range of talent shaping our culture, from global hitmakers to groundbreaking composers and exciting new voices. We can't wait to celebrate them on October 26."

SOCAN Achievement Award winners receive "The SOCAN" – the world's first and only music industry trophy that is also a musical instrument, incorporating five custom bronze crotales, tuned this year with notes from "Let Your Backbone Slide" by Maestro Fresh Wes. 

The full list of this year's SOCAN Award winners will be released on the evening of October 26. 

SOCAN proudly acknowledges its legal counsel of 75+ years, Gowling WLG as the official sponsor of the 2026 SOCAN Awards, with the SOCAN Foundation and the Unison Benevolent Fund serving as official charity partners.

About SOCAN   

SOCAN is Canada's largest member-owned music rights organization, championing the fundamental value of music and the people who create it. SOCAN collects license fees for the public performance and reproduction of music, matches them to rights holders, and distributes them as royalties to songwriters, composers and music creators and publishers in Canada and around the world. With more than a century of expertise and innovation, SOCAN stands for respect and fair compensation for creative work – protecting, recognizing, and celebrating its over 200,000 songwriter, composer, and music publisher members. For more information: www.socan.com.

releases.title: JEFFREY STEELE TO BE HONORED WITH BMI ICON AWARD AT THE 74TH ANNUAL BMI COUNTRY AWARDS ON NOV. 17TH
releases.body:
Country Songwriter of the Year, Country Song of the Year and Country Publisher of the Year to be Revealed During Celebration of  the Year's 50 Most-Performed Country Songs

NASHVILLE, Tenn., Oct. 7, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- BMI will celebrate one of the ultimate architects of modern Country music, Jeffrey Steele, by naming him a BMI Icon during the 74th annual BMI Country Awards. The two-time BMI Country Songwriter of the Year will be recognized for his significant songwriting and contributions to Country music. The invitation-only event will be held at BMI's Nashville office on Nov. 17th and will be hosted by BMI's CEO, Mike O'Neill, Executive Vice President, Chief Revenue & Creative Officer, Mike Steinberg and BMI's Nashville VP of Creative, Clay Bradley.

Throughout the evening, BMI will also reveal the Country Songwriter of the Year, Country Song of the Year and Country Publisher of the Year, while celebrating the top songwriters and music publishers behind this past year's 50 most-performed songs in Country music.

"Jeffrey Steele is a titan of modern storytelling whose catalog has shaped the sound of Country music over the last three decades," BMI's Nashville VP of Creative, Clay Bradley said. "When you hear one of his anthems that has become the soundtrack to millions of lives, you can feel the emotion behind every lyric. As a two-time BMI Country Songwriter of the Year and an intentional mentor to the next generation of creators, Steele has earned a permanent place among the greats."

Since Steele's affiliation with BMI in 1981, the multi-Platinum songwriter, singer and producer has shaped the modern Country music landscape with over 60 chart-topping hits. The prolific songwriter has received more than 34 BMI Country and Pop Awards for his extensive catalog that includes iconic songs like Tim McGraw's "The Cowboy in Me" along with Rascal Flatts' "What Hurts the Most," "My Wish," and "These Days" as well as Keith Urban's "Raise 'Em Up" featuring Eric Church, Zac Brown Band's "Knee Deep," Van Zant's "Help Somebody," Montgomery Gentry's "Something to Be Proud Of" and "My Town." The seven-time GRAMMY® nominee has earned critical recognition for his creative impact with an induction into the Nashville Songwriters Hall of Fame, and Steele has been honored by the Country Music Hall of Fame as a "Poet and Prophet."

The BMI Icon Award is given to exceptional songwriters in recognition of their unique and indelible influence on music makers over many generations. In receiving this award, Steele joins an impressive list of Country legends including Bill Anderson, Matraca Berg, Clint Black, Toby Keith, Loretta Lynn, Willie Nelson, Merle Haggard, Dolly Parton, Kris Kristofferson, Dean Dillon, Vince Gill and Hank Williams, Jr., as well as multi-genre creative/songwriting royalty Stevie Nicks, Little Richard, Carole King, Patti LaBelle, Brian Wilson, James Brown, Janet Jackson, Bo Diddley, Holland-Dozier-Holland, Peter Gabriel, Al Green, Van Morrison, Sting, Bryan Ferry, Carlos Santana, Los Lobos, and more.

ABOUT JEFFREY STEELE:

Jeffrey Steele continues to shape American music with songs that connect people across generations. With more than 65 million radio and television airplays, his songwriting has produced major hits for artists including Keith Urban, Eric Church, Zac Brown Band, Jimmy Buffett, Montgomery Gentry, Lynyrd Skynyrd, Cher, .38 Special, Faith Hill, Tim McGraw, Trace Adkins, LeAnn Rimes, Rascal Flatts, Van Zant, Joe Cocker, Little Feat ft. Bob Seger, Joe Bonamassa, Cascada, and many more. A member of the Nashville Songwriters Hall of Fame, Steele has been recognized by the Country Music Hall of Fame as a "Poet and Prophet," named BMI Songwriter of the Year twice, and awarded NSAI Songwriter of the Year three times. He is also a two-time CMA Triple Play Award recipient for penning three No. 1 hits in a single year. His extensive list of chart-topping songs includes: "Raise 'Em Up," "Knee Deep," "Here," "My Wish," "The Cowboy in Me," "These Days," "My Town," "Something to Be Proud Of," "Everyday," and the landmark "What Hurts the Most," which earned a GRAMMY® nomination for Best Country Song. Steele has received a Golden Globe and Critics' Choice nominee for Best Original Song for "I Thought I Lost You" (from Disney/Pixar's Bolt). He has been named one of Billboard's Top 5 Writers for eight consecutive years and MusicRow Magazine's Songwriter of the Year. Continuing to use his voice to reflect the times, Steele released his new single "A Voice" in January - a song rooted in hope, unity and shared humanity. Written as a reminder of what connects us in a world often marked by division and uncertainty, the song underscores Steele's enduring belief in music as a force for healing and togetherness. The song debuted at #4 on the Billboard Digital Sales charts. A full-length American Storyteller album of new music will follow. Fore more information visit www.JeffreySteele.com.

ABOUT BMI:

Celebrating over 80 years of service to songwriters, composers, music publishers and businesses, BMI® is a global leader in music rights management, serving as an advocate for the value of music. BMI represents the public performance rights in over 25 million musical works created and owned by more than 1.5 million songwriters, composers, and music publishers. The Company negotiates music license agreements and distributes the fees it generates as royalties to its affiliated writers and publishers when their songs are performed in public. In 1939, BMI created a groundbreaking open-door policy becoming the only performing rights organization to welcome and represent the creators of blues, jazz, country, and American roots music. Today, the musical compositions in BMI's repertoire, from chart toppers to perennial favorites, span all genres of music and are consistently among the most-performed hits of the year. For additional information and the latest BMI news, visit bmi.com, follow us on X, TikTok, and Instagram @BMI or stay connected through BMI's Facebook page. Sign up for BMI's The Weekly™ and receive our e-newsletter every week to stay up to date on all things music.

releases.body:
Recognition highlights the School's industry-driven curriculum, career opportunities, and connections to leading music and entertainment professionals

NEW YORK, Oct. 6, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Today, the Roc Nation School of Music, Sports & Entertainment at Long Island University (LIU) has been recognized by Billboard as part of its 2026 Top Music Business Schools List, marking the third consecutive year the Brooklyn-based School has earned the distinction. 

The annual list recognizes colleges and universities preparing the next generation of music business leaders. This year, Billboard highlighted the Roc Nation School's industry-focused curriculum, access to professional resources and continued connections to leading music and entertainment executives. 

Since beginning enrollment in 2021, the School has continued to expand opportunities for students pursuing careers across the music business, including artist management, marketing, publishing, touring, entrepreneurship and more. Billboard highlighted how students have access to industry professionals and events and industry-standard resources, including the School's 2,400-square-foot Dolby Atmos studio.

Billboard also acknowledged how the School's curriculum continues to evolve alongside the industry, including coursework through its continued relationship with JPMorgan Chase, assisting aspiring music executives with money management.

Recent alumni have launched careers with organizations including Roc Nation, 508 Productions and Vevo, while other students have secured competitive opportunities with Universal Music Publishing Group, Interscope Records, iHeartMedia, Live Nation, SiriusXM and Sugar Mountain Records, among others. 

The latest recognition comes as select students from the School were invited to attend the world premiere of HBO's JAŸ-Z In 8 documentary at The Metropolitan Opera House at Lincoln Center. The costs of the students' gowns and tuxedos were covered by the Shawn Carter Foundation and other organizations, allowing the students to experience a historic night in music in culture alongside some of the biggest names in entertainment.  

Additionally, the School recently announced a four-year, full-tuition scholarship for a first-time freshman, established by Grammy Award-winning engineer and producer Young Guru, who also serves as Director of the Music Technology, Entrepreneurship & Production program at the Roc Nation School.  

About The Roc Nation School of Music, Sports & Entertainment 

The Roc Nation School of Music, Sports & Entertainment at Long Island University (LIU) is a globally renowned destination for world-class education, exceptional career development, cultural initiatives and philanthropic endeavors. The school prepares students for careers spanning entrepreneurship, music, sports business, management, performance and more through an esteemed faculty of university professors, adjunct industry leaders and special guest lecturers.  

 The Roc Nation School began enrolling students at LIU in Fall 2021 and combines academic instruction with immersive opportunities designed to help students build practical experience and professional networks. Located in Shawn "JAY-Z" Carter's hometown of Brooklyn, the school also provides Roc Nation Hope Scholarships to 25 percent of enrolled students, enabling recipients to graduate with a four-year full-tuition scholarship. Hope Scholars are selected from a pool of academically competitive, New York-based, first-time freshmen with the highest financial need.

releases.title: Meekah and Dove Celebrate All the Amazing Things Our Bodies Can Do With New "My Body Is Amazing" Music Video
releases.body:
Moonbug and the Dove Self-Esteem Project are back with a new Meekah music video encouraging kids to move, express themselves and celebrate what their bodies can do.

LOS ANGELES, Oct. 6, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Get ready to move with Meekah! Moonbug Entertainment and the Dove Self-Esteem Project (DSEP) are partnering with Meekah for a new "My Body Is Amazing" music video celebrating movement, self-expression and the amazing things our bodies can do. Designed to protect body confidence1 from an early age, the music video encourages children to focus on everything their bodies help them experience, explore and enjoy, rather than how they look.

Premiering today, ahead of International Day of the Girl, "My Body Is Amazing" is set to protect body confidence1 in a way that feels fun, engaging and accessible for young children and their caregivers. Set to an energetic pop track, the song takes kids on a playful journey through the senses and the many ways we experience the world, from smelling and tasting to seeing, moving and expressing ourselves. Together, Meekah and her friends celebrate the unique ways each of them can move, play and experience the world around them.

The collaboration builds on Moonbug and Dove's partnership in 2024, when the two brands joined forces on a collection of Blippi episodes and music videos focused on body confidence and self-esteem, including the Blippi "Wonderful Talent Show" special. This time, the partnership brings Meekah's signature energy, creativity and love of movement to a song all about celebrating the incredible ways our bodies help us experience and explore the world.

"Meekah is all about encouraging kids to jump in, try something new and find their own way to experience the world," said Liz Katz, Associate General Manager of Blippi who leads the Meekah franchise at Moonbug Entertainment. "Movement and self-expression are such a natural part of who she is, and this partnership with Dove gives us a wonderful opportunity to celebrate that. We want kids to feel excited to move, try things, express themselves and, most importantly, have fun being exactly who they are."

"For more than 20 years, the Dove Self-Esteem Project has been helping young people build body confidence and self-esteem. And we know that work needs to start early. If we want to reach more children, we need to take body confidence education beyond the classroom and into the things they love to watch and listen to. 'My Body Is Amazing' with Meekah does exactly that, celebrating bodies for everything they can do, not simply how they look," said Marcela Melero, Chief Growth Marketing Officer, Dove.

The partnership builds on the Dove Self-Esteem Project's multi-decade mission to provide body confidence and self-esteem education so the next generation can grow up with a positive relationship with their bodies and reach their full potential. Research shows that body image concerns start to manifest as early as 4-years-old, with 1 in 4 girls aged 4-6 years disliking something about their appearance2. That's why it's never too early to start teaching kids about body confidence to help minimize self-esteem issues, now and in the future.

"My Body Is Amazing" is now available on YouTube.

About Meekah

Meekah makes learning about the world fun by inviting kids to jump in and try things for themselves. She ignites curiosity by doing, making and expressing herself, using creativity and movement to explore the world in her own way. With her signature big-sister energy, Meekah jumps in alongside kids, cheers them on and makes trying something new feel fun and achievable. As part of the Blippi franchise, Meekah brings a distinct point of view that complements Blippi: Blippi opens kids' eyes to what's out there, while Meekah encourages them to jump in.

The Blippi brand averages more than one billion monthly YouTube views and reaches more than 100 million fans worldwide, with Meekah related content averaging more than 200 million monthly YouTube views. Available in 25+ languages, including ASL, across 65+ distribution platforms, the franchise spans streaming, live experiences, products, music, publishing and gaming.

About Moonbug Entertainment

Moonbug is an award-winning global entertainment company inspiring kids everywhere to laugh, learn and grow. The company is behind some of the biggest kids' entertainment brands in the world, including CoComelon, Blippi and Little Angel. Moonbug believes every child should have access to entertaining and enriching content, making its shows available on more than 150 video platforms globally including Netflix, Disney+, BBC iPlayer and YouTube Kids. The company is also a global leader in pre-school music and audio experiences, available on 100+ audio platforms globally. Moonbug brands extend far beyond the screen to include streaming music, games and interactive, consumer products, and live events.

Moonbug is part of Candle Media, an independent, creator-friendly home for cutting-edge, high-quality, category-defining brands and franchises. By bringing together elite talent operating at the intersection of content, community, and commerce, it helps to position leading entertainment businesses for accelerated, sustainable growth in the current market and beyond. Candle is run by its Co-Chairmen and Co-CEOs, leading entertainment executives Kevin Mayer and Tom Staggs, and backed by investment capital from funds managed by Blackstone's flagship private equity business.

About the Dove Self-Esteem Project

The Dove Self-Esteem Project (DSEP) is the world's largest provider of body confidence education. For more than 20 years, it has helped over 160 million young people across 150+ countries build body confidence and self-esteem through academically validated resources. DSEP's mission is to empower the next generation through body confidence education, helping young people reach their full potential.

About Dove

Dove started its life in 1957 in the US, with launch of the Beauty Bar, with its patented blend of mild cleansers and ¼ moisturising cream. Dove's heritage is rooted in care – proof, not promises grew Dove from a Beauty Bar into one of the world's most beloved beauty brands. 

Real women have always been our inspiration, and since the beginning, Dove has been wholly committed to providing superior care to all, and to championing real representations of beauty in our advertising, communications, and campaigns. Dove believes that beauty is for everyone, and the Dove mission is to ensure a positive experience with beauty is universally accessible to all.

For 69 years, Dove has been committed to broadening the narrow definition of beauty in the work they do. This includes the 'Dove Real Beauty Pledge,' and commitment to:

  1. Portray women as they are in real life with honesty, diversity, and respect. We feature women of different ages, sizes, ethnicities, hair colour, type, and style. 
  2. Represent individuals with zero digital distortion, with all images approved by the women they feature.
  3. Help young people build body confidence and self-esteem through the Dove Self-Esteem Project, the biggest provider of self-esteem education in the world with a goal to educate 250 million young people by 2030.

1 Craddock, N., Garbett, K. M., Smith, H. G., Anquandah, J., White, P., & Williamson, H. (2025). "My body is amazing from the bottom to the top"-An RCT study testing two positive body image media micro-interventions for young children aged 4–6 years. Body Image, 52, 101851.

2Hayes, S., & Tantleff‐Dunn, S. (2010). Am I too fat to be a princess? Examining the effects of popular children's media on young girls' body image. British Journal of Developmental Psychology, 28(2), 413-426.

releases.body:
• The combination builds on the storied history of two of the world's most recognizable entertainment companies, forming a single creative powerhouse.
  • The combined company, Skydance, brings together two major film studios, two global streaming services, premier television assets including CBS, HBO, and Paramount's and WBD's cable networks, two of the industry's most recognized news networks, CBS News and CNN, and a leading content portfolio that includes live sports, a deep programming library and expansive collection of iconic brands and franchises.
  • Together, Paramount and WBD will deliver enhanced output commitments, including a minimum of 30 high-quality theatrical films per year and 180+ television shows and series.  
  • Skydance aims to build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology. We are creative-first, audience focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.
  • Storytelling anchors the combined company's growth strategy – expanding opportunities for the world's leading creative talent and widening choice for consumers across every entertainment vertical. 
  • Disciplined execution and an owner-operator model underpin the strategy, targeting at least $6 billion in run-rate synergies within three years.

LOS ANGELES and NEW YORK, Oct. 6, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Skydance Corporation (f/k/a Paramount Skydance Corporation) (NYSE: SKYD) ("Paramount") today announced the completion of its acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery, Inc. (NASDAQ: WBD) ("WBD"), creating a combined company, named "Skydance." The company brings together two major film studios, two global streaming services, a premier television portfolio including CBS, HBO, and Paramount's and WBD's cable networks, two of the industry's most recognized news networks, CBS News and CNN, and a portfolio of live sports including CBS Sports and TNT Sports, as well as a deep programming library and expansive collection of brands and franchises. The transaction closed following receipt of all required regulatory approvals under the merger agreement and satisfaction of other customary closing conditions. Skydance Class B shares will begin trading today on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) under the new ticker symbol "SKYD."

Under the terms of the agreement, WBD shareholders received an amount in cash equal to $31.01666668 per share. WBD shares have ceased trading on NASDAQ, effective today. 

The completed transaction unites two of media and entertainment's most storied companies, each with a history spanning more than a century, giving the combined business a rare legacy to build on. The aim of the combined company is to build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology.

Storytelling will drive the combined company's growth, bringing creative visions to life for audiences in more than 200 countries and territories and creating greater opportunities for workers across the entertainment industry. Skydance starts from a position of strength: the most diverse film and television library of any studio, the largest theatrical output in the industry, 200+ million streaming subscribers across platforms, an iconic broadcast network, an unmatched sports portfolio, and a franchise portfolio spanning Top Gun and Harry Potter to White Lotus and SpongeBob SquarePants. From this foundation, Skydance is committed to delivering for the creative community and consumers, with at least 30 theatrical films annually, each with a minimum 45-day theatrical window, and already boasts 180+ television shows. Across TV and streaming, Skydance will also continue to support the independent production sector by commissioning content from independent studios and licensing its own content to third parties, creating more opportunities and more jobs for creatives, both in front of and behind the camera.

David Ellison, Chairman and CEO of Skydance, said: "Today is a historic day, not just for Skydance but for our entire industry. From the start, our ambition was to bring these two storied studios together and create a stronger competitor, with the talent, resources, and reach to tell great stories in every genre, on every platform, for audiences everywhere. Now that ambition is a reality. We're grateful to everyone who made this possible – the employees, creative talent, and production teams of both companies, who worked tirelessly to get us here and inspire audiences around the world every day, as well as the advisors and partners who guided this transaction to completion. Our focus now turns to the future: building a company that empowers creatives, entertains audiences and rewards shareholders. We couldn't be more excited to get to work."

Gerry Cardinale, Founder and Managing Partner of RedBird Capital and a Skydance Board Director, said: "This is a defining moment for the industry. By applying our owner-operator model to Paramount and WBD's unmatched portfolio of iconic franchises, premium original programming, and live sports rights, we can protect that legacy while building for a media landscape that's undergoing transformational change. David, our Co-CEO Ynon Kreiz, and the rest of our world-class Skydance team have the vision and track record to lead through this change. We're proud to back them as we build a stronger Hollywood, expand opportunities for talent, and create long-term value for our shareholders."

At the same time, consumers can expect greater innovation from a company built with technology at its core, including significant improvements to its direct-to-consumer streaming products, which will unify into a single service over time.

The transaction received unanimous approval from competition authorities covering nearly 70 jurisdictions worldwide, reflecting recognition of the deal's pro-competitive nature and the benefits it brings to consumers and creatives alike. The combination will strengthen competition and expand consumer choice, both on Skydance's own platforms and across the broader industry.

The combined company is built on a strong financial foundation that positions it to capitalize on growth opportunities, deliver on its commitments, and drive shareholder value. Skydance is one of the largest media and entertainment companies in the world, with nearly $70 billion in revenue. We are targeting $6 billion-plus in run-rate synergies over the next three years. Applying the same operational playbook that allowed Paramount to exceed its synergy targets following the Skydance-Paramount merger, the synergy savings will come primarily from technology, integration and procurement, marketing and real estate rationalization. That will make the company leaner and more nimble, freeing it to grow its investment in the stories, creators and technology that matter most while reducing net leverage to its 3.0x target by the end of 2029.

Powered by best-in-class content, streaming scale and technological edge, the combined company expects to generate more than $10 billion in free cash flow by 2030 – reducing leverage while funding growth and investment. Its pro forma content spend of more than $30 billion for the last twelve-month period will be disciplined and strategic, prioritizing audience reach and long-term value creation. 

WBD's common stock has ceased trading on the Nasdaq Exchange, effective today. The Ellison Family holds the largest equity stake in Skydance (NYSE: SKYD), and the Ellison Family and RedBird Capital Partners ("RedBird") together are the sole holders of Paramount Class A Common Stock, including 100% of the combined company's voting shares.

As previously stated, the transaction included $47 billion of new equity investment in Class B Common Stock, led by the Ellison Family, RedBird, Public Investment Fund (PIF), L'IMAD, Qatar Investment Authority (QIA) and LionTree, which was priced at $12.00 per share. The debt financing for the transaction was led by Bank of America, Citigroup and Apollo.

Advisors

Centerview Partners LLC and RedBird Advisors acted as lead financial advisors to Paramount, and Bank of America Securities, Citi, M. Klein & Company and LionTree Advisors also acted as financial advisors. Cravath, Swaine & Moore LLP and Latham & Watkins LLP acted as legal counsel to Paramount. Latham & Watkins LLP also acted as legal counsel to the investor consortium, including the Ellison Family.

Allen & Company, J.P. Morgan and Evercore served as financial advisors to WBD and Wachtell Lipton, Rosen & Katz and Debevoise & Plimpton LLP served as legal counsel.

Barclays Capital acted as financial advisors to the Special Committee of the Board of Directors of Paramount and Cleary, Gottlieb, Steen & Hamilton LLP served as legal counsel.

About Skydance

Skydance is a next-generation global media and entertainment company, composed of three business segments: Studios, Direct-to-Consumer, and TV Media. Skydance's portfolio unites legendary brands, including Paramount, Warner Bros., HBO and HBO Max, Paramount+, Pluto TV, CBS, CNN, CBS Sports, TNT Sports, Nickelodeon, Cartoon Network, MTV, Food Network, BET, HGTV, and Comedy Central.

releases.title: Library Ideas Brings Pure Flix Movie & TV Streaming to Public Libraries
releases.body:
WASHINGTON, Oct. 6, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Library Ideas, LLC of Fairfax, VA has partnered with Pure Flix, part of Great American Media, to bring a new movie and television streaming option to public libraries in North America.

Pure Flix offers a wide selection of family-friendly movies and series, including original content such as Ainsley McGregor Mysteries, Jep and Jess: Beyond the Bayou, When Hope Calls: Brookfield, County Rescue, and Crossroad Springs. The collection also includes heartwarming romances, uplifting dramas, and inspirational stories starring familiar faces such as Candace Cameron Bure, Danica McKellar, Jen Lilley, and Trevor Donovan.

Library patrons at subscribing libraries can now stream Pure Flix's extensive catalog of movies and TV series at no cost with their library card. Library Ideas has launched Pure Flix with 70 libraries, including Maricopa County (AZ), Fresno County Public Library (CA), Anderson Public Library (IN), Lake County Public Library (IN), Monroe County Library System (MI), Midpointe Library System (OH), Wayne County Public Library (OH), Mason Public Library (OH), Kokomo-Howard County Public Library (IN), and Springfield-Greene County Public Library (MO).

Pure Flix can be streamed on smart TVs, phones, tablets, and computers, giving patrons convenient access to positive entertainment at home or on the go.

The addition of Pure Flix gives public libraries a new way to serve patrons looking for family-friendly and uplifting entertainment as part of their digital collections.

"Library Ideas was an obvious choice for Pure Flix to partner with in the public library market. We couldn't be happier to expand our reach and make Pure Flix available to library patrons across the country," said Kristen Roberts, Chief Revenue Officer and Executive Vice President of Programming, Great American Media.

Brian Downing, CEO of Library Ideas, said, "The hallmark of a sustainable service is its ability to deliver ongoing value, drive consistent usage, and adapt to the evolving needs of the community. This partnership helps libraries broaden their digital collections with highly requested content that appeals across generations."

Libraries worldwide continue to see increased interest in streaming video, particularly among patrons looking for lighter, uplifting programming and family-friendly viewing options.

About Library Ideas

Library Ideas, established in 2009, is a global media company dedicated to delivering innovative digital solutions to libraries worldwide. Serving more than 10,000 institutions in over 40 countries, the company offers leading tools for reading, learning, and listening.

For more information, visit www.libraryideas.com 

About Pure Flix

Pure Flix, part of Great American Media, is a leading faith and family streaming service offering a broad selection of movies and series centered on uplifting, values-driven entertainment. The platform features original productions, exclusive content, and popular films across genres including romance, drama, and inspirational titles. Pure Flix is available to stream anytime, providing audiences with accessible, feel-good entertainment across devices.

Country artist Jackson Dean and jazz trumpeter Etienne Charles join all-star lineup for Palace 100 concert

COLUMBUS, Ohio, Oct. 6, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The Palace Theatre will celebrate its 100th anniversary by bringing Ray Charles' music back to a stage where he performed throughout his career. CAPA today announced that country artist Jackson Dean and jazz trumpeter Etienne Charles will join host Paul Shaffer and an all-star cast for Palace 100: The Genius of Ray Charles at 7:30 p.m. Saturday, Nov. 14, 2026, at the Palace Theatre in downtown Columbus.

An all-star lineup spans musical genres

Dean and Charles join a lineup that includes Grammy Award-winning R&B and jazz vocalist Patti Austin; multiplatinum singer-songwriter Aloe Blacc; Grammy-nominated gospel singer-songwriter Blessing Offor; Grammy and Academy Award-winning singer Lisa Fischer; Grammy-nominated singer Monica Mancini; and Columbus native, singer and songwriter Billy Valentine. A Guggenheim Fellow, Etienne Charles is known for blending jazz with Afro-Caribbean musical traditions.

Spanning R&B, jazz, gospel, country and contemporary music, the lineup reflects the range of styles Charles explored throughout his career.

Paul Shaffer and Gregg Field bring personal Ray Charles connections

Paul Shaffer, David Letterman's longtime musical director and bandleader, will host the evening. Shaffer performed with Charles on programs including Saturday Night Live and Late Night with David Letterman. The concert will be produced by Grammy and Emmy recipient, music producer, and former drummer for Ray Charles, Gregg Field.

"Ray Charles represents the kind of musical excellence that transcends genres, generations and boundaries," CAPA Vice President of Marketing and Sales Peter Keiser said. "Bringing his music back to the Palace honors his extraordinary legacy and the theatre's history as a place where great artists and unforgettable moments continue to come alive."

Palace 100 at a glance

  • Event: Palace 100: The Genius of Ray Charles
  • Occasion: The Palace Theatre's 100th anniversary
  • Date: Saturday, Nov. 14, 2026
  • Time: 7:30 p.m.
  • Location: Palace Theatre, 34 W. Broad St., Columbus, Ohio
  • Host: Paul Shaffer
  • Producer: Gregg Field
  • Featured artists: Aloe Blacc, Billy Valentine, Blessing Offor, Jackson Dean, Patti Austin, Lisa Fischer, Etienne Charles and Monica Mancini 
  • Tickets: Starting at $62.50 at the CAPA Ticket Center at the Ohio Theatre, 39 E. State St.; online at www.capa.com; or by phone at 614-469-0939
  • Significance: A one-night-only concert created for the Palace Theatre's centennial

An exclusive concert for the Palace Theatre's 100th anniversary

Created specifically for the Palace Theatre's centennial, the concert will be performed only once, in Columbus, and will not tour to other cities. Charles performed at the Palace Theatre throughout his career, most recently on June 6, 1992. Bringing his music back to the Palace links the theatre's history with a new generation of performers and audiences.

"A theatre doesn't reach its 100th anniversary by simply surviving—it gets there by becoming part of the lives of generations of people," Field said. "The Palace Theatre has that kind of history. For its centennial, we're bringing the music of Ray Charles, who performed on that very stage, back to the Palace with an extraordinary collection of artists. Having worked with Ray for many years, I can't imagine a more powerful way to honor his legacy and celebrate 100 years of this extraordinary theatre."

National talent and Columbus musicians share the Palace stage

The program will include a special rendition of "America the Beautiful," one of Charles' best-known interpretations. The concert will bring nationally recognized artists together with musicians from the Columbus Symphony Orchestra, Columbus Jazz and The Ohio State University School of Music. Led by Grammy-nominated conductor Chris Walden, the orchestra will feature Grammy-nominated guitarist Dean Parks, bassist Nathan East (Eric Clapton), Columbus Hammond organist and former Ray Charles band member Bobby Floyd, saxophonist Tom Scott (Blues Brothers) and Grammy-winning keyboardist Matt Rollings. The concert also marks a homecoming for Columbus native Billy Valentine, a performer and songwriter who co-wrote "My World," the title track of Charles' 1993 album.

The Palace Theatre celebrates 100 years

Billed as "A Theatre of a Thousand Wonders," the Palace Theatre opened Nov. 8, 1926, as a vaudeville house. Over the next century, its stage welcomed generations of artists and audiences across nearly every performing arts genre. Six days after the Palace's 100th birthday, Palace 100: The Genius of Ray Charles will celebrate that history by returning Charles' music to its stage.

The concert is one of several programs CAPA has planned in celebration of the Palace Theatre's centennial. Visit www.capa.com/100-celebration-palace for additional information.

TORONTO, Oct. 5, 2026 /CNW/ -- It's the gift that keeps giving as Hallmark Channel's Countdown to Christmas returns to W Network and STACKTV beginning Friday, October 16. Over 10 consecutive weeks, W Network is Canada's official holiday cheer headquarters, wrapping up and delivering heartwarming stories centered around the magic of the season. Following last year's Hallmark Channel's Countdown to Christmas, where W Network reached over 8 million Canadians and was ranked as the #1 specialty entertainment station for A25-54, F25-54 and total viewers*, this year's lineup features 34 all-new movie premieres, one special and two returning series reuniting viewers with household favourites, notable stars and feel-good holiday tales. With Hallmark Channel's Countdown to Christmas full lineup available to stream exclusively on STACKTV, the festivities continue as W Network will also be available on National Free Preview from November 1 to November 30. Please check local listings for additional information.

"The spirit of the holidays comes alive with the annual return of Hallmark Channel's Countdown to Christmas on W Network and STACKTV," said Jennifer Abrams, SVP Content and Marketing. "Our long-standing partnership with Hallmark continues to bring Canadian audiences the heartwarming stories, familiar faces and holiday magic they look forward to year after year.  

MOVIES

From time-travel twists to holiday meet cutes, this year's movie lineup is loaded with festive fun, heartfelt romance, and the magic of connection.

Debuting Saturday, November 28 at 8 p.m. ET/PT, Lacey Chabert and Travis Van Winkle star in Holiday Ever After: A Disney World Wish Come True where a holiday wish in Cinderella Fountain may turn their rivalry into romance.  Disney alumni Christy Carlson Romano and Richard Kind also star in this holiday tale set at The Most Magical Place on Earth.

In the time-travel tale with a holiday twist, The Nights Before Christmas, premiering Saturday, November 14 at 8 p.m. ET/ PT is an all-new Canadian movie starring Tyler Hynes and Laci J Maily. Marty is happily caught in a time loop on Christmas Eve until he encounters a down on her luck Chloe and for the first time since the loop started, he wants to see Christmas Day.

Continuing the time travels adventures, A Grand Biltmore Christmas follows Elizabeth as she travels from 1915 to 2026 Biltmore, where she reconnects with Michael and falls in love with the wonders of the 21st century. Airing Saturday, December 5 at 8 p.m. ET/PT, A Grand Biltmore Christmas stars Holland Roden, Niall Matter, Andie MacDowell, James Trevena, Jonathan Frakes, Rachel Boston and Wes Brown.

The Holiday Touchdown franchise returns with Holiday Touchdown: A Bears Love Story joining the lineup on Saturday, October 17 at 8 p.m. ET/PT. Avery writes an article profiling a woman attending her 500th Bears game, who only agrees to the story if her grandson serves as Avery's ambassador to Chicago for the holidays. This match made on the field stars, Lyndsy Fonseca, Robert Buckley, Marsha Mason, Barbara Alyn Woods, and Khary Payton with tons of special cameos, including Marilu Henner and Tamera Mowry-Housley.

TV SERIES

Festive fan favourite, Canadian original, Mistletoe Murders is back with Season 3 on Thursday, November 5 at 8 p.m. ET/PT. Emily and Sam tackle new mysteries that come to town and in the process further ignite their flame all while Emily's past threatens her time in Fletcher's Grove. Based on the Audible global hit podcast of the same name and created by Ken Cuperus, Mistletoe Murders from Lionsgate Canada and Headspinner Productions stars Sarah Drew as Emily Lane and Peter Mooney as Sam Wilner with special guest appearances from Holly Robinson Peete and Catherine Bell.

All aboard for the return of Christmas at Sea as Season 2 premieres on Monday, December 21 at 8 p.m. ET/PT, with back-to-back episodes. In this unscripted series, Hallmark superfans are rockin' around the high seas celebrating the holidays aboard a Christmas cruise. Across four-episodes superfans experience life changing moments and share in the joy of the season with a few surprises from their favourite Hallmark stars. Christmas at Sea features appearances from Benjamin Ayres, Jonathan Bennett, Rachel Boston, B.J. Britt, Wes Brown, Erin Cahill, Paul Campbell, Taylor Cole, Nikki DeLoach, Heather Hemmens, Tyler Hynes, Ginna Claire Mason, Brendan Penny, Kimberley Sustad, Andrew Walker and Ashley Williams.

releases.title: RODDENBERRY ENTERTAINMENT AND NASA's JET PROPULSION LABORATORY JOIN TO CELEBRATE LANDMARK ANNIVERSARIES
releases.body:
Historic collaboration will feature w programming to mark 60 years of Star Trek and 90 years of JPL

LOS ANGELES, Oct. 5, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- As both storied institutions observe milestone anniversaries in 2026, Roddenberry Entertainment, torchbearers of the Star Trek franchise and Gene Roddenberry's legacy, and NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory, managed by Caltech have planned an exciting activation, bringing two stargazing stewards of science fiction and science together in an exciting extension of their enduring collaboration.

For Roddenberry Entertainment, September 8 marks the 60th anniversary of the day Gene Roddenberry's groundbreaking sci-fi drama premiered on NBC. In over half a century since, The Original Series has grown into a sprawling universe of 12 spin-off television series, 13 feature films, and countless books, comics, and video games.

Meanwhile, October 31 marks nine decades since a group of Caltech graduate students and fellow enthusiasts began experimenting with rocketry in a dry riverbed near La Cañada Flintridge, Calif. The years that followed would see JPL grow from a test site in the Arroyo Seco to the crown jewel of Earth's extra-planetary robotic research ambitions. Voyager, the Mars rovers, and the Deep Space Network all trace their beginnings to JPL.

Caltech JPL and Roddenberry Entertainment have shared a special relationship over their histories. Throughout the development and production of Star Trek, Gene Roddenberry consulted often with JPL scientists and engineers to ensure that his vision of a spacefaring future was as feasible and believable as possible. In the 1970s, Roddenberry contacted John Casani, then JPL's Voyager project manager, who loaned Roddenberry a physical model of the Voyager probe, inspiring the sentient spacecraft V'Ger from "Star Trek: The Motion Picture."

Roddenberry's desire to ground his science fiction in real-world science meant a continued need to work closely with the real-world scientists at JPL. His stories and those that followed have honored those scientific advancements that have enabled us to travel to the stars in our time. In turn, many at JPL and Caltech proudly attribute their career paths to Star Trek and its vision of an interstellar future guided by reason, inclusion, and mutual aspiration.

The hub of this united celebration comes in the form of a uniquely exciting interview series titled "Those Who Look Up."

VIEW "THOSE WHO LOOK UP" TEASER HERE

Those Who Look Up

Going all the way back to The Original Series, Gene Roddenberry sought inspiration from scientists of the day, whose work could catapult the mind into the 23rd century. Honoring the inspiration Gene found in science, and looking at the subsequent reverberative effect Star Trek has had on the scientific community, Roddenberry Entertainment will be releasing its "Those Who Look Up" series – A collection of interviews featuring JPL and Caltech subject matter experts and Star Trek actors. The series will showcase the synergy between the two entities, and give human faces to the enduring intersection between science and science fiction. JPLers and Star Trek stars will explore how the work they do every day has influenced another person, another industry, and the world at large.

The series will be structured in a way that reflects the cyclical nature of the rapport between Star Trek and Caltech JPLers. Including four people from JPL and four members of Star Trek talent, the series begins with a JPLer interviewing a Star Trek actor, who, in turn, interviews another JPLer. That JPLer then interviews another Star Trek actor, who interviews another JPLer. At the series conclusion, the last person in the sequence will close the loop by interviewing the person who conducted the first interview.

"Having been lucky enough to visit JPL on a number of occasions, I've often considered the wonderful gift JPL gave to my father and Star Trek so long ago," said Roddenberry Entertainment CEO Eugene "Rod" Roddenberry, Jr. "Now, to recognize that his creation has reciprocated in such a significant way, and to see that in the faces of individuals who participated in our series, is tremendously rewarding."

ABOUT RODDENBERRY ENTERTAINMENT

Roddenberry Entertainment is a science fiction leader, passionately providing thought-provoking, quality genre entertainment that sustains the legacy of our founder, Gene Roddenberry. We are devoted to producing viewer-centric entertainment that actively recognizes the integral role audiences play in the creation of any franchise, as well as the role substantive entertainment can play in bettering society. Our productions promote experience over observation; encouraging audiences to think, question and challenge the status quo of the world in which we live.

ABOUT NASA JET PROPULSION LABORATORY

A division of Caltech in Pasadena, California, JPL is NASA's center of excellence for robotics and deep space exploration. The federally funded research and development center helped launch America's first satellite, Explorer 1, in 1958, and became a part of the agency later that year. Since then, JPL has managed such historic missions as Voyager, Galileo, Cassini, the Mars Exploration Rover program, the Perseverance Mars rover, the Ingenuity Mars Helicopter, Europa Clipper, and many more.

releases.body:
The Mexican-American-Founded Project Brings Music First Created

for Its Denver Wellness Sanctuary to Listeners Anywhere, at Any Time

Visit the Sacred Society Music World HERE

View REST, FOCUS, and ENJOY HERE

NEW YORK, Oct. 5, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Sacred Society, the Colorado-based wellness sanctuary, is expanding beyond its physical space with the launch of three 24/7 YouTube livestreams featuring the functional music created for Rest, Focus and Enjoy at www.sacredsocietymusic.com.

Each stream serves a distinct purpose. Rest provides a soundtrack for winding down and quiet moments; Focus accompanies work, study and concentration; and Enjoy brings more uplifting sounds to social settings and everyday activities. Corresponding playlists are available across major streaming services.

At the center of this new chapter is Toci, the character who connects Sacred Society's music to a larger visual and narrative world shaped in part by Beltran and Guerrero's Mexican heritage. Her story begins with a simple idea: healing is not something you chase, but something you allow. Like many people, Toci loses touch with that understanding amid the noise and movement of modern life. Her journey is one of return, using sound as a way back to herself. Through Toci, Sacred Society Music gives a face and story to the philosophy behind its music, inviting listeners to make that same return in their own lives.

The launch builds on an idea that began inside Sacred Society's wellness sanctuary based in Denver. Founders Barbie Beltran and Jose Guerrero initially developed the music because they wanted a specific sonic environment for guests and couldn't find existing options that fit their vision. To bring this vision to life, they teamed up with music executives Adelio Lombardi (Side 3 Studios) and Bradley Roulier (Beatport co-founder), along with music producer and songwriter Jon Bonus to create Sacred Society Music. That starting point continues to shape the project: rather than adapting an existing artist catalog for wellness use, Sacred Society Music creates its catalog specifically around how and when people intend to listen.

The approach arrives as functional listening becomes an increasingly visible part of the broader music business, with listeners using music alongside sleep, work, meditation and other daily activities. Sacred Society Music's model keeps those uses within one simple framework while combining ambient composition, meditative elements and immersive production, including music mixed exclusively in Dolby Atmos.

Visitors can experience the full world of Sacred Society Music at www.sacredsocietymusic.com, including 24/7 streaming music, interactive digital oracle card pulls, and more.

Today, the Rest, Focus and Enjoy livestreams will also be available on Sacred Society Music's official YouTube channel HERE and across streaming platforms everywhere.

But this is only the beginning for Sacred Society Music. As the project continues to reach audiences globally, Sacred Society is building a world that extends beyond listening, bringing together music, storytelling, mindfulness and culture in new ways. Additional releases, experiences, and elements of the Sacred Society universe will continue to unfold in the months ahead.

ABOUT SACRED SOCIETY MUSIC

Sacred Society Music creates functional music that helps people tune their inner life. We started from necessity. Guests in our Denver sanctuary needed more than background noise. They needed sound designed to support rest, sharpen focus, and lift the mood. Off-the-shelf tracks fell short, so we built our own. We compose original, frequency-informed music mixed in Dolby Atmos. It began as an in-house solution. Now it serves studios, spas, and storytellers who design spaces where people can actually feel something.
